de de ltar gnas pas lha'i dbang po brgya byin nyid ⑨yid la ngo mtshar che bar gyur nas / yon tan rab tu brtan pa de dag brtag pa'i ⑤phyir nags tshal dgon pa de na shing ljon pa dang ldum bu thams cad dpyid kyi rlung gis btab pa bzhin du lo ma thams cad 1med par byas so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' des ④lo ma lhags shing rnyings pa cung zad yod ⑤pa rnams btus te chu'i nang du btsos pa de dag za zhing mi dga' ba med par der ⑥bsam gtan gyi bde bas yid tshim par byas te/ bdud rtsi'i dam ④pa bzhin du ⑧gnas so/ /mang du thos pa snyems pa med/ /'byor pa rnams ni ser sna med/ /nags tshal gnas rnams chog shes pas rngu/ /yon tan rgyan gyi mchog yin no/ /de nas de'i chog shes ⑩brtan pa ngo mtshar du gyur pa des/ brgya byin ngo mtshar cher gyur nas bos ⑪pa bzhin du/ sems dpa' chen po de dro la babs ⑫pa'i tshe/ me la sbyin sreg bya ba ni zin/ bzlas brjod ni rdzogs nas/ skye bo glo bur du 'ongs pa lta ba'i phyir phyogs su bltas pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin bram ze'i gzugs ⑫su bsgyur nas glo bur du 'ongs pa 'dra bar mdun du 'ongs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' yid rab tu rngu dga' nas/ de'i drung du 'ongs nas⑩/ 'dir 'ongs pa legs so/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshig snyan par brjod nas⑩/ zas kyi dus la babs 7pa bstan nas mgron du bos ⑫ so/ / des kyang ⑪mi smra bas khas blangs pa pya bdag nyid chen po des shes nas/ sbyin pa ⑫'dod pas mig bgrad ⑫bzhin ni 'dzum pas mdzes/ /yid 'ong ⑫rnar snyan tshig gis dga' bar byas nas ni/ /dka' bas rnyed de btsos pa de dag thams cad kyang / /de la byin nas bdag nyid dga' bas tshim par gyur/ /de de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi 94—50

gnas su zhugs nas dga' zhing mgu ba ① nyid kyis nyin mtshan gnas byeso/ /de nas brgya byin de ①phyi de gnyis ④dang / nyi ma gsum ⑪la yang de bzhin du brtul zhugs kyis pyade'i mdun du 'ongs so/ /de'ang ④rab tu dga' nas de bzhin du de la mchod pa byas so/ /sbyin par 'dod pa'i dge ba rnams/ /snying rje goms pa las skyes pas/ /sdug bsngal srog la babs rkyen yang / /dman zhing zhum par yongs ⑨mi 'gyur/ /de nas brgya byen sems la ngo mtshar ⑫che bar gyur nas⑪/ 'di ni dka' thub che bas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i bdag po'i dpal thob par bya ba yang 'dod pa tsam gyis 'grub par rig nas dogs pa dang 'jigs pa skyes nas⑫/ bdag gi lus lha'i cha lugs ngo mtshar che bar ⑫bzang po dang ldan pa mngon par bstan nas/ de la dka' thub kyi dgos pa dris so/ /gnyen dang mdza' bshes mchi mas 'ju ba dang / /bde ba'i rgyur gyur yongs su bzung bor nas④/ /bsam pa'i lcags kyu gang du dmigs nas ni//dka' thub sdug bsngal 'di la gnas par gyur/ /bde ba snye'abyor pa'i longs spyod yongs bor zhing / /gnyen bshes ⑩rnams kyang mya ngan bslongs ⑫nas su/ /rgyu rkyen chung ngu dag gis brten ⑫pa rnams/ /bde dang 'gal ba'i dka' thub nags mi 'gro/ /gang gi yon tan thos nas khyod lta bu'i/ /blo yang de ltar dbang du byas pa de/ /bdag la gal te smra bar bya rung na/ /de bas bdag gi rtog pa bsal bar ⑪rigs/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gang gi phyir bdag pya ltar 'bad pa grogs po khyod nyon cig /yang dang yang du skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /rgas ⑪dang rgud dang na ba'i sdug bsngal dang / /'chi bar gyur tshusnyam sems pa'i bu'ajig rten rnams/ /bskyab pa'i phyir na ④bdag ni de ltar 94—51

gnas / /de nas brgya byin kyis bsams ①pa/ 'di ni bdag gi dpal 'dod pa ma yin no snyam nas dbugs phyin te/ legs par smras pa des dga' bar gyur te1/ de'i tshig de rigs so/ /zhes bya bas dga' ba bskyed de/byang chub sems dpa' la mchog sbyin par byas so/ /'dir khyod kyis dka' thub can dang mthun pa'i tshig legs par smras pa'i phyir 'ongs pas①/ khyod la mchog sbyin gyi 5gang 'dod pa de slongs shig /de nas byang chub sems dpas srid pa'i rngubade ba la ma chags pa dang / slong ba nyid sdug bsngal du rig cing chog shes pa la goms pas/ brgya byin la smras pa/ rjes su phan par byed pa'i ⑥mchog /gal te bdag la sbyin 'dod na/ /lha yi mchog la dam pa 'di/ /bdag gis da ni bslong ⑦/bar bya'o/ /chung ma yid du 'ong dang bu dang dbang byed dang / /mngon par 'dod pa'i nor rnams rgya chen thob gyur kyang / /gang gis yid gdungs rnams kyang 2 chog mi shes pa yi/ /brkam pa'i rlung de bdag gi snying la med par byos/ /de nas de'i chog shes pa la gzhol ba la ⑨legs par smras pas bsal ⑫ bar byas pa des/ brgya byen yid rab tu dang bar gyur nas/ byang chub sems dpa' la legs so zhes bya bas bstod de/yang mchog sbyin pas 'dun par byas so/ /'dir yang skye bo dka' ⑪thub pa dang mthun pa'i tshig khyod kyis legs par smras pa la dga' bas/ skyes lan dang 'dra bar mchog gzhan la tho)yang sbyin par bya'o/ /da 4)nas byang chub sems dpas mchog slong ⑫ba la snyad btags te/ nyon mongs pa dang bral ba thob dka' ba nyid de la bstan pa'i phyir yang de la chos bshad do/ /yon tan mchog ni ⑫ brgya byin khyod/ /nga la gal te mchog sbyin na/ /lha yi dbang po 94—52

dam pa'i mchog /de bas gzhan yang 'di bslang ①ngo / /sems can gang gis zil non ①dgra bo bzhin/ /nor yang nyams shing mdog bzang grags pa dang / /bde ba las kyang nyams par gyur pa ①yi/ /zhe sdang med de bdag la ring du byosadu/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis de thos nas/ ngo mtshar du gyur te—/ legs so zhes bya bas de la gus pas bstod de/ yang smras pa/ rab tu byung la grags pa de/ /rjes su chags bzhin bstan ⑤par 'os/ /de bas legs par smras pa rjoyi/ /mchog de bdag la ⑦bzhes su gsol/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyir/ mchog 'dod ⑧pa la snyad btags nas sems can nyon mongs pa can dang 'grogs pa smad pa'i phyir 'di skad ⑨smras so/ /byis pa rnams ni nam yang ⑩mi thos shing / /mthong bar mi 'gyur nams kyang mi smra zhing / /de dang 'grogs par ⑪skyo ba'i sdug bsngal yang / /mi myong mchog ni bdag gis ⑫khyod la slong / /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ phongs par gyur la khyad par du/ /dam pas phan btags ma yin na⑫/ /phongs pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i phyir/ /byis pa tha ma yin par 'dod/ /byis pa 'di dag khyad par du/ /snying rje'i gnas su gyur pa ni④/ /ci phyir snying rje can yin yang / /mthong ba tsam du ⑫spyod mi 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ grogs po khyod ⑩mi nus mod 'di la ⑩ltos shig /ji ltar byas kyang byis pa la/ /phan gdags par ni mi nus te/ /bdag cag lta bu ji ltar ⑫na/ /de la phan par brtson mi byed/ /de lta bas na 'di dag phan gdags par bya ba'i snod ma yin par zung shig /'di dag tshul min pa ⑪yang tshul bzhin byed/ /gzhan yang 'di la rab tu sbyor bar 'dod/ /'dul dang drang po'i rim dang rjo94—53

mi mthun par/ /phan par ①bstan kyang rab tu 'khrug par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa'i nga rgyal gti mug mes bsregs shing / /phan par smra la'ang khro bas rtsub 'gyur ba/ /'dul dang dubartson 'grus chung bas gzu lums can/ /de la ji ltar phan btags ldu/rung ba smos/ /lha'i gtso bo de lta ④bas na/ snying rje chen por khya gyur pa yang / /byes pa rjes dusu mi rung ba/ /mthong ba tsam du'ang mi 'dod do/ /brgya byin gyis de thos nas/ legs so legs so zhes de la bstod de legs par smras pas sems rab tu dad par gyur nas/ yang smras pa/legs par smras pa rin chen la/ /rin ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /dga' bas me tog snyim bkang nas⑦ / /'dir yang khyod la mchog sbyin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas skyes bu dam pa ⑤gnas skabs thams cad du bde ba bstan pa'i phyir/ brgya byen la smras pa/ brtan pa mthong zhing brtan pa thos pa dang / /de dag nyid dang brgya byin bdag 'grogs gyur⑨/ /de dang smra zhing spobs pa'i bde ldan gyur⑪ / /lha yi dam pa mchog de bdag la stsol/ /brgya byin kyis smras pa—/ khyod ni brtan pa la rab tu dga' ⑪ na/ de smros shig /brtan pas ⑫khyod la ci zhig byas⑫/ /'od srungs de yi rgyu smros shig /brtan pa mthong bar 'dod pa yi/ /gang phyir mi brtan bzhin du 'gyur④/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑫ skyes bu dam pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i phyir smras pa/ bdag gang gi phyir brtan pa 'ba' zhig mthong bar 'dod pa de grogs po khyod ⑩nyon cig /yon tan lam du bdag nyid 'gro bar byed/ /gzhan yang lam de nyid du 'dzud par byed/ /rtsub mo'i ⑩tshig kyang mi bzod bskyed ⑫mi 'gyur/ /de yi tshig ni phan par ⑪ldan pa yin/ /g.yo sgyu med pa'i 'dul bas rtag ④tu brgyan/ /de 94—54

ltar phan pa dag kyang bstan par nus/ /de ltar lkubadag blo yon tan dga' ba la—/ /yon tan dga' phyir rab tu gzhol bar gyur/ /de nas de la brgya byin gyis / legs so 'di ni legs ②so zhes bstod do/ /( —sems rab tu dang bar gyur nas/ yang mchog sbyin par byas so/ /chog shes pa la goms gyur pas—/ /khyod kyis kun tu bzlog gyur kyang / /bdag la phan btags rjoblo yis su/ /mchog ni blang bar bya ba'i rigs/ /gus dang ⑪phan pa'i bsam pa dang / /mthu yang ci yod thams cad kyis/ /mchog ni sbyin par byas pa larjo/ /ma blangs pa ni sdug bsngal che/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑦de rab tu phan 'dogs ④par 'dod pa rtogs nas de dag la ⑨dga' ba dang phan par 'dod pas sbyin pa la rab tu dga' ba de la brtan ⑪ pa'i phyir smras pa/khyod kyi ⑪kha zas zad pa'i nyes pa spangs/ /yid kyang sbyin la ⑫dga' dang mthun gyur zhing / /slong mi rnams ni ⑫tshul khrims rnam dag brgyan/ /'di dag bdag la yod gyur ④mchog slong ngo / /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ 'dir spyoyang khyod ni legs par smras pa ⑫rin po che'i 'byung khungs su gyur to/ /gzhan yang khyod kyis gang blangs ⑩pa/ /de dag thams cad de bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /legs par smras pa 'di la yang / /khyod la mchog ni sbyin par bya/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ lha rnams kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa khyod/ /bdag la phan 'dogs rgyur gyur mchog sbyin na/ /gsal bar skyobadag drung slan chad mi 'byon ⑪pa'i/ /mchog 'di lha min 'joms pa rjo khyod la bslong ⑨/ de nas brgya byen ngo mtshar du gyur nas/ mi bzod rngo )pa bzhin du /༷ )de la smras pa/khyod re zhig ltos shig ④dang / bzlas brjod brtul zhugs mchog ⑫sbyin dka' 94byed55

thub spyad pa yis① / /skye bo 'di dag kho bo'i snerjes su mthun ①'dod na/ /kho bo mchog sbyin 'dod phyir 'di ltar 'ongs pa la/ /khyod ni de ltar mthong bar mi 'dod ci yi phyir/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ 'di la bdag gis khyod mnyes par bgyi yis/ lha'i dbang ④po khyod ma bkyon cig /'di ⑤mi srun pa'i tshul kyang ma lags/ ma gus par bgyid rjopa yang ma lags/ khyod dang 'phrad klupar mi 'tshal ba yang ma lags na/ lha yi gzugs mchog rmad du byung ba mthong ba dang / /gzi brjid pegasal zhing mdangs dang ldan pa mthong gyur na / /khrod ni rab tu dang zhing zhi bar gyur pa yang / /bdag gi dka' thub nyams par 'gyur du dogs lags mod/ /de nas brgya byin kyis de la phyag 'tshal te bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas nam langs pa dang / lha'i bza' ba dang btung ba brgya byin gyis sbyar ba rnams dang /rang sangs rgyas brgya phrag du ma brgya byin gyis spyan drangs pa rnams dang / lha'i bu gzhon nu bshos 'dren ⑨par chas shing bsdogs pa du ma tsam lhags pa()/byang chub sems dpas mthong bar gyur to/ /bza' ba dang ni btung ba sbyar ba de dag gis/ /drang srong chen po de dag mchod par ⑪byas pa dang / /thub pa de ni dga' ba chen po thob par gyur/ /skye bo dka' thub can dang mthun pa'i tshul dag dang / /bsam gtan tshad med sdom dang zhi ba'i ⑫gnas/ /de bas na de ltar dka' thub kyi nags tshal na gnas pa rnams ⑫la yang gtong phod pa dang dpa' bas rgyan du gyur ④na/ khyim na gnas pa rnams ⑫ lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de bas na mi rnams kyi ⑪gtong phod pas bdag brgyan par bya'o/ /zhes sbyin bdag gzengs bstod pa'i phyir de ltar bcom ldan 'das de ⑩sku tshe snga 94—56

ma la yang legs par gsungs pa khyad par can rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin na/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa na lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba nyid bstan pa la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /a gas+t+ya'i ①skyes pa'i rabs te bdun pa'o// //⑤bam po gsum pa/ snying rje chen po gzhan gyi sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba ①rnams ni bdag gi bde ba la mi lta ste/ de yang 'di skad thos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' dag ④gi che ba nyid kyis snying rje dang ldan zhing / 'gro ba yongs su bskyab pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa can/ sbyin pa dang dul ba dang sdom pa dang /nges pa la sogs pa 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa dang / mthun pa'i yon tan khyad par can mngon par 'phel ba/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i yid du gyur pa/ byams pa'i stobs zhes bya ba'i rgyal por gyur to/ /zhes grags so⑤/ /skye dgu rnams ni dubade dang sdug bsngal gang / /rgyal po de yang de dag de bzhin gyur/ /de bas de ni dze+eskye dgu bsrung la mkhas/ /mtshon cha dang ni gtsug lag rnams la goms/ /mi yi bdag ⑤po'i bka' khrims spyi bos mnos/ /de yi mtshon cha rgyan dang 'dra bar gyur/ /'jig rten phan byung bstan bcos ⑨tshul rnams kyi⑩/ /gtsug lag dag kyang rnam par gsal bar snang / /tshar gcad ⑪pa dang phan gdags byas pa ⑫la/ /chos dang 'gal ba de ni yongs ⑫mi byed/ /tshul la mkhas shing phan par sems pa'i phyir/ /skye dgu rnams la rtog mkhas pha dang 'dra/ /de de ltar chos kyis skye dgu rnams (steskyong ba na/bden pa dang gtong ba dang / (nyeshes rab la sogs pa gzhan la phan pa 4994—57

yongs su bsngos pa'i phyir khyad par can ①gyur pa la rlabs che ba'i rim pas byang chub kyi tshogs bsags shing mngon par dar ba las/ re zhig cig nyes pa 'ga' zhig byung ba'i phyir gnod sbyin gzhan gsod pa la mkhas pa mdangs 'phrog pa la dga' ba lnga sde cigakhya /gnod sbyin gyi bdag pos rang gi yul nas sgyugs pa yul der lhags so/ /zude'i yul na gnod pa thams cad med pa dang rtag tu dga' ba sna tshogs yod pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa mchog dang ldan pas rtag tu thu mi rnams rab tu dga' mgu zhing dar 'ub mthong nas/ de dag yul de na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi mdangs 'phrog 'dod par gyur to/ /de dag rab tu bsgrims nas ni/ /rang gi las la 'jug byas kyang / /de na gnas pa rnams kyi mdangs/ /'phrog par bya bar mi nus so/ /rgyal bo de'i ⑥mthu khyad par che bas na/ /bdag gi yin pa'i blo ni gar bzhag pa/ /de nyid de yi srung ma ④mchog yin pas/ /de dag gis ni mdangs 'phrog nus ma gyur/ /de ltar rab tu 'bad kyang yul de na gnas pa'i mi gang gi mdangs ④'phrog par ma nus pa de'i tshe/ de dag gcig la gcig bltas nas/ grogs po dag 'di ci zhig yin snyam du sems par gyur to/ /bdag cag mthu la gnod par nus pa yi/ /rig sngags dka' thub dngos grub khyad par ⑨ yang / /de dag la ni yod pa ma yin na/ /'on kyang de ring bdag cag thams cad kyi/ /ming ni don dang mthun par ma gyur to/ /de nas gnod sbyin ⑪dag bram ze'i gzugs su bsgyur te song song ⑪ba dang / grib shing sngon po cig gi drung na nags na rgyu ba'i ba glang gi dze+e'u rmyecig lham dang bcas par 'dug cing / nags tshal gyi shing gi me tog lo ma dang bcas pa'i phreng ba ni thogs/ dbyug pa dang dgra sta ni g.yas 94—58

rol du bzhag /gcig pus ①srad bu ni 'khal/ sgyugs byeglu ni len cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ de'i drung du lhags te smras pa/ kye ba glang rdzi'u 1'di lta bu'i dgon pa dben pa 'gro ba med pa na gcig pur gyeji ltar mi 'jigs/des de dag la bltas nas su la 'jigs zhes smras so/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis smras pa/ srin po rnams dang 'dre rnams rang bzhin kyis gtum zhing ma rungs pa yin par khyod kyis sngon ma thos sam/ rig sngags dka' thub bde legs ldan pa dag /grogs kyis bskor ba'i nang na 'dug gyur zhing / /dpa' la 'jigs pa med pa'i mi dag kyang / /gang las (cho thar bar 'gyur ba rab dka' ba / /nags tshal rab tu dben zhing zab pa la/ /'jigs pa'i sa na grogs kyang yong med par/ /mi yi sha dang tshil dag za ba yi/ /srin bo de dag ci phyir khyod mi skragaspyo /de skad ces smras pa dang / ba glang rdzi'u des dgod nas ⑦ smras pa/ bde legs chen pos 'gro ba 'di/ /yongs su bskyang bar gyur pa ⑤na / /lha yi dbang po dag gis kyang / /'di dag gtse bar mi nus na/ /sha za ⑨rnams kyis ga la nus/ /de bas nags na ⑩khyim bzhin du/ /mtshan mo dag kyang nyin par bzhin/ /gcig pu'ang grogs kyi nang 'dug 'dra/ /bdag ni 'jigs pa med par 'dug /de nas gnod sbyin de dag ngo mtshar cher gyur nas/de la zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du ched cher byas nas smras pa/ kye bzang po khyod kyi bde legs kyi bye brag de ci 'dra ba zhig re zhig ⑪sgos shig /de dgod cing de dag la smras pa/ bdag cag gi bde legs kyi bye brag rmad du byung ba ci 'dra ba nyon cig /gser gyi ri bo'i brag ltar yangs pa'i brang ⑫ / /ston ka'i zla ba ⑫dri med mdzes pa'i zhal/ /dpung pa gser gyi sdong po lta bur rgyas/ /mi 94—59

dbang khyu mchog spyan 'dra rnam par gnon/ /bdag cag gi bde legs kyi khyad par ni 'di'o ①zhes smras nas/ ngo mtshar che zhing khro ba dang bcas pas gnod sbyin de dag la bltas te yang smras pa/ e ma ho ①'di ngo mtshar che'o/ /mi dbang thub 1chen 'di ltar grags pa yang / /khyed bukyi rna lam ci ltar ma grags kye⑤/ /'on te thos ⑥kyang shin tu rmad byung bas/ /spyod cag yid mi ches phyir ma bzung ngam⑦—/ /khyed cag gang nas lhags ⑧pa'i yul de yi/ /mi rnams yon tan tshol la mi mkhas sam/ /ched cher mi 'dzin skal ba med pa'i phyir/ /mi dbang grags pas rnam par spangs su dogs/ /de bas na yul de lta bu mtha' 'khob ⑪nas 'dir lhags pa ni/ khyed cag la skal ba cung zad cig yod do/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis smras pa/ bzang po de'i yul na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams la ⑪ mi ma yin pa rnams kyis gnod pa byed ⑪mi nus pa rgyal po de'i mthu de lta bu ci las gyur/ ba glang rji'us ⑫smras pa/ nged kyi rgyal po chen po'i mthu 'di lta bu 'di ⑫ni rang gi che ba nyid kyis thob pa'o/ /bram ze dag ltos shig /de'i dpung byams pa'i ④ru mtshon khro bo'i dpung ni cho ga tsam/ /de ⑫ni mi khro tshig rtsub mi smra sa yang legs par bsrung / /de yi bka' khrims chos yin rgyu med nor yang dam pa mchod/ /de ltar rmad du byung yang ngan pa'i chos nyid dregs pa med / /kho bo cag gi rje 'di ni de lta bu la sogs pa'i yon tan mang po dang ldan te/ de bas ⑫yul na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams la gnod par ⑩mi nus so/ /de lta bas na kho bos khyed la ci snyed cig smra bar mi spyonus kyis/ mi'i bdag po'i yon tan thos par 'dod na khyed grong khyer de ⑪nyid du 'dong bar ④ rigs so//khyed der song dang 0skye bo rnams rang rang 3gi chos la dga' bas ya rabs kyi 94—60

tshul la gnas pa dang rtag tu bde zhing lo legs pas rab tu dga' ba phun sum tshogs shing cha lugs bzang la mi 'phya ⑨ ba dang / skye bo glo ⑤bur du lhags pa rnams la khyad par du byams pa dang / mi'i bdag po'i yon tan snying la dran pa dang / de'i grags pa'i gzhi bstod pa dang kya bkra shis pa ④dang bde legs bzhin du rab tu dga' zhing goms par byed pa dag mthong na ⑤rgyal po'i yon tan rgya cher shes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar yon tan mang po brjod pas de mthong bar 'dod pa la nges par de'i yon tan mngon sum du 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag rang gi mthus ma tshugs pas rgyal po de la sems mi bzod pa dang bcas pas yon tan snying nas brjod cing tshig ⑥rigs pa dang / bden par smras pa des kyang sems 'jam por ma gyur to/ /dman pa rnams ni phal cher yang / /mi bzod pas ni yid gdungs pas⑦/ /dngos po gang la de grags pa/ /de yis lhag 'upar gdungs par gyur⑨ / /rgyal po de ⑩sbyin pa la dga' bar shes nas/ de la gnod pa byed par 'dod pa'i gnod sbyin de dag gis rgyal po de ⑩mthong nas mthong ba'i tshe/ bza' ba slongs ⑫so/ /de nas rgyal po de rab tu dga' nas de'i las su bskos pa'i mi rnams la kha zas zhim po bram ze rnams la myur du byin cig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas bram ze la dgos spyopa'i kha zas rnams khyer te 'ongs na yang / gnod sbyin de dag na re kha zas de lta bu ④bdag cag mi bza'o zhes smras spyonas/ stag gzig rtsa sngon po mi 'dod pa bzhin du len du ma btub bo/ /de rgyal po des thos nas/ de dag gi drung du song ste/ 'o na dzad cag rnams ⑩kha zas ci lta bu 'dod de 'dra ba btsal lo/ /zhes smras so/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis smras pa/ mi sha shin tu 94—61

dron po dang / /mi yi khrag ni dron mo ①dag /brtul zhugs ma nyams pad+ma'i spyan / /gnod sbyin rnams kyi bza' btung lags/ /zhes smras nas/ rang gi lus kha nas mche ba gcigs pa/ mig dmar zhing ser la g.yo ①zhing mi sdug pa dang / sna leb cing mi sdug pa dang / skra dang kha spu me 'bar ba ltar ser ba dang / lus char sprin ltar ①gnag cing mi sdug pa ④'jigs pa bstan pa ⑤de dag mthong nas/ rgyal po des bsams pa/ 'di dag ni sha za yin te mi ma yin no/ /de bas na bdag cag gi bza' ba dang btung ba ma pya'adod do snyam du nges par gyur to/ /de nas mi'i dbang po de snying rje can yin ⑦pas/bsam pa dag pas de dag la snying rje de bas yang ches ⑤gyur snying la snying rje 'ba' zhig semasabu// gnod sbyin de dag la mya ngan byed cing don 'di lta bu nges par bsam mo⑩/ /snying rje can la 'di lta bu'i/ /bza' dang bca' ba rab tu dkon/ /nyin re zhing yang de btsal ba/ /de las sdug bsngal che ba med / /snying rje med cing mi nus na'ang / /'bad pa ⑪don ni med par 'gyur / /nus na'ang phan byed goms pa la/ /de bas ⑫dka' ba ci zhig yod/ /snying rje med cing yid ni ma zhi ba/ /de lta bu yi kha zas za ba rnams/ /tshe 'di dang ni pha rol rang don bsreg⑫ /'di dag sdug bsngal nam zhig med par 'gyur—/ /da 'di dag gi kha zas sbyar bas nyin zhag 'ga' ④tsam yang gzhan gsod pa la zhugs pa 'di las ci ltar bzlog par bya/ phongs te slong du 'ongs pa rnams kyi gdong / /re ba bzlog pas ngo 'dzum gnag gyur pa/ /bu yug rlung gis pad+ma rnying pa bzhin/ /mi dga' byas pas nams kyang ⑩bdag mi dran//gdon mi za bar bdag lus rgyas pa 'di⑩/ /khrag dang bcas pa'i sha rnams 94—62

sbyin par bya/ /phongs pa 'ongs na de ni rigs ①pa snyam/ /de las gzhan pa bdag gis gang du btsal/ /bdag rang shi ba'i sha rnams drod med la/ /khrag rnams 'ang rjode la yod pa ma yin no①/ /bru ba tsha bas sems ni gdungs pa la /de yis legs par mgu bar 'gyur ma yin/ /gson bo'i sha yang ④bdag gis ji ltar btsal bar bya/ /'di dag bdag gi thad du 'ongs nas bkres pa largya/ /skom pas mig dang gdong gi mdongs nyams shing / /bslong snedang re ba'i 'bras bu med pas yid④/ /sdug bsngal bzhin du slar dong na yang ci zhig ⑤bya//de bas na 'di ni bu/dus la bab kyis⑩/ rtag tu na zhing gdug ⑩pa'i rma dang 'dra⑫ / /nad kyi 'byung khungs ⑫ngan pa'i lus 'di la/zi/ /dgos pa khyad par can du spyad pa yis/ /bcos pa'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod par ⑫bya/ /de ltar nges par byas nas rgyal po ⑫rab tu dga' bar gyur pas/ mig rtsa dang gdong gi mdangs bzang pos rang gi lus bstan nas/ gnod sbyin de dag la smras pa/ bdag gi sha ni khrag dang bcas pa 'di/ /'jig rten rnams la phan pa'i phyir bzung ste/ /gal te de ring mgron du byar rung na/ /de ni bdag gis ⑩mngon par thob par ⑫'gyur/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag rgyal po de'i ⑪lhag pa'i bsam pa shes bzhin du ngo mtshar rab tu che bas yid ma ches nas/rgyal po la smras pa/ phongs pas bdag gi sdug bsngal dag /slong zhing dman pas bstan pa lags/ /de las sbyin pa po nyid kyis/ /dus la bab pa ( 'u mkhyen par mdzod/ /de nas rgyal po des bsams pa da du r+shani 'di dag dga' 'dod do 3snyam nas/ snying rab tu dga' ste/ rtsa dbral 3ba'i phyir sman pa rnams bos shig ces bka' stsal to/ /de nas rgyal po de'i blon po rnams rgyal po'i sha dang 94—63

khrag rnams ①sbyin par byed bar rig nas/ rtab rtab por gyur to rjo/ /mi bzod cing sems 'khrugs nas byams pa'i dbang gis don 'di lta bu cung zad cig gsal bar smras so/ /lha sbyin pa la ①dgyes ches pas 'bangs glo ④ba nye ba rnams la phan pa dang / gnod par 'gyur ba mi gzigs pa ⑤mi rigs so/ /lhas 'di dag ni rjomi mdon pa yang ma lags te/ /'di ltar skye dgu rnams la gnod pa gang dang gang / /de dang de dag gnod sbyin rnams la dga'/ /gzhan la gnod pas 'tsho zhing dga' ba skye/ /'di dag rigs dang rang bzhin de lta ⑦lags/ /rgyal srid dpal 'di ⑤'jig rten phan pa'i phyir/ /bde la ma chags lha yis bzung ⑨bar mdzod/ /de bas bdag gi sha sbyin gsol ⑩ba yi//log pa'i lam du yi dam bcas pa mthong / /skyes bu dpa' bo byed kyi ⑪mthus bskyabs pa'i/ /'jig rten gdon mi za bar 'di mi bzod/ /phung bar byed la mkhas pa 'di dag ni/ /tshul gyis tshul min skye dgu phung bar 'dod/ /mchod sbyin tshe na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'ang / /tshil dang zhag la sogs pa bsregs pas mgu/ /byed kyi zhal zas phun sum tshogs pa dag /gus par sbyin ⑫yang 'di dag 'dod mi 'gyur/ /lha'i thugs ni bdag cag lta bu'i skye bos bcos pa ma lags mod kyi⑫/ 'on kyang 'di ni bdag cag gi don du gces pa'i be+ed du bdag cag 'di ltar ko ⑫long gsol bar gyur to/ /gnod sbyin lnga po 'di rnams kyi don spyodu 'bangs thams cad mgon ma mchis par bgye'am⑫/ lha 'di lta bu'i ⑩chos gang gi lam lags/ gzhan yang 'di ltar bdag cag la mi ⑫byams pa ci las gyur/ rje'i ched du 'tshal ba la sha dang khrag yongs su rdzogs par mchis pa 'di dag sngon bdag cag gang gis ⑪sbas te ma phul na lha nyid kyis 94—64

stsal bar bzhed① / de nas rgyal po des blon po de dag la smras pa/ yod bzhin du ni med ces su/ /nged cag lta bus ci khrultar smra/ /brtul te gsal bar slong ba ④la/ /mi sbyin zhes kyang ci skad smra/ /chos kyi bka' khrims duthog mar 'gro ba dag /gal te ngan pa'i lam du bdag song na/ /nga yi ⑤ spyod pa'i rjes su 'jug pa yi/ /nga yi 'bangs rnams gnas skabs ci ltar 'gyur/ /'di yang skye dgu rnams kyi don gye phyir/ /ngas ni lus la khyesnying po dbyung bar bya//nga yi sems ni ser snas phrogs gyur na/ /skye bo'i don la dge ba'i gzi ci 'dra/ /khyed kyis ④nga la gus pa dang bcas par byams pa dang bag phab ste gang smras pa/'di ltar bdag cag la ni ⑧mi byams pa ni rnguci las gyur/ sha dang khrag bdag cag la yongs su rdzogs par mchis bzhin du/ lha nyid kyis stsal bar bzhed ces zer ba de yang khyed la bshad do/ /nga spyod la mi 'byor ⑩zhing mi byams pa yang ma yin la/ ma byin du dogs pa yang med mod kyisakṛ7 / rim gyis nor ni nyung ngur ⑫gyur pa 'am/ /skal ba chung bas zad par gyur na ni/ /mdza' bo rnams la slong ba mdzes par gyur/ /nor ldan dbul la slong ba yongs ⑫mi mdzes—/ /skye bo phongs pa rnams kyi phyir bskyed pa'i/ /lus ni sha rgyas shin tu mtho ba dang ④/ /nga bdag nyid la chen bo yod bzhin du/ /khyod ⑫ la slong ba legs pa ma yin no/ /mi shes gzhan gyi gnod pa'ang ⑩mi bzod na/ /khyod ⑩kyi gnod pa bdag gis ga la bzod/ /'di dag khyod ⑫la mi slong nga la slong / /de bas nga bdag sha ni sbyin par bya/ /de bas na nga la rab tu byams pas chos kyi gegs ⑪la 'dzem pa med pa 'di thong shig /nga'i don du khyod kyis du spyod pa 'di lta bu bya ba 0mi rigs so/ /'di ni re zhig dpyad 3dgos te/ /bza' ba 394—65

la sogs bdog ①bzhin du/ /sbyin pa 1'gog pa ji ltar 'gyur/ /legs sam gal te ma legs nakye/ /de ltar byed pa ci 'drar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'dir bsam pa de lta bu ④de thong la/ nga'i grogs durjes su mthun par byas ④na rigs pas dpyad ④par bya'o/ /lam log par 'gro ba las bzlog pa'i yid can du byas la rjes su yi rang ba dang mthun par 'di la khyed kyis byas na bzang gi de ltar mi brtan par bya ba ldumi rigs so/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ nor ni gcig pus spyad pa ma yin la/ /slong ba'ang nyin re rtag tu 'ong ma yin/ /slong ba 'di lta bu dang 'phrad ⑨pa ni/ /lha dag mnyes par byas kyang mi 'grub ⑩ na/ /slong ba 'di lta bu 'ang 'ong 'gyur zhing ⑫/ /lus kyang chud za mi bde'i gnas gyur la/ /je tshom za na'ang rgya cher mi 'grub na/ /'dzum zhing ⑫zhum pa med ⑫pa'i mchog yin no/ /de ltar rgyal po des rang gi 'khor rnams la khyed kyis de ltar nga la brgal bar 6mi rigs so/ /zhes tshig 'jam pos bsgos ⑫nas/ sman pa rnams bos te 7rang gi lus la rtsa lnga dbral ⑪te/ gnod sbyin de rnams ⑫la smras pa—/ nga yi lus 'di khyer nas su⑪/ /chos kyi grogs kyang bya ba dang / /nga yang rab tu dga' gyur par/ /khyod ༷ kyis nga ni bya bar ⑫rigs/ /de dag gis de ltar bgyi'o zhes smras nas/ rgyal po'i khrag tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba 'dra ba snyim pa zed 3de btung bar chas so/ /rgyal po de'i lus gser mdog 'dra ba laske/ /mtshan mo spyod pa rnams ni khrag 'thung ⑫ba/ /ri rab lhun po'i ri la dbyar tshudus kyi/ /char sprin stug ⑪pos nye bar bskor ba bzhin/ /dga' ba mchog ldan bstan ⑩dang ldan pa dang / /lus kyi yon tan ldan pas rgyal po de/ /lus kyang ma nyams sems kyang brgyal ba med/ /khrag gi rgyun yang zad pa ⑦yod 94—66

ma gyur/ /gnod sbyin de dag skom gyis gdung ba pa7 zhi nas da ni 'dis 'tshal to zhes rgyal po la smras so/ /sdug bsngal mang bo 'byung ba'i gnas kyi lus/ /rtag tu byas pa mi gzo yin ②yang rgyal po de/ /slong ba dag la sbyin pa'i don grub pas/ /rab tu dga' dang rjes mthun bzung bar gyur/ /de nas rgyal po de ⑦rab tu dga' bas bskul bas mig dang bzhin gyi mdangs lhag par gsal bar gyur nas/ ut+pa la mthing ga'i 'dab ma ltar mdog sngo ba'i ral gri rnon po rdo rje ④rin po ches spras pa'i 'od kyis mdzes pa blang steye/ bdag gi sha bcad cing ⑥de dag la byin no/ /byin ⑦la dga' bas yang dang yang / /skabs ni med par byas pa ⑤na/ /bcad pa'i sdug bsngal de yid la/ /dmigs par byed ni ma ⑨nus so/ /ral gri rnon pos ⑫ bcad pas drangs pa yi nyunyu/ /dga' bas phyir yang ring du bsregs pa bzhin⑩/ /de yi sdug bsngal skyo zhing ngal ba ltaraste/ —/ /yid la 'jug par byed pa chung bar 'gyuratsobye / /rang gi sha yis gnod sbyin de dag ni/ /tshim par byas pas de ni de bzhin dga'/ /de dag sems ni khro ba'i rang bzhin yang / /de ltar byas nas ⑫'jam zhing nges par gyur / /chos la ⑫dga' zhing snying rje'i dbang gyur te/ /gzhan gyi don du bdag lus gces btang bas/ /zhe sdang me yis bsregs pa'i yid rnams kyang / /rab tu dang zhing mdog kyang gsal bar byas/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag rgyal po des ⑫rang gi sha gcod pa la 'bad cing sha bcad pa'i sdug bsngal gyis bzhin mdangs ma gyur pa dang / mi g.yo ba ⑫de bzhin du bzhugs ⑨ pa mthong nas/rab tu dga' ⑫zhing ngo mtshar che bar ⑩gyur to/ /e ma ho 3ngo mtshar rmad byung 'di dag ci/ /bden nam brdzun zhes dpyod 7 rtecing dga' ba skyes/ /brgya ④la 94—67

mi bzod zhi nas yid kyang dang / /de la bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal bar gyur/ /lha nyid kyi sku 'o brgyal 1bar mdzad pa btang ②du gsol/ bdag ①kyang tshim par bgyis lags so④/ /skye bo slong ba yid dga' bar babyid pa shin tu rmad du byung ba khyod kyi spyod pa 'di ngo mtshar gyis btang du gsol/du zhes rgyal po la gus pa dang bcas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas pas durab tu dga' ⑦zhing gdong mchi ma can gyis bltas nas yang smras pa/ gus pa'i dbang gis skye bos skekhyod kyi grags pa sgogs pa thog tu bab/ /dpal yang pad+ma'i nags tshal btang ste khyed kyel brten pa thog tu bab/ /brgya byin mgon du gyur kyang khyod kyi mthus bskyabs sa ⑫yi lha mo 'di/ /mtho ris kyis ⑪mthong smon par nges te gal te mi smon bslus su zad/ /mang du smos kyang mi ⑫dgos te/ skye bo 'di lta bus mngon par bzung ba'i mi'i 'jig rten 'di dag ni skal ba dang ldan pa'o/ /khyod lta bu 'o brgyal bar bgyis pa 'dis ni bdag cag bsregs kyi 'gran zla ⑫ma mchis so/ /de ⑩ltar gyur pa las kyang skye bo khyod lta bu la brten nas bdag cag thar bar nus nges so/ /⑫ bdag cag gis nongs pa bgyis pa gsol ⑩ba'i slad du zhu bar 'tshal lo/ /bde ba brnyes par gyur pa dang / /rgyal po'i dpal yang bor nas ni/ /'di lta bu yi spyod pa yis/ /rmad du byung ba'i gnas ci bzhed/ /thams cad sa yi bdag po 'am/ /nor gyis ⑩phyug pa'am dbang po 'am/ /tshangs pa'am rnam par grol ba dag /dka' thub 'di ⑫yis bzhed lags sam/ /'di lta bu yi rtsol ⑪phod pas/ /bzhed pa'i don ni mi ring ste/ /gal te bdag cag thos rung na/ /bdag cag la ni bka' stsal rigs / /rgyal pos smras pa/ ci'i phyir ngas dhi'adi ltar byed pa nyon cig /94—68

rnyed par dka' la 'jig par sla ba dang / /chog pa'i bde med rab tu zhi med pa'i—/ /srid pa'i longs spyod bde ba nga mi 'dod/ /lha dbang dpal yang 'dod pa ma yin na/ /de las gzhan pa smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /bdag gis ①sdug bsngal zad pa tsam kyi phyir/ /nga yi yid ni mgu bar 'gyur ma yin/ /sdug bsngal mi bzad nad kyis nyen pa yi/ /lus can mgon med 'di rnams ngas bltas na⑤/ /bsod nams 'dis ni thams cad gzigs pa yi/ /go 'phang thob ①cing skyon gyi dgra btul nas/ /rga dang na dang 'chi ba'i rlabs 'khrugs pa'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las skye bo 'don par 'dod/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag rab tu dang ④zhing ba spu langs nas/ rgyal po la phyag 'tshal te smras pa—/ 'di lta bu'i rtsol ba khyad par can gyi las 'di ni rigs te/ de bas na khyod lta bu'i dgos pa grub pa ni/ ring por 'umi thogs so snyam du yid la nges par bsams pas 0gsol ba btab pa/ khyod kyi bsam ⑦pa 'di kun ni/ /'jig rten phan pa'i phyir lags kyang / /bdag cag rang la phan 'tshal bas /de tshe bdag cag dgongs su gsol/ /ma 'tshal bas na bdag cag gis/ /bdag gi don yang ma mthong bas/ /de ltar khyod ni 'o brgyal ④ba/ /de yang bzod pa mdzad du gsol/ /khyod kyi bka' ⑨yang bdag cag la/ /rjes su bzung ⑩ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /blon po dag la bgyi ba bzhin/ /'dzem pa med par stsal ba ⑪rigs/ /de nas rgyal po des de dag ⑫ sems rab tu zhi ⑫zhing 'jam par gyur pa rig ④nas smras pa/ 'di ni nga la phan pa yin gyi gnod pa ma yin pas mi bzod du dogs pa ma bskyed ⑫cig /gzhan yang / chos kyi lam la 'di ltar grogs byed pa/ /byang chub thob nas rjed ⑩par ga la 'gyur/ /94—69

rnam par thar pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi las/ /khyed cag nyid la thog mar bgo bar bya / /nga ni de la dga' bar shes byas nas/ /srog gcod khyed kyis dug bzhin spang bar byos/ /gzhan nor chung ma dag la chags pa dang / /brdzun du smra dang chang gi sdig pa spongs/ /de nas gnod sbyin de dag gis ①de bzhin du bkyi'o zhes de la mnyan nas/ de la bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /sems dpa' chen po des mebadag gi sha dang khrag nges par sbyin par byas pa de nyid kyi tshe/ sa ni rnam pa mang por g.yos par gyur torju/ /gser gyi ri bo rnam par 'gul bar gyur/ /de na gnas pa'i bya lgornams sgra yang 'byin / /shing rnams 'gul bas me tog lhags par gyur/ /de dag rdzis bskyod mkha' la sprin ltar chags/ /la la bla res khyebres shing bya brgyus bzhin/ /kha cig tu ni phreng ba brgyus pa bzhin/ /mi yi bdag po khor gyeyug mnyam par lhags / /rgya mtsho chen po shin tu g.yo peba'i rlabs/ /rang bzhin las ni lhag dupa'i shugs dang sgrasashe/ /'gro ba brtul ba'i ⑩lus ni gzi mdangs can//sa yi bdag po'i ṅku/bzlog pa bzhin du byung / /de nas lha yi dbang pos ⑫ 'di ci zhes/ /brtags ⑫par gyur nas de yi rgyu rtog cing / /rgyal po nyes par dogs te rab myur bar/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mya ngan 'khrugs par 'ongs sa yi bdag po de ltar gyur na yang / /④gzi mdangs skegasal bas lhag par ya mtshan skyes/ /thad du 'ongs nas snyan pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ /dang zhing dga' bas de yi spyod pa bstod/ /e ma ho/ skye bo ⑩dam pa'i cho rigs ⑩bzang / /e ma ho/ yon tan bsgoms pas ()rgya re che/ /e ma hopho)/gzhan la phan pas blo re bde me/ /sa 'di khyod la gtad pa ⑨mgon dang bcas//94—70

zhes bstod nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lha dang mi'i sman gyi khyad par gyi rma gsar ①pa sos par byed nus pa rnams kyis/ de'i lus sngon bzhin du sdug bsngal med par byas nas/ rgyal po des kyang mthun pa dang gus pa dang khyeyo byad kyis be+er mchod par byas te/1 nyid kyi gnas su slar song ④ ngo de ltar na snying rje chen po rnams ni gzhan kyi sdug bsngal gyis rngusdug bsngal zhing /bdag gi bde ba la mi lta ba yin na/ nor tsam la 'uchags nas gtong mi phod pa lta su ④zhig yod ces⑤/ skye bo sbyin pa byed pa dag la gzengs ⑨bstod pa dang / snying rje'i yon tan bsngags pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑩che ba bstan pa dang / bste stang du byas te chos nyan 7pa la yang brjod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong lnga bo 'di dag ni mang du byed skyebyed pa'o/ /zhes ⑫gsungs pa de yang 'di la dgongs termye/ de'i tshe rmyeganod sbyin lnga por gyur pa de dag la bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa de bzhin du chos kyi bdud rtsi byin pa yin no/ / byang chub sems dpa' ⑩byams pa'i stobs su ⑫skyes pa'i rabs te brgyad pa'o// //byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni sems can phal pa rnams kyis rjes su yi rang ba tsam yang lags ⑫par mi nus na kun tu spyad pa lta ga la nus/ de yang 'di skad thos te/ dbang po thul ba goms par gyur pa dang ⑨ / dpa' ba dang / tshul dang dul ba phun sum tshogs pas rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal thob pa/rgan pa la bsnyen bkur nges par byas pas rig byed gsum dang brtag pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid khong du chud pa rang pya gi 'khor rang gi chos dang las la 'bad pa/94—71

yid de'i rgyu med pas ma gyur zhig spyibade bar 'tsho ba snying nye ba rnams kyis bka' khrims bzang po bsgrags pa/ so tshis byas pa 3legs par 'byor pa/ yul shi bi pa rnams kyi rgyal po kun tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba zhig byung ngo / /yon tan ldan pas mi yi ④bdag po'i dpal/ /rigs ldan chung ma bzhin du snying nye ba/ /ri phug seng ges bsrungs pa'i ri dwags bzhin/ /sa yi bdag po gzhan rnams glags mi lta/ /dka' thub rnams dang rigs dang sgyu rtsal la/ /nang ⑤gi 'khor gyis goms par byas pa rnams/ /'ongs nas ⑤rim gro lhag par che bar 'gyur⑥—/ /bkur ste byas pa spu gtso bo yin par snang / /dar khrurgyal srid thob ma thag tu de'i bu thams cad sgol ⑨zhes bya ba yon tan mang po rab ⑩tu grags pa cig rgyal tshab tu gyur te/ de'i tshe ⑫rgyal tshab de bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid yin no/ /gzhon yang rgan pa'i nye bar zhi la dga'/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing des pa'i ngang / /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /dpal dang ldan zhing 'byor yang dregs pa med/ /de yi grags pas 'jig rten gsum khyab pas/ /phyogs rnams rab tu rgya chen mthong gyur kyang / /gzhan gyi grags pa cung zad yod pa rnams/ /'phro ba'i skabs kyang med pa bzhin du 'gyurarmyeshe / /skye bo rnams kyi tresdug bsngal dpag med ⑫pa/ /de yis ⑫ ma bzod snying rje'i gzhu dag ⑩dang / /sbyin pa'i mda' rnams char bzhin 'be+ebs pa yis/ /de dang lhan cig g.yul chen 'gyed pa 'dra/ /de nyin re bzhin ⑩slong ba lhags pa rnams la bslongs d+kupa bas kyang lhag par nyon ma ⑫mongs par nar 'u gtong zhing tshig 'jam po dang gus pa dang yid du 'ong bas rab tu tshim par byed par gyur to/ /dus mtshams kyi nyi ma dag la yang gso sbyong ⑫nges par 94—72

gnas pa dang / rab tu zhi bas brgyan te/ mgo khrus byas te ①gos dkar po bgos nas glang po che'i mchog gangs ri 'dra ba/ dregs pa dngul gyis gdong ⑤brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid dang / dul ba dang / mgyogs pa dang / snying stobs che ba phun sum tshogs pa/ grags pa bzhon par 'os pa'i spos kyi chaglang po che mchog zhon nas/ grong khyer gyi kho ra khor yug na bdag gis sbyin pa btang ba'i ④khang pa skye bo phongs pa rnams kyi rdzing bu dang 'dra ba bshams te bzhag pa rnams nyul du song ngo / /dga' ba'i khyad par 'di lta bu dag ⑤thob par gyur te/ phongs pa rnams la sbyin 'dod pa'i/ /dga' ba gang dag skye ba ni—/ /khyim na gnas pa'i longs spyod la/ /de tsam du ni dga' ba med/ /de nas re zhig cig de de ltar sbyin pa la ⑥ rab tu dga' ba'i slong mo pa ⑦ rnams kyis kun tu bsgrags pa thos nas/ de'i tshe nyi 'og gi rgyal po gzhan cig gis bsams pa/ 'di ni sbyin pa la dga' ba'i dbang du gyur pas bslu bar nus so snyam nas/ glang po che'i mchog song rnguba'i phyir der bram ze ⑨cig btang ngo / /de nas thams cad sgol rang gis sbyin btang ⑩gi khang pa nyul zhing rab tu dga' bas bzhin gyi ⑪mdangs bzang po dang ldan pa ⑫la/ bram ze de dag gis rgyal ba dang shis pa brjod nas lag pa g.yas pa bsgreng ste bstod nas mdun du sdod ⑫pa dang / des glang po che'i mchog de ④bzung nas zhe sa dang bcas pas spyoci bzhed gsungs shig ces ci'i phyir lhags pa dris so/ /bram ze rnams kyis smras pa—/ khyod ni sbyin la dga' ⑩ba dang / /byed kyi glang po chen po 'di/ /'gros bzang 'gying zhing 'gro ba yi/ /yon tan 'tshal phyir bdag cag mchis/ /ti se'i gangs dang 'dra ba yi/ /glang chen 'di ni pa ba yis/ /'jig rten 94—73

'di dag ya mtshan gyis/ /'di ①ni rab tu dga' bar ⑤mdzod/ /ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' snying dga' bas kun tu rgyas par gyur nas/yun ring mo zhig nas gdod slong 1mo pa'i skye bo rlabs cher slong phod pa mthong bar gyur to snyam du bsam mo④/ /bram ze 'di dag la ni glang po che'i rgyal po 'di lta bu ni ⑤ cang mi dgos kyi/ gdon mi za bar 'di ni brkam pa dang /phrag dog gi skyon gyis bdag la duyid dkrugs pa'i rgyal po ⑦'dod chen cig gis ⑤ sbyar te btang ngo snyam du nges so/ /grags dang chos la'ang ma bltas par//nga la phan bzhin gang byed pa/ /rgyal po de yi bsams pa dag /re thag chad par mi bya'o/ /de ltar nges par byas nas/ bdag nyid chen po de glang po che'i mchog de las myur du babs te bzhes su gsol zhes byas ⑨nas gser gyi ril ba gtad 8de/ de dag gi mdun na ⑫'dug go/ /nor bsgrub ⑫ngor ni chos lam mi mthun pa'i/ /rgyal bo ⑫ gtsug lag dag la mkhas gyur kyang / /chos la dga' bas de nas glang chen byin/ /tshul dang dga' ⑫bas de ni g.yos ma gyur/ /glang chen gser gyi dra bas mdzes par ⑫legs brgyan pa/ /ston ka'i sprin tshogs glog 'gyu 'dra ba de byin nas/ /mi yi bdag ⑫po'i sras de ⑫rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /tshul gyi phyogs la dga' ba'i ⑫grong khyer pa rnams 'khrug⑪ /de nas glang po che'i rgyal po de byen pa thos nas yul shi bi pa'i ⑩bram ze rgan po dang blon po bka' la gtogs pa dang / dmag mi dang grong khyer gyi gtso bo rnams ca co'i sgra phyung nas/ rgyal po kun tu rgyal gyi spyodrung du lhags nasashirtab rtab por gyur nas mi bzod cing sdangs te ⑫zhes btang nas ko ④long du smras pa/ lha rgyal srid kyi ⑫dpal 'di ltar mchog tu gyur pa ⑩yal bar dor ba 94—74

ni ①ci lags/ lha nyid kyi rgyal srid 'di ltar nyams par gyur pa bzod par mdzad pa ②mi rigs so/ /rgyal pos rings rings skad du 'di ci nyes zhes smras pa dang / yang smras pa/ ci lha mi mkhyen tam/ gang gi 'gram pa bud pa sgra sgogs pa/ /dngul ④gyi dri zhim rlung gis reg pa yi④/ /gzhan gyi glang po stsos shing dregs ⑤pa rnams/ /stsal ⑥ba'i sdug bsngal med par zil gnon pa/ /gang gi gzi yis khyod kyi dgra bo rnams/ /mthu stobs mnan zhing drags pa med byas pa/ /thams cad sgol gyis glang po de byin pas⑦/ /khyod kyi rgyal ba gzugs can gzhan yul song / /ba dan ⑧gser dang gos dang bza' ba dag/rgyal pos ⑨bram ze rnams la sbyin par 'os/ /gang la dpal dang rgyal ba nges yod pa'i/ /glang chen btang ba sbyin pa ⑪dpa' ches so/ /tshul dang 'gal ba'i lam du song ba 'dis⑪/ /rgyal po'i dpal ni ji ltar 'gro zhes ⑫ 'gyur/ /'di ni yal bar dor ba ⑫khyod la gnod/ /khyod kyi dgra ni mdun na dga' ⑫bar byed/ /de skad thos nas rgyal po ⑩bu la byams pas de dag nyid la cung zad cig ⑫mi dga' bar gyur nas/ dgos pa'i dbang gis mi dga' ⑩bzhin du de ltar bya'o spyosmras nas/ yul shi bi pa'i mi ⑪ rnams la yid bzhos te smras pa/thams cad sgol 'di sbyin pa la zhugs shing / tshul gyi rim pa la mi lta ba ngas shes te/ rgyal srid la dbang byed du bcug pa ni de ltar spang bar bya ba ⑩mi rigs mod⑪/ 'dis kyang rang gi glang po che byen zin pas/ skyugs pa dang 'dra bar bor ba lta bu cig be+er ④'phrog /'on kyang 3'di ci nas ④sbyin pa la tshod shes par bya yis khyed de ltar 'khrug ⑫par ma byed cig /shi bi pa rnams kyis smras pa/ rgyal po chen po thams cad sgol 'di ni don de ⑩lta bu dag la 94—75

gtams pa tsam kyis dam bca' bzlog tu ①btub pa ma lags so/ /kun tu rgyal bas smras pa/ 'o na de la ngas gzhan sdeci zhig bya/ /nyes pa spyod la gang zhig rab rjudaga' zhing / /yon tan brtan ④la skyon du bzung ngam ci/ /glang po de yi phyir ni bdag gi bu/ /bsad dam 'on te bzung ngam ④ci zhig bya/ /de bas na khyed rnams bu'adi la rngam zhing 'khrug par ⑦ma byed cig⑧ /ngas thams cad sgol la ⑨'di lta bu dag byed du mi 'jug ⑩go/ /de nas yul shi bi pa rnams khros nas rgyal po la smras pa/ mi yi bdag ⑪po khyod kyi sras 'di ⑫la/ /bsad dam bcing ngam brdeg par su zhig 'tshal/ /chos la zhen pa ⑫snying rje'i bdag nyid pas/ /'dis ni rgyal srid bzung ba yongs ④mi nus/ /'khor gsum brten zhing gzi brjid che ba ⑩la/ /grags pa thob pa ⑫seng ge'i khri la 'os / /tshul la mi lta chos la rab dga' bas⑩/ /'di ni dka' thub nags na gnas par 'os/ /sa yi bdag po rnams kyi tshul nyes skyon/ /de la brten pa rnams la 'byung mod kyi/ /'on kyang de dag bcos su rung ma ⑫ mchis sa bdag gtso bo nyams na bcos ⑪ mi rung / /'di la mang du gsol yang ci 'tshal te / /khyod kyi srid nyams mi bzod shi bi pa/ /'di rnams kyis ni 'di ltar nges par bcad/ /mi rje'i ⑥ sras 'di dka' thub 'phel ba'i phyir/ /thub stsopas bstan 3pa'i ri bo 'bang ④kar btang / /tshul ma yin par ④nyams su dogs shing phan par dga' ba'i skye bo de dag gis ngo bzlog sgem phod par smras pa dang / de nas rgyal po de bu dang bral ba'i ⑩sems gdungs pas ngo tsha ba ⑦bzhin du/ mgo smad de nyam nga nga ltar shugs nar se byung ⑤nas/ byams shing spobs pa dang / yid gcugs pa'i dbang gis yul shi bi pa rnams la smras 94—76

pa / khyed de ltar 'di la gal gyis 'chu na re zhig nyin zhag gcig tsam cig spro srings shig dang / ①sang nang par khyed kyis bsams pa bzhin du thams cad sgol byed du bcug ①go/ /yul shi bi pa rnams kyis de ltar bgyi'o zhes smras ①nas / bsgo ba nyan ④pa dang / rgyal po des gsol ka ba la khyod song la 'di ltar gyur pa thams cad sgol la sbon cig ces bka' sprul to/ /des kyang de bzhin du bgyi'o ⑤zhes mnyan nas/ mya ngan gyi mchi mas gdong khebs shing /thams cad sgol rang gi khang pa na 'dug pa de'i hūṃdrung du song ste/ mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal gyis shugs kyi ⑦skad phyung ste ngus nas/ de'i rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo⑧/ /thams cad sgol gyis rtab rtab kyeltar/ e ma kyergyal po thugs bde 'am zhes dris pa dang / mi dga' bas kyetshig mi gsal bar de la rgyal po ⑫thugs bde zhes smras so/ /'o na ci'i phyir de ltar mi brtan par gyur zhes thams cad sgol gyis yang spyoyang dris pas 6/ gsol ka ba mchi mas brnangs shing skad 'jor ⑫ la dbugs kyis brnangs pa'i tshig mi gsal bas/ gcom chung ngus smras pa/ shi bi pa rnams mi srun pa/ /'khrugs 17par gyur nas rgyal po'i bka' / /'jam por stsal yang ⑫mi nyan par/ /rgyal po khyod ni yul nas 'byin—/ /thams cad sgol gyis smras pa/ yul shi be+e pa rnams ci'i phyir 'khrugs ⑫nas nga skrad⑪ / 'dul dang 'gal ba'i lam mi 'gro/ /bag med pa la du nga mi dga'/ /nyes par byas pa ma mthong na/ /shi bi pa rnams ci phyir 'khrugaspyo /gsol ka pas smras pa/ ha cang rlabs ches pas len ⑫no/ /khyod ni chags pa med la dga' bar gyur 3/ /slong ba rnams kyi yid ni chags la dga'—/ /glang po'i rgyal po khyod kyis byin pa'i phyir/ /shi bi pa rnams dzuste94—77

'khrugs nas bstan pa nyams/ /de bas rang gi chos bor te/ /khyod la tsham tshom med par ni/ /gang du sgyugs kyang mi dang bsadhi/ /lam der khyod kyang song zhes zer/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' snying brtse ba ①la goms pa ④shas che ba dang / gzhung lugs buskye bo slong ba rnams ⑤la byams pa dang /rang gi bstan pa phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir smras pa/ yul shi bi pa rnams ni mi brtan pa'i rang bzhin can yin te/ ngas durang bzhin mi shes pa ltar byed mod/'jig rten don du nga yi lus ⑦'dzin na/ /phyi rol nor lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos—/ /rang gi mig dang mgo yang ngas sbyin na/ /phyi rol nor sbyin smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /slong ba rnams kyi slong ④ba'i tshig rnams la/ /rang gi lus kyang gtong bar sems pa la/ /skrag par byas nas mi sbyin sems snyam ⑪pa//byis pa rang gi rang bzhin ston pa ⑩zad/ /shi bi pa rnams thams cad kyis/ /nga ni bsad dam sgyugs kyang rung / /mi sbyin pa ni ngas ⑪mi byed/ /dka' thub tshal du 'gro /hu)zad mod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i btsun mos spyogatam ngan de thos nas bzhin 'gyur ba la/ yul ④shi bi pa rnams kyis 'dir ji ltar nges par byas pa khyod kyis thos sam/ nga las khyod kyis ⑫ci thob dang / /gang yang khyod kyi pha ma yi⑪/ /nor rnams cung zad ci yod pa/ /de dag khyod kyis gter du sbos/ /ma ⑫dris smras pa/ lha 'di dag gar gter du sba bar bgyiske/ thams cad sgrol gyis smras pa/ rtag ⑫par tshul khrims ldan pa la/ /sbyin pa bkur stes brgyan pa sbyin⑪/ /nor rnams de ltar gter bcug pa/ /rjes su 'gro zhing phrog 0 tu med/ /gyos sgyug gnyis kyang smyodaga' bar byos/ /⑫chos la gcig tu bag yod byos/ /nga med mya ngan ma byed cig /ma ⑫dris de 94—78

thos nas snying rab tu gdungs nas①/ khyim thab mi dga' ba spang ba'i phyir mya ngan dang mi dga' ba btang ste smras pa/ rgyal po chen po nyag gcig pu/ /nags su gshegs pa'i ②chos ma mchis/ /rgyal rigs gang du gshegs pa der/ /bdag kyang de bas mchi bar 'tshal/ / khyod spangs nas ni yongs bskor te/ /gnas kyang bdag nyid nges par mchi/ /dul ba byed gang gson pa der/ /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal med par 'gyur/ /lku lha bdag ④ni nags ⑤na gnas pa mi bde bar ma mthong lags so/ /ci'i phyir ⑥ zhe na/ mi srun mi med shing dang chu mang bskyed⑦/ /bya rnams sna tshogs sgra 'byin ri dwags mang / /de'u gseng sngon po yid 'ong bai ḍūr 'dra/ /skyed mos tshal bas dka' thub nags tshal dgyes—/ /lha gzhan yang 1/ nags tshal lcug ma'i khrod dag na/ /gzhon nu 'di gnyis phreng ba yis/ /brgyan cing brtse ⑨ba gzigs na ni/ /rgyal srid dag kyang dgos ⑩mi 'gyur/ /dus kyi dbang gis gyur pa yi⑫/ /nags tshal mdzes pa gsar ⑫pa dang / /sman ljongs 'bab chur bcas pa yi/ /nags tshal dag na dgyes par 'gyur/ /dga' bas 'tshal snyeba'i bya rnams ni⑫/ /sna tshogs sgra 'byin sel snyan bzhin/ /'dod chags bde ⑫ba'i slob dpon byis//bstan pa'i rma bya gar yang bgyid/ /bung ba'i na chung glu len pa/ /rab tu snyan cing ma smad pa⑩/ /nags tshal dag na glu gar gyis/ /khyod kyi thugs ni dgyes par bgyid/ /nags tshal dag na mtshan mo ⑫zla 'od ni/ /ras dkar bzang pos g.yogs pa'i rdo leb dang / /me tog shing gi dri zhim bsgos pa yi/ /nags tshal ser bu'i ⑫ bsel yab g.yob ⑫par barmid/ /'bab chu'i na chung du gor mas bskyod pa yi⑥/ /chab sgra snyan pa lhang lhang sgra sgrogs pa/ /rgyan gye 94—79

sgra rnams sel khrol mchis pa ①bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs ni rab tu dgyes par bgyid / /de de ltar btsun mo gnang chen gyis ② yid bzhos pa dang / nags su bye'agro ba la sems spro bar gyur nas/ skye bo slong mo pa rnams la bltas te/sbyin pa chen po sbyin pa la zhugs so/ /de nas thams cad sgol de ltar btang bar gyur pa thos nas/ rgyal po'i pho brang na ngud mo'i sgra chen po byung bar gyur to//skye bo slong ⑦mo pa rnams kyang mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i shugs kyis brgyal ba bzhin du gyur zhing / smyo bla can du gyur pa bzhin du smre sngags rnam pa mang po 'don par gyur to/ /'bras bu zhim po yod pa'i grib shing dag /bcad pa'i phyir ni sta re 'ugazas pa rnams/ /'dzin pa'i sa ni ngo mtshar ma gyur pa/ /'di ni sems dpa' ⑥ med par gsal bar mngon/ /chu gtsang zhim ⑦ po bsel bas gang ba yi/ /rdzing bu 'dra ba dag khya kyang mi 'gog na/ /'jig rten skyong rnams ming ni don med gyur/ /grags pas ⑨zad dam gal te gud du song ⑫/ /gang na rgyal po thams cad sgol/ /rang gi srid las phyung bas ⑪na/ /kye ma'o chos min gnyid ma log /chos ni gnyid log yang na shi/ /bdag cag phongs pa slong mo pa/ /nyes pa cung zad med pa la/ /srog la rgol ba mi srun pa/ /de las phung byed mkhas pa med/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas ⑫nor bu rin po che dang / gser ḍa/) dngul gyis gang ba'i mdzod 'bum phrag du ma dang /nor dang 'bru mang por tusteldan pa'i bang mdzod rnams dang / bran pho ⑫ dang /bran mo dang / theg pa dang / bzhon pa dang / gos dang yo byad la sogs ⑩thams cad phongs pa ⑫rnams la ji ltar rigs pa spyobyin te/ pha ma mya ngan gyi sdug bsngal gyis brtan pa zil gyis gnon pa'i ⑪rkang pa gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas/94—80

bu dang chung mar bcas te shing rta'i mchog la zhon nas/ bsod nams kyi nyin bar gyi sgra bzhin du skye bo mang po cho nge ①'don pa'i sgra sgogs shing / grong khyer chen po ④mchog gi nang nas phyir byung ste/ /rjes su chags pa'i dbang gis rjes su 'brang ba'i skye bo mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i mchi ma la ①gdong g.yogs pa rnams nan gyis slar bzlog ste bkye nas/ bdag nyid kyis srab skyogs bzung ste/ri bo ④'bang ka la ga la rjob der song ngo / /grong khyer gyi mchog gi nye kor ba 'uskyed mos tshal bzang po yid du 'ong ba dang ra ba 'das nas kyang / yid la 'khrugs pa med pa ④mthar gyis grib shing nyung zhing skye bo mang po 'du dāba'i rgyun chad pa/ ri dwags mang po ⑨rgyu ba/ phyogs gsal bar snang ba/ tshad pas ⑩byi'u tsa tsa' sgra grag ⑪pa'i dgon pa cig tu phyin to/ /de nas bram ze 'khyams pa dag cig gis de la shing rta 'dren pa'i rta bslangs so/ /dpag tshad du ma'i lam du de lus pa⑫/ /bu smad bcas shing grogs ni med gyur kyang / /sbyin la dga' bas phyi rjes mi lta bar/ /bram ze rnams la rta bzhi byin par gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid kyis shing rta drangs par brtsams ⑫nas legs par chas pa dang / gnod sbyin gzhon nu bzhi ri dwags dmar bo'i gzugs su bsgyur nas rta bzang po rab tu dul ba bzhin du bdag nyid kyi ⑩shing rta'i gnya' shing gnya' bar thogs par gyur to/ /de mthong ba dang ma dris ⑫dga' zhing ngo mtshar du gyur pas mig bgrad pa la byang chub sems dpas smras pashigang na 'di ltar glo bur 'ongs pa la/ /byams pa'i rtsa zug ri dwags mchog 'khod nags/ /dka' thub can gyi nags ⑫bcas bkur ba yi/ /mthu chen khyad par 'phags pa 'di la ltos/ /ma ⑫dris smras pa/ dam pa rnams kyi yon 94—81

tan dang ① / /rab tu goms kyang mi 'dra bas/ /bdag gis bsams na mthu chen 'di/ /rgyal po khyod kyi bulags pa snyam/ /mtsho yi nang na skar ma'i gzugs brnyan rnams/ /ku mud rgyas pa dulhag par mdzes gyur pa/ /zla ba'i 'od zer ltad mo lta ba bzhin/ /'dir mchis pa rnams rgyur gyur lags pa snyam// 'di ltar de dang ④de dag phan tshun rjes su mthun pas gcig la gcig snyan par smra zhing lam du zhugs te dong ba las/ bram ze cig byung ⑤nas byang chub sems dpa' la shing rta bslangs so/ /slong la dga' bas snyan ⑪gyur pa/ /bdag gis nor ྅la ma chags des/ /shing rta byin pas bram ze de⑧/ /re ba yongs su rdzogs par byas/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' yid dga' bzhin du/bdag dang lngabu smad shing rta las babs te⑪/ shing rta'i mchog bram ze la byen nas / gzhon nu dra ba can pang du thogs te rkang pas lam du zhugs so/ /ma ⑪dri yang yid la mi dga' ba med par gzhon nu ma kṛṣ+ṭa ⑫'dzin pang du thogs te de dang 'grogs te song ngo / /ljon pa'i shing rnams 'bras bu bzang po yispyo rtse mo btud nas mgron du gnyer ba bzhin/ /bsod nams mthu yis mngon du lta byed cing / /slob ma dul ba phyag kyang 'tshal ba 'dra/ /gang du chu 'dod gyur pa de dag tu/ /ngang pa'i ④dpung mgos pad+ma bskyod ⑫pa yi/ /ze ba lhags pas ser po ⑪gsal gyur pa'i/ /mtsho rnams de la rab tu byung bar gyur/ /sprin rnams kyis kyang bla re bzang po byes/ /ser bu bde ba'i ⑩dri zhim ngad kyang ldang / /ngal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba mi bzod pas/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis de yi lam yang bstungs/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' skyed mos tshal gyi nang du 15'gro ba bzhin du chos la ⑨ dga' ba'i bde ba rjes su myong zhing / lam gyis 94—82

dub pa'i sdug bsngal ma stsong bar bu smad dang bcas te phyin nas/ 'bang ka'i ri mthong bar gyur te/ /de na ①yang me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo mas brgyan pa'i shing ljon pa snum snum ltar 'dug pa 1 du mas gang ba/ bya mang po 'dod pas myos shing / dga' ba'i sgra 'byin cing ①/ rma bya mang po gar byed pas mdzes par gyur pa/ ri dwags kyi rigs du ma rgyu ba mtsho chu sngon po gtsang mas ched du bskor ba ltar 'dug pa/ me tog gi dris bsgos pa'i ser bu'i ngad ldang ba'i dka' thub kyi nags tshal du/ nags tshal na rgyu ba rnams kyis lam mtshon te zhugs pa dang / de ④yang brgya byin gyis bka' stsal te/las sna tshogs byed pa nyid kyis byas pa/ shing lo'i khang pa mthong na yid du 'ong ba/dhi dus thams cad du bde ba de lta bu zhig na ⑥gnas bcas te 'dug go//nags tshal de na chung ma 'dug dze+epas bkur ste byas/ /bdag gis kyebyis pa'i snyan ngag ma bsgrib ⑨snyan pa nyan/ /skyed mos tshal na 'dug bzhin rgyal srid bsam pa med/ /lo phyed lhag tsam de ni dka' thub spyod par gyur/ /de nas ⑫rgyal po'i btsun mos ⑪rtsa ba dang / 'bras bu tshol du song ba'i 'og tu byis pa gnyis skyong tra)ba'i phyir rgyal po bu dang rkyu5 gnas bsrung zhing 'dug pa na/bram ze lam gyi rdul gyis rkang pa dang byin pa rtsub rtsub ltar 'dug pa/ shin tu ngal ba ④bzhin mdog dang mig rtsa nyams pa/ ril ba spyi blugs dbyug pa la btags pa phrag par ⑫thogs pa/ chung mas g.yog khrid la ⑩shog cig par ched cher sbran pa cig ⑩phyogs der 'ongs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ⑫yun ring mo cig nas slong mo tukye pa 'ongs pa ⑪mthong nas yid rab tu dang bas mig dang bzhin gyi mdangs rab tu gsal bar gyur nas bsus te 094—83

'ongs pa legs so zhes bya ba la sogs pa tshig snyan pa brjod de/ dka' thub kyi nags kyi nang du ①bzhag nas/ glo bur du 'ongs pa la bkur ste ①byas te/ci'i phyir 'ongs pa dris so/ /de nas bram ze de chung ma la byams pas brten ④pa dang ngo tsha ba bor zhing slong ④ba 'ba' zhig tu chas pas don 'di ltar ⑤smras so/ /gang na snang zhing mnyam ⑥pa'i lam yod pas⑦ / /'jig rten 'di dag der dong dunyam ngar min/ /'gro ba 'di ni ⑨phal cher ser snas bsgribs/ /bdag gis gzhan du slong ⑪ba'i tshig mi phyin/ /sbyin la dpa' ba'i grags dang dpal dag gis/ /mthar byung ⑪ma lus khyod kyis mthar phyin pas/ /de phyir bdag ni slong mo bgyid par gyur/ /de bas sras gnyis bdag la g.yog tu ⑫stsol/ /de skad ⑫smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ④sbyin pa la dga' bas goms par ⑫byas shing / slar bzlog pa ni ma bslabs pas/ /rab tu sdug pa'i bu gnyis kyang / /tsham tshom med par sbyin zhes smras/ /bde legs su gyur cig /da 'di na mchis te ci bgyis 6nyezhes bram zes smras pa⑩/bu gnyis kyis sbyin 8pa'i gtam thos nas skrag pas ⑪mig rig rig por gyur pa la/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa'i shugs kyis snying gdungs par gyur te pya smras pa/ khyod la 'di gnyis ngas byin na/ /'di gnyis ma ni nags tshal du/ /rtsa ba 'bras bu tshol 0du song / /de yang de ring 'dir 'ong gis / /'dir yang ⑫zhag gcig ngal sos bu la/ /de dang 'phrad nas gtam byas pa 'u/ /rgyan gyis brgyan cing phreng ba can/ /nga yi bu gnyis sang khrid cig /bram zes smras pa/ khyod 'di la dus kyi ⑪'chu ba 'di thong cig /bud med rnams ni mi drang bas/ /ming ni g.yo ⑫can zhes su btags/ /khyod 94—84

kyi sbyin la gegs byed kyis①/ /de bas bdag ni 'dug mi 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ sbyin pa'i gegs su 'gyur du ④ma dogs shig /de ni nga yi chos spyod pa'i grogs yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang 'di la khyod ci dgar zad mod①—/ gzhan yang bram ze chen po/ rab tu gzhon zhing byis pa gnyis④/ /g.yog gi bya ba mi mkhas pas/ /'di gnyis khyod kyi bran byed kyang / /ji lta bur na mgu bar 'gyur/ /shi bi'i rgyal po nga yi yab/ /'di gnyis 'di ltar gyur mthong nas⑤/ /'di gnyis bslu ba'i nor dag ni/ /ci 'dod khrod la nges par ster/ /de bas de yi yul du ni/ /'di gnyis khrid na legs par 'gyurarjo—/ /de ltar byas na nor chen dang / /chos rnams dang yang ldan par 'gyurasti—/ /bram zes smras pa/ bdag ni rgyal po sbrul gdug pa dang 'dra ba'i drung du mi dga' ba ④skyes 'tshal te mchi ba'i rngo mi thogs so⑨/ /rgyal pos bdag gi ⑩'di gnyis 'phrog /yang na chad pas gcod kyang srid/ /de bas 'di gnyis bram ze chen mo yi⑪/ /g.yog tu bdag gis ⑫khrid de mchi/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas don yongs su ma rdzogs par 'o na ci dgar zad ces smras nas/ bu gnyis la ⑫chags pa dang bcas par g.yog legs par byos shig ces gdams ④nas len du gzhug pa'i phyir/ bram ze'i lag pa brkyang pa lasasnye/ril ba spyi blugs gtad ⑩do/ /de yis bsgrims pa'i mthu dag gis/ /ril ba las ni chu byung nas⑩/ /mig ni pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra las⑫/ /ma bsgrim ⑪par yang mchi ma byung / /de nas bram ze de brkam pas ha cang yang dga' ches nas/rtabs ⑦pa dang bcas pa'i yid kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i bu 'phrog par rings nas⑥shis par brjod pa'i tshig mdor smras pa ⑫/ tshig drag po rtsub mos 394—85

phyir byung zhes smras nas/ gzhon nu gnyis dka' thub kyi nags nas phyir phyung ngo / /de nas gzhon nu gnyis pha ma dang ①bral ba'i sdug bsngal gyis snying gdungs pas/ pha la phyag 'tshal nas/ mig mchi mas gang bzhin du smras pa/yab gcig yum yang ④slad rol byung / /khyod kyis ①bdag cag gtong bubar bzhed—/ / ma dang ma 'jal bar du gzhes/ /⑤de nas bdag cag khyod kyis byed / /de nas bram ze des bsams pa/ 'di gnyis kyi dum yang de ring ⑦tshur 'ong la/ 'di yang bu la byams pas/ 'gyod pa skye yang srid do ⑧snyam nas / pad+ma'i bam po bcings pa bzhin du de gnyis kyi lag pa lcug mas bcings pa dang / de gnyis gcig la gcig 'khri zhing / pha la bzhin slar phyogs te/ lta ba rab tu gzhon pa'i gzhon nu gzhon sha can gnyis bsdigs shing khrid do/ /de nas gzhon nu ma kṛṣ+ṭa ⑨'dzin sdug bsngal dang ⑩ po myong ba des skad phyung ste ngu zhing pha la smras pa/ pha ⑪gcig bdag la bram ze 'dis⑫/ /brtse ba med par lcug mas bkyigs⑫/ /bram ze chos dang ldan zhes gda'/ /'di ni bram ze ma lags nges/ /gnod sbyin bram zer bsgyur nas ni/ /nges par za ⑫ba'i phyir khrid do/ /sha zas bdag cag khrid gyur na/ /yab kyis ci ⑫phyir yal bar bor⑫/ /de nas gzhon nu dra ba can gyis ⑩smre sngags 'don cing smras pa/ bram zes ⑫bdag la brdeg pa yi⑩/ /de tsam snyug bsngal mi che yi /de ring yum dang ma 'jal ⑨ ba/ /de yis bdag snying gas ⑫pa bzhin/ /dka' thub nags tshal stong pa na/ /yum ni yun ring nges par bshum⑫/ /bron mongs bu yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /byi'u phrug bsad pa'i ma ma ⑫bzhin/ /bdag cag phyir ni nags tshal nas/ /rtsa ba shing thog mang po rnams/ /bsnams 94—86

te byon nas gnas stong 'dir①/ /gzigs nas yum ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /yab gcig chibs ②rta 'di rnams dang / /glang chen shing rta gang mchis las/ /phyed tsam yum la phul na ni/ /de yi thugs ngal rjuchung yang srid/ /'phrin thugyis yum la phyag 'tshal zhing / /thugs ngal ⑤ mdzad las bzlog tu gsol/ /yab gcig khyod dang yum de yi/ /zhal ni mthong ba ⑥rab tu dka'/ /kṛṇ+ḍa ⑦tshur shog bdag cag 'dong / /bram ze'i ④bran g.yog 'dod pa la/ /yab kyis bdag cag byen zin gyis/ /bdag cag gson yang ci zhig rung / /de nas byang chub sems dpas bus ⑨ smre sngags bton ⑨ pa snying rje rje skad zer ba de'i 4〉blo rab tu bskyed tusrekyang byin zin pas da 'gyod kyang ci phan snyam nas/mya ngan gyi me bzlog dka' bas/ snying brtse ste ⑫ dug langs nas rngubargyal ba bzhin du sems blong blong por gyur nas de nyid du 'dug go/ /ser bu bsel ba'i rlung yab kyis 'du shes slar rnyed pa dang / sgra ci yang mi grag cing bu mi 'khor ba'i ⑫gnas mthong nas/ mgrin pa dbugs kyis ⑩brnangs bzhin du rang la rang gis smras pa/ nga yi snying bu gces ⑩pa la/ /'dzem dogs med par mngon sum du/ /mtshon gyis 'debs pa ci ltar na/ /bram ze ngan pa ngo mi tsha/ /lham yang med par rkang gis dong / /rab tu gzhon pas ngal mi bzod—/ /ji ltar lam du zhugs te dong / /ji 'u ltar de yi bran g.yog byed/ /lam du ⑩ngal zhing dub pa la/ /su zhig de ring ngal bsor du 'jug /bkres skom sdug bsngal nyen pa gnyis/ /slong stsoba'i gnas kyang su zhig yod/ /bdag ni brtan par byed 'dod kyang / /'di lta bu ④ni sdug bsngal na/ /nga'i bu bde bar skyes ⑦pa gnyis/ /gnas skabs ji ltar 'gyur zhing ④'khod/ /94—87

kye hūṃma'o bu dang bral ba yi/ /sdug bsngal mes ni bdag sems bsregs/ /dam pa rnams ni chos dudran nas/ /su zhig rjes su 'khyed pa ①byed/ /de nas ma dris ④mi dga' ba byung ⑤ ba'i ltas ngan pa rnams kyis yid mi dga' bar gyur bzhin du rtsa ba dang 'bras bu khyer te rab tu myur bar 'ong bar ⑥'dod kyang gcan gzan khro bo rnams kyis lam chod pas rings shig dze+elon nas dka' thub kyi gnas su ④phyin nas bsur ⑨'ong ran pa'i sa dang / rtsed mo rtse ba'i sa ⑩na yang bu gnyis mi snang ba dang / rab tu mi dga' ba'i dbang du gyur to/ /ltas ngan byung nas ⑪ dogs pa skyes par gyur/ /de nas bu btsal phyir ni mig kyang blta / /yang dang ⑫yang bos bu ⑫gnyis len med pas/ /mya ngan gdung ⑩nas smre sngags 'don par gyur/ /byis pa smra ba'i sgra grag ⑫nags tshal 'di/ /sngon ni bdag la mang po tshogs bzhin snang / /de gnyis mi snang de gnyis ⑩de ring ni/ /bdag la 'brog dgon 3rtebazhin du skyabs med snang / /kye ma tu)gzhon nu de gnyis ⑫ci nyes kye/ /rtse rtse ngal nas gnyid kyis log gyur tam/ /nags tshal 'thug pya por brlag gam 'on te nyal/ /bdag 'ong phyis ⑫pas ma mgu mchis 3gyur tam/ /byis par gyur pas gang zhig gab cing 'khod/ /gal te bsad pa mthong na 3'khrugs nas ni/ /bya 'di kun kyang ci ste sgra mi 'byin / /'bab chu drag po rlabs chen 'khrug ④pa yi/ /chu yis ⑫gal te de gnyis khyer gyur tam/ /'on kyang da ni bdag gis ⑫log par rtog pa 'di ltar ma gyur cig rgyal po yab sras bde legs su gyur cig /ltas ngan mtshan ma ngan pa ston pa yang / bdag gi lus la smin par gyur cig /bdag gi snying 'di yang ltas ngan ⑦/ dga' ba ni bzlog /mi dga' ba'i mun pas ni 3khebs 94—88

nas gas pa bzhin du ①gyur tam ci/ bdag gi lus kyang lhu tshigs bral stisnyam byed / phyogs rnams kyang 'khrug ①pa snyam byed/ nags tshal 'di yang dpal nyams shing g.yo ba snyam byed par gyur to/ /de nas dka' thub kyi nags kyi nang nas ④'ongs nas rtsa ba dang 'bras bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhag ste/ zhe sa dang bcas pas ⑤khyem thab la byis pa du gnyis gar song medris so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas⑧/ ma ni bu la byams pas ⑨stobs chung ba dang / mi dga' ba'i tshig brjod par ⑩dka' bar shes nas/ de la cung zad kyang smra ma nus so/ /dga' bar bya rigs skye bo la/ /mi dga' smra ba'i mi dag gis/ /ched kar yid ni gdungs ⑩bya ba/ /snying rje can gyis rab tu dka'/ /de nas ma dris bsams pa/ 'di 'di ltar mya ngan gyis gdungs nas cang mi smra ba dang sbyar na bdag gi bu gnyis gdon mi za bar ma rung bar shā5gyur to snyam nas/dka' thub kyi nags kun tu sems kyis ⑫ brtags na bu gnyis mi snang bas mchi mas brnangs nas yang smras pa/ byis pa gnyis kyang yong mi snang / /khyod kyang bdag la cang mi gsung / /mi dgar gyur pa mi gsungs pasanyurte/ /kyi hud bdag ni spyobasad kyis med/ /de skad ces smras nas/ mya ngan kyi mes snying bsregs pas lcug ma rtsa ba nas bcad pa bzhin du 'gyel to/ /de 'gyel ma thag tu byang chub sems dpas blangs 49nas rtswa'i stan la bzhag ste/ chu grang mo ⑫btab nas slar sos ⑫ pa dang / dbugs phyung ⑪ba'i phyir smras pa/ byams pa'i yid kyis mi bzod la/ /brtan po du med du dogs pas na/ /ma ⑫dri khyod la nga yis ni/ /sdug bsngal myur du ma smras so/ /rgas shing dbul ba'i sdug bsngal kyis/ /nyen pa'i bram ze nga can byung / /de la nga yis bu gnyis byin/ /94—89

mya ngan ma byed spro bsrings khyel/ /bu la ma sems nga la ltos/ /bu yi mya ngan gdungs snying la/ /mtshon kyis 'debs pa bzhin ma byed/ /bslangs par gyur na srog dag kyang / /mi sbyin par ni ji ltar nus/ /de bas nga yi sbyin pa la / /bzang mos 1rjes su yi rang byos/ /ma dris de thos nas bu shor ladogs te snying brtse ba la④/ bu gnyis gson pa'i gtam thos nas ⑪ mya ngan chung ngur du gyur nas/ khyim thab mya ngan bsang sdeba'i phyir/ khye mchi ma phyis te/ya mtshan che bar bltas nas khyim thab la smras pa/ mang du gsol yang ci 'tshal te ngo mtshar che'o/ /'di ltar khyod kyi kyethugs la ni/ /'dzum ⑫ pa'i skabs kyang ma rnyed pa/ /lha yi sems kyang nges par ni/ /ya mtshan che ba'i dbang du gyur / /khyod kyi grags pa'i tshig bsdeb ⑪sgra grag pa/ /lha yi rnga chen brdungs pa'i sgra rnams kyi⑫/ /brag cha'i sgra yis phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /tshig 'bru gsal bas nam mkha' khyab par gyur/ /sa gzhi ri yi nu ma g.yo ba can/ /'dod chags langs pa bzhin du rab tu g.yos/ /gser gyi me tog rnams kyang mkha' la lhags/ /glog 'gyu'i 'od kyis nam mkha' gsal gyur bzhin/ /de bas thugs ngan ma mdzad par/ /stsal bas thugs ni dgyes par mdzod/ /'jig rten rnams la btung chu bzhin/ /slan chad kyang ni sbyin bdag mdzod/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin sa gzhi g.yos pas4)/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab 'gul ba dang / 'di ci yin zhes /④rtog pa skyes pa⑩/ 'jig rten skyong ba ya mtshan skyes pas mig bgrad ⑫pa rnams la ⑩sa g.yos pa'i rgyu thams cad sgol gyi sbyin pa yin par rtogs nas sems rab tu dga' bar gyur te/ de'i mtshan mo nam langs pa dang / brgya byin gyis ⑫ bram ze'i gzugs su bsgyur nas slong mo 94—90

spyod pa 'dra ba 1byas te/ thams cad sgol gyi drung du 'ongs so/ /byang chub sems dpas glo bur du byung ba ④la bkur ste byas nas/ ci 'dod ces skabs phyes pa ①dang / de la chung ma bslangs ④so/ /mtsho chen dag la chu ni mi zad bzhin/ / dam pa ⑤rnams la sbyin pa'i chos mi zad/ /de bas lha 'dra khyod la 'phags ma slong / /btsun mo 'di ni bdag la stsal bar rigs/ /byang chub sems dpa' yid mi dga' ba med pa nyid du de bzhin du bya'o zhes ⑥sbyin par byas so/ /de nas ⑦lag pa g.yon pas ma skedri bzung / / lag pa ⑨ g.yas pas ril ba spyi blugs bzung ⑩nas ni/ /de yi lag g.yas rtse la chu byung nas⑩—/ /'dod lha'i sems ni mya ngan me yis ⑫tshig /de yi rang bzhin phan sems shes nas ni/ /sems kyang ma 'khrug ⑫ngus kyang ma ngus te④/ /sngon med sdug bsngal khur gyis non gyur nas/ /de la mig tshugs lta zhing bris bzhin 'dug /lha'i dbang po brgya byin kyis de mthong nas snying la ngo mtshar rab dang ldan par 3nyegyur te/ sems dpa' chen bo de la bstod nas smras pa/ ya rabs ma rabs chos gnyis ni/ /e ma khyad par re che ste⑫/ /bdag nyid ma sbyangs pa rnams ni/ /sus kyang yid ches mi nus so/ /'dod chags bral bar ma gyur pas/ / bud med ⑩rab tu sdug ⑫pa dag /de ltar ma chags sbyin byed pa—/ /'di 'dra'i rlabs chen su la yong / /khyod kyi yon tan chags pa'i gtam dag gis/ /khyod kyi grags pa phyogs su bsgrags pa ⑪nges/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis gzhan 'od zil rjomanan bzhin/ /gzhan gyi dpal grags zil gyis non par gyur/ /khyod kyi spyod pa mi las 'das/ /'di la gnod sbyin dri za dang / /ltos 'go spyosum cu rtsa gsum pa 3/ /brgya byin bcas pa yi rang 'gyur//94—91

brgya byin gyis de skad smras te/ bdag gi lus 'od gsal bar 'dug pa bstan nas / bdag ni brgya byin lags so zhes sbran ①te/ byang chub sems dpa' la smras pa/ zla ba btang ste zla 'od rnams/ /gzhan du 'gro bar ①mi rigs kyi①//khyod kyi btsun mo ma ④ dri 'di/ /khyod bdag nyid la bdag 'bul rjolo/ /brtan pa rnams ni bslangs na ster/ /seng ge'i chung ma ce spyang la/ /byin yang de yis ci zhig bya/ /de ni seng ge nyid la 'os/ /mthon po rnams dang dman pa la/ /rgyal po'i ⑥myu gu 'dra bar sems/ /de bas de yi spyod pa des/ /'jig rten rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /de bas bu dang bral ⑦bar ma sems shig /rgyal srid nyams pa'i mya ngan ma byed cig /khyod kyi yab ni tsha dbyug gnyis dang 'grogs/ /khyod kyi mgon byas yul na dze+ergyal srid byed/ /de skad ces smras nas/ brgya byin de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /brgya byin gyi mthus bram ze des kyang /du/ byang chub sems dpa'i bu gnyis yul shi bir khrid de song ngo / /de nas yul shi bi pa rnams dang / yul shi bi pa'i ⑪ rgyal po kun tu rgyal bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni ⑪shin tu bya dka' ba thos nas snying brlan par gyur te/ bram ze las byang chub sems dpa'i bu gnyis bslus ⑫nas/ thams cad sgol mgu bar byas te bsus ⑫nas rgyal srid byed du bcug go/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni shin tu rmad du byung ba yin no—/ /5de la phyogs pa'i sems can khyad par can rnams la brnyas pa'am gnod par kṛ5mi bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan bsngags pa dang /bkur ste byed ⑫de dam pa'i chos nyan ⑩pa la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /thams cad sgol du ⑫skyes pa'i rabs te dgu pa'o// //94—92

①bam po bzhi pa/ bsam pa dge ba rnams ni sdig pa byed du gzhug par bslur mi tshugs te/ de bas na bsam pa dge ba 1 bya ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /de yang ①byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar rjorang gi bsod nams kyi mthu thob pa/rgyal phran thams cad ⑤phyag 'tshal ba/ bdag dang ⑥gzhan gyi 'khor la sogs pa'i gnod pa rab tu zhi bas 'tshe ba med pa/ gdugs zla med pa/ bgo skal gyi rim pas thob ⑦pa'i sa skyong zhing 'dug go zhes grags so①/ /dbang po'i dgra ⑨thul de ni sa yi mgon/ /'bras bu smin pa spyad ⑫la ma chags shing / /dngos po kun gyis 'gro la phan byed pa/ /thub pa bzhin du chos don gcig pur kyebyed—/ /skye dgu rnams ni gtso bo'i rjes spyod par/ /'jig rten rang bzhin de yis shes gyur nas/ /skye dgu ⑫rnams ni dge la gzud par byed⑫/ /khyad par du ni chos la spyod par gyur④/ /nor yang sbyin ⑫ zhing tshul khrims spyod pa mnos—/ /bzod pa brtan ⑩cing 'gro ba'i don yang spyod⑩/ /'gro la phan sems mthong na zhi ba ⑪snang / /gzugs can chos bzhin ⑪ de ni rnam par mdzes /de nas re zhig cig de'i mthus de'i yul bskyabs kyang ma phan te/ sems can rnams kyi las kyi nyes pa dang / lha'i bu char 'be+ebs pa'i las su bskos pa rnams bag med par gyur pa'i dbang gis kha cig tu than pa byung bas 'khrug cing gnod par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po des bsams pa 'di ni bdag cag pya skye dgu rnams kyis chos legs par ma spyad pas spyolan gyis ma rung bar gyur to / /zhes blo 3nges par gyur to/ /skye dgu rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa che ba dang /de'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pas chos kyi de kho na nyid la bslab par gyur pa ⑫mdun 94—93

na 'don pa'i gtso bo bram ze rgan po rnams dang blon po rnams la de ci ltar thar pa'i ⑨thabs dris so/ /de nas de dag gis mchod sbyin gyi cho ga rig byed las byung ⑤ba/ srog chags du ma gsod pa 'jigs 'jigs skad zer ba ①byas na/char legs par 'bab par 'gyur bar bsams nas cho ga de de la gsol to/ /rgyal po des mchod sbyin las byung ④ba'i cho ga srog chags gsod pa'i rgyus ⑤shes nas / snyeng rje'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir de dag gi tshig ⑥yid la 'bab par ma gyur ④te/ 'dul ba'i 'khor ⑪ rjes su mthun par de dag la ngo bzlog ⑨phod pa'i tshig rtsub mo ⑪ ma smras par skabs gzhan dag gis ⑪de dag gi gtam de khyad du bsad do/ /de nas ⑫yang rgyal po de la chos kyi gtam bya ba'i skabs rnyed nas/ de'i bsam pa zab cing brtag dka' ba ma shes nas mchod sbyin bya ba'i gros 'debs so/ /rgyal pos bgyi bar ⑫nges pa gang lags pa/ /sa gzhi thob dang yongs su skyong ④ba ste/ /de dag khyed ni dus las 'da' mi mdzad/ /de dag go rims chos dang bde ba bzhin/ /'khor gsum brten ⑫la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /'bangs la phan phyir gnam ⑫ru bsnams pa ste/ /mchod sbyin cho ga mtho ris them skas la/ /ji ltar khrod thugs bag med dbang du gyur/ /khyod kyi bka' ni rgyal po gzhan rnams kyis/ /'di ni dngos grub mngon du grub yin zhes/ /'bangs dang 'dra bar rab tu gus nod ⑫na/ /mchod sbyin ngag gis grags 'bar legs pa dag /da ni khyod kyis mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /sbyin pa mdzad cing sdom la gnas pa yis/ /rtag par khyod ni dbang bskur lags gyur kyang / /'on kyang rig byed grags pa'i mchod sbyin gyis/ /lha yi bu lon bral bar mdzad par ⑫rigs/ /mchod sbyin legs par bgyis pas lha 94—94

mnyes na/ /char pa 'bab pas 'byung bo mgu bar bgyed/ /de bas 'bangs dang bdag la phan pa'i phyir/ /grags par gyur pa'i ①mchod sbyin cho ga mdzod//des bsams pa/ kye ma'o gzhan gyi dring la 'jog cing / blo chung la dpyod pa pyami nus pa'i ④chos tsam la dga' zhing / dad pa skye ba'i 'gro ba 'di dag ni shin tu ma legs par bstan to/ /gang yang ④/ 'jig rten dag na ⑤gang la skyabs btsal ba/ /de dag bsad dupas chos su 'gyur ba ni/ /de yis bstan pa'i skye bo lam ngan song / /ngan song mi bde dogs ④pa'i nang na 'khod/ /phyugs rnams bsad pas ④chos 'gyur zhing / /lha yi 'jig rten skye ba dang / /lha yang mnyes par 'gyur ba dag /ci lta bur na 'thad par 'gyur/ /phyugs rnams bsad pa'i sngags kyi mthus⑨/ /mtho ris 'gro phyir de bas de bsad na//chos su 'gyur zhes zer ba de yang brdzun/ /gzhan gyis byas pa rngu pha rol su zhig thob / /legs ⑫par spyod las yid ni ma bzlog cig⑫ /dge ba'i las la nges par ma byas pa'i/ /phyugs rnams mchod sbyin dag la ⑫bsad gyur kyang //bdag byas gzhi med ji ltar mtho ris skye/ /mchod sbyin la bsad mtho ris 'gro na ni/ /bram ze bdag nyid phyugs su bsgyur ⑫la rag /gang phyir tshul 'di gang na'ang mi snang bas/ /de ⑫phyir de dag tshig ni su zhig nyan/ /mtshungs med mthu bsung ro gang gzi ⑫ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i ⑪ zas mchog lha mos phul ba dag /bor nas phyugs bsad sha khrag la sogs pas/ /lha rnams mgu bar gyur pa ⑫ga la srid/ /rgyal po des da ni 'di ⑪'di ltar bya dgos so snyam du bsams nas/ mchod sbyin byed pa du la mos par ⑨'dra bar byas te/ de dag gi tshig ⑫mnyan nas/ de dag la smras pa/ khyed cag 'di ⑫ltar bdag la 94—95

phan par sems pa ni/ bdag mgon dang bcas shing phan 'dogs pa dang ldan par gyur to/ /de bas na bdag ni mi stong gi ①mchod sbyin byed 'dod kyis/ji skad du rngu bskos pa'i blon po rnams de'i yo byad sbyor du chug shig / bkod sa rtsig 3tu rung ba'i sa phyogs dang / de dang mthun pa'i tshes grangs dang /byed pa dang yud tsam dang / rgyu skar dang sbyor ba yang rtogs shig /de nas de'i ④mdun na 'don gyis smras pa/ 'dod pa'i don grub par bgyid pa'i khruslad du/ rgyal po chen po re zhig khrus mdzod cig dang mchod sbyin cig bgyis lags narka/ bdag cag rnams kyis bkod pa brtsam ⑥mo/ /cig char mi stong bzung na khyod kyi 'bangs rnams gdon mi za ④bar yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze rnams kyis kyang de mad do zhes smras so/ /rgyal po des de dag la smras pa/khyed 'bangs 'khrug par gyur rjodu ma dogs shig dang / bdag gis ci nas kyang ⑨yid 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar bya'o/ /de nas rgyal po des grong khyer gyi mi rnams bsdus nas smras pa/ ngas ⑩ni mi stong gi ⑩mchod sbyin byed 'dod na nyes pa med par mi 'dod bzhin du su yang phyugs su byar ngas mi nus kyi⑫ /de bas na de ring ⑫ phan chad khyed cag las gang dang gang tshul dang bka' khrims las 'gal bar byed cing / nga'i bka' gcog pa de dang de dag nga'i rtog chen gyi mi rngubag med pa'i gnyid kyis skem log cig⑩ /dri ma med par ⑫brtag par bya'o / /rang gi rigs la gnod pa dang yul la gnod par ⑫byed pa dag yod na / ngas phyugs kyi gor bzung ⑩bar khyed kyis shes par gyis shig /de nas de dag gi nang nas 0 gtso bo rnams kyis thal mo sbyar nas stsode la smras pa/ khyod kyi spyod pa thams cad 'bangs la phan par gzhol/ /mi rje lhas mdzad de la 94—96

brgal ①ba ga la srid/ /khyed ①kyi spyod la tshangs pa ①rjes su yi rang ngo nga /khyod ni legs par tshad ma'i nang nas tshad ma dumachog /lha gcig dgyes pa gang lags pa/ /bdag cag kun kyang de la dgyes⑥/ /'o skol dgyes shing smon ④pa las/ /dgyes par ④gud na gzhan ma mchis/ /de ltar grong khyer gyi 'bangs rnams kyis bka' pa pa mnyan pa dang / rgyal po des blon po thugs ches pa rnams skye bo mang pos mthong bar gyur pa'i duyo lang chen po dang bcas par ljongs dang grong khyer rnams su sdig pa ⑫byed pa'i mi rnams 'dzin du bkye'o/ /kho ra khor yug tu yang nyin re zhing 'di skad bsgos so⑪/ /brtan zhing gtsang ma'i ⑫tshul khrims nor ldan mi mchog la/ /rgyal po mi 'jigs sbyin pas ⑫mi 'jigs sbyin par mdzad/ /'bangs la phan phyir tshul min byed pa'i mi rnams ni//phyugs su bsgyur ba stong gis mchod sbyin mdzad par bzhed/ /de bas de ring phyin chad gang zhig tshul min rjes spyod cing / /rgyal po'i bka' lung sa skyong blon pos bkur dang 'gal byed pa/ /de ni rang gi las kyi mchod sbyin phyugs su byas gyur nas/ /mchod sdong lus btags grim shing ④skams pa skye bos mthong bar 'gyur—/ /de nas yul de na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi phyugs su bya ba'i phyir/ rgyal pos ⑩ tshul bzhin mi byed pa'i mi tshol du 'jug ⑪ pa dang /nyin re bzhin 'jigs 'jigs skad bsgo ba de thos pa dang / rgyal po'i mi rnams kyis ⑩sdig byed pa'i mi rnams bzung skyoba'i phyir/ thams cad du tshol zhing 'ong bar ⑪mthong nas/ tshul bu /ma yin par byed pa la dga' ba ni btang /tshul khrims dang sdom pa dang ⑥yang dag par blangs pa ⑫la ni 'bad/ dgrar 'dzin pa las ⑫ni phyir phyogs/ gcig la gcig dga' ba dang mgu bar ④ni 94—97

byed / 'thab pa dang rtsod pa ni rab tu zhi/ bla ma'i man ①ngag nyan cing rjes su mthun par ni byed/ bgo bsha' byed pa la ④bag tsha ba ni ①med/ glo bur du 'ongs pa la mgron byed ④pa la ni dga' zhing ⑤dul ba dang / gus par bya ba la ni 'bad par gyur te/ rdzogs ldan gyi ⑥dus bzhin du gyur to/ /shi bas 'jigs shing 'jig rten pha rol sems/ /rigs kyi ④nga rgyal grags pa bsrung 3ba dang / /bsam pa dag cing ngo tsha ⑨shes pa yis/ skye bo rang gi tshul khrims dri med brgyan/ /ji lta ji ltar skye bo chos 'bad pa/ /de lta de ltar srung ④ma khyad par du/ /tshul bzhin mi byed skye bo tshol ⑪bar gyur/ / des ni ⑫chos las su yang g.yos ma gyur/ /rang gi yul ni de ltar thos gyur ⑫nas/ /rgyal po dga' ba'i khyad par brgyan pa ni/ /dga' ba'i gtam snyan rgya cher bsgrags pa yis/ /blon po mgu bar byas nas bka' stsal pa/ /nga ni 'bangs rnams bsrung bar ④rab tu sems/ /de rnams kun kyang da ni sbyin gnas gyur/ /nga ni mchod sbyin byed 'dod ces bsams nas/ /mchod sbyin phyir ni nor rdzas bsags pa 'di/ /gang zhig bde ba bskyed pa'i nor gang 'dod⑫/ /nga yi drung nas 'di ⑫dag ci bder khyer/ /'di ltar nga yi yul ni dben spyod pa'i⑩//dbul ba ci nas yul na med par 'gyur⑫/ /'bangs rnams bsrung bar sems par ⑫ nga 'dug cing / /grogs ldan yo byad phun sum tshogs bzhin du/ /skye bo phongs byed nga ni mi bzod pa pya / /nga yi sems ni yang yang bsregs pa bzhin/ /de nas rgyal po de'i blon po rnams legs so snyam nas de'i tshig mnyan te/grong dang ljongs dang grong khyer thams cad dang lam gyi ngal bso ba'i sa spyophyogs thams cad du sbyin btang 3gi khang pa brtsigs nas/ rgyal pos ji skad bka' 94—98

sprul pa bzhin du/ nyin re zhing phongs pa rnams ci 'dod pa'i nor gyis mgu bar byas so/ /de nas skye bo de dag dbul bor te/ /sa bdag las ni mthun par nor thob ①nas/ /rnam mang gos dar rin chen ②rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dga' ston bzhin du bzang pos brgyan par gyur/ /phongs pa 1rab tu dga' nas rjobastod pa'i tshig /rgyal po'i grags pa phyogs su rgyas gyur pa/ /mtsho las rjopad+ma'i ge sar bye ma dang ⑥/ /rlabs kyis bskyod de kun tu khyab pa bzhin//de ltar rgyal po'i tshul bzang yon tan gzhis/ /skye bo ma lus legs par spyod gyur pas⑦/ /dge ba chen pos gnod pa rnams kyi mthu④/ /zil kyis mnan nas chags med zad par gyur/ /dus tshigs rnams kyang dus la 6mthun par bde—/ /rgyal po de bzhin ⑫chos la gzhol bar gyur/ /sa gzhi 'bru rnams sna tshogs skye bar gyur⑪/ /chu bzhi chu gtsang sngon po pad+mar ⑫bcas/ /'gro ba nad chen dag gis mi 'debs gyur/ /sman rnams yon tan rab tu che bar gyur//dus tshigs dbang gis ser bu'i ngad kyang ldang / /gza' hurternams lam ni bzang por rgyu bar gyur/ /gzhan gyi dmag gi 'jigs pa med par gyur/ /phan tshun gnod dang dmag gi ⑪ 'jigs pa med/ /skye bo nges par chos spyod dul gyur pas/ /rdzogs ldan dus bzhin phun sum tshogs par gyur/ /de nas rgyal pos de ltar chos kyi mchod sbyin ⑫ byas pa dang / /skye bo phongs pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal dang / gnod pa rnams ⑩ni rab tu zhi bar gyur/ sa gzhi ni skye bo rab tu dga' ba mang pos gang zhing ⑫mngon par mtho ba ①5 nyams dga' bar ni snang / 'jig rten pa rnams ni rgyal po'i shis pa rmye brjod pa 'ba' zhig kha ton du byed/ rgyal bo'i grags pas ( )ni thams cad du rgyas par gyur pa dang /94—99
