la la zhig gi gnyid kyis sor mo rnams kyi 'bad pas 'phrog pa'i lag pa las ma mchu dang rnam par 'byel pa'i bu ga dang po can du bud med kyi mig gi 'bras bu ltar sngo ba'i gling bu lhung bar gyur to/ /mche ba gnyis pa rnams kyis rnam par gnon pa'i pad+mo rnams ltar gnas skabs sna tshogs pa'i de rnams kyi gzugs mthong nas mar me rnams kyis dgod ①pa dang 'dra ba ste/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' gzhon du ②med rnams la smad pa mdzad nas mngon par bzhengs te/phyi rol du gshegs nas kyang mos pa blangs te gsungs pa/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho 'di ni kun nas rgal 'dod yid/ /dka' thub nags su 'gro phyir btson ①pa ste—/ /de phyir bdag gi nges pa bsgrub par bya ba'i phyir/ /shugs chen ngang pa bsngags ④ldan rta de khrid la ⑤shog /mos pas kyang gnas gtsang ma pa rnams kyis bskul bzhin pa rgyal po'i chad pa la gus pa ma byas par de ltar bgyi zhes bya ba slar mnyan te/ mchan khung g.yon par ral gri bzung nas/ rta'i mchog ngang pa bsngags rjoldan khrid nas 'ongs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' zhon pa'i rta de la phyis rta kha khrid pa'i mos pa dang lhan cig tu gnod sbyin rnams kyi ⑦lag pa'i mthil du rmig pa rnam par gzhag dze+epa tho rangs kyi dus su nam mkha' nas drang srong chen po a ra la'i spyil po dang nye bar 'jug cing gnas pa 'gyur sdeces pa'o/ /de nas rgyan rnams gsal ba'i rin chen gzi brjid kyis/ /gsal ba des ni sku la phog par mdzad nas ni/ /rlabs dang ldan pa khu byug mgrin pa ltar nag pa'i/ /mgo skyes rnams ni rim gyis ral gris gcad ⑩par mdzad/ /dwangasaspepa'i chu yi rten ni ut+pal gsal bar byas pa ltar/ /rgyan ni gsal ba de ni kun nas mthong ste mos pa ni/ /rab tu stobs can mya ngan bsreg ⑫blugs za 94—1393

bas kun gdungs pa/ /mu tig dang mtshungs chu thigs rnams ni btang bar gyur//byang chub sems dpas gsungs pa/ chos la mngon du phyogs pa'am skye bo dka' thub kyi nags su mngon par 'jug pa la skyes bu dam pas sdug bsngal bya bar 'os pa ma yin te/ de bas na song shig dang bdag gi bla ma'i skye ba ①la 'di skad ces khros shig /mi bzad sdedaka' thub kyis bdag ni/ /lus 'di yang ni zad 'gyur te/ /bdag gis ①go 'phang rnyed pa 'am/ /de nyid mthong rnams kyis mthong gang / /mos pas kyang de ltar babyi zhes byang chub sems dpa' la mngon par phyag btsal nas rta dang rgyan rnams blangs te/ rim gyis ④grong khyen du 'ongs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lo rgyus de mi'i bdag po la zhu ⑤zhing gnas so/ /zas gtsang mas kyang de'i rnam par nges pa gsan nas btsun mo'i 'khor dang lhan cig tu rnam pa mang pos smre sngags 'don par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpas kyang rngon pa'i gzugs 'dzin par byed pa'i lha'i bu la rang gi ri bong can gyi 'od zer rnams ltar mjes pa'i na bza' gnyis kyis gos dmar po dag nyos nas mnabs te/ rim byis rim gyis a ra rjola'i spyil por phyin par gyur to/ /a ra ⑦las ni byang chub sems dpa' 'ongs pa mthong ste/legs par 'ongs sam legs par 'ongs sam zhes brjod nas rang gi shing lo'i khang par khrid nas sa'i ⑧gdan la bzhugs su bcug cing bde bar sngon du 'gro bas smra ba byas par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpas de la dris pa/khyed ⑨rnams kyi chos ci lta bu/ /ci ltar yang ni rtogs 'grur te/ /de nyid mthong 'dod bdag la ni/ /dam pa bdag gis gsungs par 'os a ra ⑩las smras pa/ skal ba chen po mnyan par 'os zhes zer ro/ /rang bzhin dang 94—1394

rnam par 'gyur ba dag gi skye ba dang rga ba dang 'chi ba rnams de kho na nyid ces bya ba brjod pa ste/ rang bzhin yang 'byung ba chen po lnga dang / nga rgyal dang bsal ①ba zhes bya ba'o/ /rnam par 'gyur ba rnams ni dbang po rnams dang /de'i yul rnams dang / lag pa dang / rkang pa dang / ngag dang / bshang sgo dang pho rtags dang yid ces pa'i zhing 'di rnams rnam par shes pa zhing shes pa zhes bya bar brjod pa yin te/ zhing shes pa yang de kho na nyid shes pa rnams kyis skebadag gsal bar smra ba yin no/ /gang zhig skye ba dang gnod pa dang shi ①ba'i chos kyi bdag nyid de ni gsal ba zhes bya bar rtogs par bya'o/ /mi gsal ba nyid ni de las bzlog pa ste de ltar mi shes pa dang las dang sred pa ni 'khor ba'i rgyur rnam par shes par bya'o/ /gsum po la gnas pa'i shed bu ni snying stobs 'da' bar byed nas 'jug pa ma yin te/ rkyen dang bral ba dang / nga rgyal dang / the tshom dang / rnam par kun nas mchongs ④pa dang / khyad par med pa dang / thabs ma yin pa dang / chags ⑤pa dang / mngon par lhung ba rnams te/ de la rkyen dang bral ba zhes bya ba ni phyin ci log tu 'jug pa'o| /bdag ni mngon par smra ba dang / bdag rjoni shes pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni nga rgyal lo/ /gang zhig the tshom med pa'i dngos po rnams kyang 'dag pa'i ri lu ltar gcig po'i ⑦dngos pos mthong ba de ni the tshom zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /gang zhig bdag de rnams nyid 'di yid dang ⑧blo dang las rnams so/ /gang zhig tshogs 'di de ni bdag ces bya ba mngon par kun nas mchongs pa smra ba yin no/ /khyad par med pa ni slar rab tu sad pa dang ma sad pa dag gi rang bzhin med pa rnams kyi khyad par shes pa nyid de de ni khyad par 94—1395

med pa ste zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /swā hā byed pa dang / bshad byed pa dang / bsang gtor mngon par bsang gtor la sogs ①pa rnams ni thabs ma yin pa zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /dngos po gang la shes rab dang / yid dang ngag dang / blo dang las rnams kyis ⑤chags pa nye bar 'gro ba de ni chags pa zhes bya bar brjod pa yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi yin no/ /'di'i ①bdag ces bya ba gang zhig sdug bsngal rlom sems pa de ni mngon par lhung ba'o/ /srog chags rnams kyis rjo'akhor ba'i le lo zhes bya ba'o/ /mun pa ⑤dang gti mug dang rga ba dang 'chi ba dang skye ba rnams te/ gnyi mug chen po ni 'dod pa zhes bya bar ming btags pa'o/ /mun pa ni khro ba zhes bya bar shes par gyis shig slar ni sdug bsngal dmus long nyid mun par brjod pa yin te/ ma rig pa 'di tshigs pa lnga dang ldan pas rgongs pa bcings pa yid can skye ba la sogs rjopa'i sdug bsngal chen po la yang nas yang du 'jug pa yin te/ der yang bdag ni mthong ba po dang / nyan pa po dang / shes pa po dang / 'bras bu dang rgyu zhes bya ba 'di ltar ma shes nas 'khor bar yongs su 'khor ba yin te/ rgyu 'di rnams kyi ni skye ba'i rgyun gyi 'jug pa mthong ba yin te rgyu med pas skye ba med pa zhes bya ba'o/ /de la thar pa 'dod pas rab tu sad pa dang rab tu ma ⑦sad pa dag dang / gsal ba dang mi gsal ba dag shes par bya'o/ /bzhi po 'di rtogs nas zhing shes pa sdug bsngal thams cad las rnam par grol te mi zad ⑧pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur zhes bya ba ste/ thog mar khyem gyi 'ching ba khong nad sa bon dor nas ni/ /rtags ni bzung ⑨nas thar pa'i bde ba nye bar 'dod pa yi/ /chog shes dang ni ldan pa bla med go 'phang thob 'dod pa/ /94—1396

tshul khrims rnam par dag pa nyer bzung nags nang gnas par dben①/ /phyis ni chags pa chags bral dag las rab tu byung ba'i 'jigs pa dang bde ba dag shes nas dbang po'i tshogs thams cad tshar bcad nas yid kyis zhi ba la dmigs te/ de nas 'dod pa rnams dang / sdang ba la sogs pa rnams las ⑤rnam par dben pa rnam par dben pa ①las skyes pa'i bsam gtan dang po rtog pa dang bcas pa thob pa yin no/ /des kyang rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 'dod pa la sdong zhing smod pa'i zhi ba ④dang ldan pa tshangs pa'i 'jig rten rtogs ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par rtog pa rjode rnams kyang yid kun nas 'khrugs ⑦par byed pa shes nas de dang ⑧rnam par bral ba'i dga' ba dang bde ba'i bdag nyid can bsam gtan gnyis pa thob pa yin no/ /dga' ba des kyang yid 'phrog par gyur pa 'od gsal gyi lha rnams su skye ba yin ste/ gang zhig be+er dga' ba'i bde ba de las sems 'don par byed pa de ni gsum pa bde ba dang dga' ba ⑨dang rnam par bral ba'i bsam gtan ⑩thob pa yin no/ /de tsam gyi bde ba la yid nub pa de dge rgyas kyi lha rnams su skye ba so sor thob pa yin no/ /bde ba de lta bu thob nas gang zhig btang snyoms byed pa de ni bzhi pa ⑪bde ba dang sdug bsngal rnam par bral ba'i bsam gtan nye bar thob pa yin te/ de ni tshe ring ba nyid kyis ⑫kha cig ni grol ba nyid nges par byed pa yin no/ /de ⑫ci'i phyir zhe na/bde ba dang sdug bsngal rnam par gcad pa'i phyir dang / sems la bya ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan 'di'i ⑫'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams su thun mong gi 'bras bu mkhas pa rnams smra ba yin te/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas lus can rnams kyi skyon rnams mthong ste/ lus rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir ye shes 94—1397

rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan de yang spangs nas khyad par 'dod pa gzugs la ①shin tu 'dod chags dang bral ba yin te/ lus 'di la sdug bsngal rnams gang zhig yod pa de rnams ni dang por blos ②kun nas lta bar byed cing sdug cing mthug pa'i yang rdzas rnams la yang nam mkhar lhag pa'i ③mos pa skyed par byed de/ nam mkha' la song ba'i bdag nyid mngon par bsdus nas nam mkha' mtha' yas pa mthong zhing khyad par rtogs ④pa'i phyir dang bdag nyid la mkhas pa yin pa'i phyir bdag nyid la bsdus te cung zad med ces bya ba ni ci yang med pa zhes bya ba'i 'du shes su nye bar song ba lus dang bral ba'i grol ba zhes brjod pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpas smras pa/ gal te sems pa po yod na/ /grol ba ga las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dge dang mi dge'i bya ba rnams//de yod la ni 'jug pa yin/ /ji ltar yang chu dang sa rnam par bral bas sa bon ni gang gis kyang rab tu btsugs ⑤pa mthong ba ma yin te/ de'i rkyen las rnam par btsugs pa mthong ba duyin no/ /de bzhin du bdag kyang gzung ⑦bar bya'o//las dang mi shes pa dang sred pa dor bas thar pa gang zhig nges pa yin pa de ni bdag po yod pa la de yongs su dor ba dmigs par 'gyur ba ma yin te/ de yongs su ma dor ba ni thar pa ga la yod/ de ltar nga rgyal yongs su dor ba ni bdag yod pa ga la 'gyur/ nga rgyal yod pa la yang skye ba'i rgyun mi gnas pa nyid yin te zhes bya bar gsungs nas/ spyil po de las a ra ⑧la'i/ /blo gros chen po de byung nas/ /dka' thub dka' ba drag rnams kyis/ /lus ni skam zhing bzhugs par gyur/ /dka' thub 'dis ni de kho na nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba ma yin snyam du dgongs te langs nas/ kun nas stobs chung ba'i lus can 94—1398

byang chub sems dpas chu bo ṣ+pe rāñdza ①na la khrus mdzad nas/ dga' mdzes kyis phul ba'i bsod snyoms gsol nas dus kyi lto 'phye'i rgyal pos mngon par bstod pa/ de ni rtsa sha'i phreng bas rgya che sngo ba'i sgos/ /kun nas dmar ser yan lag can gyis ②sku khyab pa/ /mtsho skyes rnams kyi rab tu g.yo ba'i 'dab ma can| /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ma bsres pa'i phreng ①ba ltar/ /de nas gom pa dal gshegs nas/ /blo ldan gser gyi ri ltar 'ongs/ /byang chub shing gi 'og tu ni/ /byang chub phyir ni de bzhugs gyur/ /de nas bu mo rnams lhan cig /me tog gi gzhu blangs nas ni/ /de yi yid ni dkrugs ④pa'i phyir/ /yid kyi skye gnas kun nas 'ongs/ /shir+ṣa'i me tog sar pa ni/ /de yi mdun du sgom ⑤byed cing / /'bras bu kun g.yo lta ba ni/ /la la zhig gis cung zad bzung / /grogs mo'i rna bar gzhan gyis ni/ /dgod rjopa sngon 'gro ci yang smras| /blo ldan de la lta ba ni/ /sgeg dang bcas par gtad cing gnas/ /gzhan dag me tog du ba ni/ /mig ni ngo tsha bar byed cing / /gos ni mtshan ma las lhung ba/ /ska rags lhod par dze+ebakag par gyur/ /zla ba ltar mdzes lang tsho 'di ni gang du ste/ /dka' thub 'di ni gang du e ma 'di ni 'gal/ /yul rnams nyams su myong nas 'di ltar rigs pa ste/ /yongs su smin pa khyed kyis 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir/ /phan par 'dod pa nyid kyis ⑧khyed la smra ba ste/ /dus min yongs su ngal du 'jug pa ci phyir lus/ /de ltar la la 'dud pa'i yan lag can ni smra ba ste/ /yan lag med pa'i ⑨so sor gnod pa ⑩che de la/ /de ltar la la 'dod pa'i yan lag smras par gyur/ /khyed la ngan 'gror phrad 'dod bud med rnams la ni/ /blo ldan dzad kyi rjes su mthun min ci phyir 'di/ /94—1399

'di ltar de la mngon par smras gyur la la zhig /pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams ni sen mos gtubs ①byed cing / /gang gi tshe de rnams la byang chub sems dpas brnyas pa dang bcas pa'i lta ba sbyin par ma byas pa de'i tshe bdud kyi bka' byed rnam pa du mar 'gyur ba'i gdong can de rnams la smras pa/ 'jigs su bcug nas 'di bslang bar gyur cig ces bya ba'o/ /de nas seng ge'i gdong la ni/ /hūṃ byas pas ni yang yang du/ /me stag 'od ni 'phro ba yi/ /'bar ba'i gdong las grol bar gyur/ /de rnams de yi bka' byed gdong las byung / /lhung zhing skad cig gis gsungs te/ /rab rgyas mya ngan me tog nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i steng du 'phangs/ /me ldan 'khor lo su zhig gis/ /rnam rgyas ze'u 'bru'i tshogs ldan pa/ /ut+pa la yi mgo phreng gyur/ /so bsdams gzhan dag nyid kyis ni/ /glog bzhin kham pa'i smin ma can/ /kha ba'i rtse mo steng du 'bebs| /kun da'i phung po nyid du 'gyur/ /gzhan dag ser ②skya'i mig can ni/ /ral gri dang bcas dpung pa bteg /lcags kyi ka ba'i grib ma 'dra//skad cig mi g.yo nyid du gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ni ④byang chub shing gi 'og tu bzhugs byas nas/ /'phro ba'i mig gi me can dka' bzhin du ni byed rnams kyi ④ni tshogs/ /dkar ba min par 'gro ba'i gogs kyis kun nas rab tu bskul bzhin pa/ /nags kyi me ni kun du chu dang nye las bzhin du zhig par gyur/ /me tog rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa 'khor gyi skye bo dang bcas pa ⑤song ba na| bcom ldan 'das de bsam gtan bzhi pa las bzhengs te 'di bsams par gyur te/ gal te skye ba sngon yod na/ /las rnams kyis ni 'jug pa min/ /las las byung ba'i skye ba med/ /las med na yang lus can gyi/ /gzugs 94—1400

dang skal bzang skal ba sogs/ /dge ①ba ci ltar 'dod ni 'dod/ /'on te sngon du las yod na/ /ma skyes pa las ②ga las te/ /mkhas pas 'di ltar 'gal mthong nas/ /'khor ba'i thog dze+em rtog mi byed/ /gal te rgyu med 'gro rjoyin na/ /su zhig las dang ⑤nyid smra 'gyur/ /rgyu med par ni thar pa yang / /rtag tu grub pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rgyu med par ni lus rjokyang 'di/ /bskyed pa nyid du 'gyur ba min/ /la la dbang phyug rgyu yin pa/ /mi mkhas pa rnams smra bar byed/ /gal te dbang phyug gzhan gyis byas/ / 'dir ni ⑦dbang phyug nyid ga las/ /'on te ma sprul nyid skyes pa/ /de las gzhan ni cis mi skye/ /de phyir dbang phyug smra ba 'di/ /bdag gi be+ed du don med nyid/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo 'di/ /yang dang yang du 'khor bzhin pa'i/ /nam yang mkhas pa rnams kyis ni/ /thog ma dmigs par 'gyur ba min/ /nam mkha'i khams 'di ni rlung dang me dang chu dang sa rnams kyis ⑧kun nas 'byel pa ni lus zhes brjod pa yin no/ /de yang rnam par shes pa'i khams la brten nas 'gro ba dang 'ong ba ⑨la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams byed do zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar gnas pa la skyes pa ⑩nye bar btags par bya ⑪zhes zer ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas du ma rnams kyis ⑫mi shes pa'i rab rib sel ⑫bar mdzad de/ grong khyer ser skyar byon nas zas gtsang ma la legs pa'i lam gsal bar mdzad de/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das de 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams kyi sdug bsngal nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don du yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nus kyang shin tu ring por 'khor ba na kun nas 'khor bar gyur to zhes bya ba ste/ blo chen de ni byang chub phyir/ /lag tu gtad ltar sbyin byas 94—1401

te—/ /yun ring shes rab pha rol phyin/ /dam pa bde bar gnas pa yin/ /e ma gal te chos ni mun pa 'joms/ /bde gshegs kyis gsungs 'di ni rnam dpyod nas/ /dri mas khyab pa'i lta bas mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye bo ①'di ni gzhan 'dod rten mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri med gsung yang yod pa zhes bya la—/ /rmongs pa lam ngan song ba'i skye bo 'di ni kun nas 'khor/ /ri bong mtshan pa mngon gsher la ni gang zhig mi zum pa/ /dman pa'i blo de song zhing ji ltar lhung bar 'gyur ba min / /②yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni/ /seng ge zhabs 'bring pas byas 'di/ /chos 'dod rnams kyi phreng ba byas pa 'di/ /skyes pa'i rabs kyi phreng ba byas pa yi①/ /dge ba cung zad gang zhig bdag gis bsagasarjo/ /de yis 'gro ba 'di ni bde gshegs kyi/ /'dod pa la dmigs thar pa'i phyir gyur cig /rab 'gro gnya' ral can brgya byin/ /khra can don kun grub ldan pa/ /lnga yis lhag pa'i sum cu 'dir/ /thub pa chen po'i skyes sderabs rnams/ /rigs ⑦pa sgra yi bstan bcos cha ni rnam pa ⑦mang po shes nas sangs rgyas kyis kyang gsungs⑧//phyi ma'i snyan dngags mkhan gyi zla bas sa ni snyan dngags 'od rnams kyis ⑨ni rab gsal byas/ /kha cher nye bar 'tshe ba'i skyon gyis rnam par gdungs pa shes nas phyi rol 'gro 'dod pas/ /ri dbang kha ba can la seng ge zhabs 'bring ⑩las ni srog rnams dor nas mtho ris song ⑩/ /rgyal po'i sras slob dpon seng ge zhabs 'bring pas mdzad pa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi phreng ba rdzogs so// //dge slong dpal ldan blo gros 'byung gnas zhes bya mkhas pa ni/ /sems can rnams la chos dang zang zing kun nas 'god mdzad cing / /tshad ma dang ni 94—1402

lung dang rgyud rnams du ma la 'dris pas/ /'gro ba'i mnga' bdag gi ni spyod pa 'di la gnyis po dag /gzhal du med cing dri ma med pa kun nas bsags te de las 'di/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i dri mchog bzhin du myur spangs sngon du 'gro ba ni/ /de dang de yi skyes rabs yongs bzung 'gro ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ni gdon byas te/ /mthar yang thub dbang rnams bzhin mtha' dag bya byas sangs rgyas khams gsum du ni khyed 'byung shog /lcang lo can gyi bum pa zhes bya mkhas dang lhan cig 'di nyid du/ /gang zhig tshul khrims 'byung gnas skad gnyis pas ni 'di ltar cho ga bzhin/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa shin tu rnam dag yangs pa ni/ /skye bo ma lus pa la phan pa'i don du de yis yang dag bsgyur// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta a lo ka de ba'i zhabs dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong tshul khrims 'byung gnas sbas pas dpal gyi sgye'u ri'i rtsa chos skor dbe+en pa'i gtsug lag ①khang du bsgyur ba'osde// //94—1403

〉d+kudag dze+e〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7'di yid dang /94byed1447
bsdur 'bras re'u migaskyes rabs/ (3)94wa 1449

༄ga /'jig rten kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar ces bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ lo ka ā ④nan+da nā ṭa ka nā ma/ bod skad du—/ 'jig rten kun du dga' ba'i zlos gar zhes bya ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bung ba'i phreng ba mi gsal sgra sgogs rkang pa 'dab ma rnam ①bskyod pas/ /ge sar kha 'bus ro bcud dang bcas rdul phran tshogs pas khyab gyur cing / /sbrang rtsi rgya chen thig les rnam khengs me tog thal mo sbyar ba 'dis/ /bdag gis rgyal ba'i zhabs la mchod pas khyed rnams la ni zhi bar mdzod—/ /gzhan yang byams pa'i thugs ni rgya chen dga' bas mgul nas yang dag 'khyud gyur pa/ /khyed kyi snying rjes bdag cag kyang ni de bzhin btang snyoms mtshungs mdzad rigs/ /legs pa'i lha mo grags 'dzin mdzad bzhin bdag cag gis ni rjes mi 'gro/ /bdud kyi bu mos phrag dog gis smras khyed rnams sangs rgyas rtogs par shog /rdzogs byang chub la bdud ni khro bas skad 94byed1450

cig gzhu bkang de yi sde tshan rnams/ /gang gis rnam par bros pas bub cing log 'dren zhabs kyis mnan te mngon skad 'byin/ /lus med bu mo myos byed ma rnams mchi 'dzag ①'chi med rnams kyis mthong nas dga'/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sngon 'gro gzhan gyis mi thub mas ni khyed rnams skyong bar shog /dga' byed kyis mchod pa'i mtha' las mdo 'dzin pa'o/ /snyan ngag tsan dru ⑧dā sha yā/ /zlos gar 'jig rten kun du dga'/ /sngon med zlos gar rab sbyar bas/ /de ring tshogs la bdag gis ①ston/ /de ni nges par snyan ngag nyid//shar phyogs dzā tu ④kar ṇa'i rigs las ni/ /lha mo rgyal ma yid kyi shing rta las//gang 'khrungs khur ni ⑤'khur bar mi nus kyang / /de yi bu zhes rab tu grags pa thob/ /gzhan yang rab 'byam rgyan dang bcas shing tshigs bcad rkyang pa mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs rgya chen rnams/ /gang gis dngos po gcig gi brjod byas la yang rgya chen zad par mi 'gyur dhidang / /gang gis byā ka ⑦ra ṇa ni nyung zhing rab gsal yongs rdzogs gzhan yang mdzad gyur nas/ /'jig rten chags dang 'jig rten mun pa'i tshogs chen rab tu 'joms mdzad gyur/ /de nas da ni rol cha dang bcas te rtsom pa na re zhig rang gi 'phags ma la bos te kye 'phags ma re zhig 'dir byon ces so/ /de nas de ni ⑧gdung ba'i shugs dang bcas te rab tu zhugs nas/ kye 'phags ma ⑨bdag 'ongs so bka' bsgos ⑩shig ces so/ /mdo 'dzin pa nas kye 'phags ma ⑪ci'i phyir khyod sdug bsngal bar byed/ zlos gar ma nas ci'i phyir sdug bsngal bar ⑫mi 'gyur te/ ji ltar khyod kyi ming tsam gyis kyang ni/ /gnas rnams yang dag 'dren nus bu gcig po/ /nges par bdag ni rab tu byung nas ni/ /rang ⑫lus 'bras 94—1451

bcas bsgrub par bya zhes smra/ /mdo 'dzin pa nas/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' ma yin no/ /zlos gar ma nas/ kye 'phags pa/ de byang chub sems dpa' ma yin ①nam mkha' las kyang ma lhung zhing / rnam par 'dzin byed kyi mthil brtol nas kyang ma byung ngo / /zhes smra zhing / gang zhig 'dir snying rje skye bo'i phyir 'tsho bar spro ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes brjod do/ /mdo 'dzin pa nas/ 'phags ma de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ni / /snying rje'i sa bon las ②skyes pa'i/ /byang chub sems kyi myu gu 'khrungs/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yal 'dab rgyas/ /dpag bsam shing bzhin dgos 'dod rnams| /sdug bsngal ba des chog go/ /'di'i bsod nams kyi stobs las de bzhin du dpal du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i rol mo rtsom par mdzod cig dang / zlos gar ma nas/ kye 'phags pa/ 'dir yang dus gang la brten yang dag pa'i rol mo brtsam par bgyi/ mdo 'dzin pa dze+enas/kye 'phags ma 'dir re zhig gsar du mngon par 'byung rjob lhan cig byed pa'i snying ma'i dris yongs su khyab pa me tog gi phreng ba len pa sbrang rtsi byed pa'i rigs kun du dga' zhing rtse ba me tog gi dus la brten la glu long zhig /'di lta ste/pad mo rnams ni ba mos rigs nyams 'od ldan gang zhig shar nas dbugs rnams 'byin/ /de bzhin mkhas pa'i lho phyogs rlung rnams kyis ni 'jig rten yang dag tshim par byed/ /phyogs rnam ⑤pa lā shā yi ljon shing me tog sha dral bzhin du shin tu dmar/ /bsil zer 'od zer 'gro ba rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bzhin gsal pos dhiyang dag gnas/ /yol ba'i nang nas ngo mtshar che'o ⑦ngo mtshar che zhes so/ /⑧mdo 'dzin pas⑨/ rna bar thos nas/ 'di su zhig 94—1452

yin / nges par brtags pas/ kun nas shes te/ rig 'dzin ma yis gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu 'di mthong nas/ /rab dga' g.yo zhing rang gi lag pa'i pad+ma gar rtse zhing / /nam mkhar rkang gdub rtse la gos kyi 'od zer reg gyur nas/ /gangs ①ldan ri bo'i rtse mo la ni rab tu rgyu bar byed/ /bdag cag rnams kyang ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par ②brtsam mo zhes zer nas/ gnyis po nges par zhugs te/ mngon du phyogs nas gnas so/ /de nas rig 'dzin ma rab tu zhugs ste/ gar byed cing astso ṭā e asbyi rā sne.e/gang gis skye bo 'di 'dra sa chen steng / /lha rnams kyis kyang shin tu mthong bar dka'| /rab tu dga' bas gzhan gyi dbang gyur pa/ /dga' ba'i grogs mo pad+ma ba tī ④la/ /bdag gi khur ni yang dag gtad byas nas/ /nam zhig 'ong bar gyur te bdag mi shes/ /zhes nas yongs su zhugs so/ /gang gis 'ongs pa dang 'dug pa'ang mi dran par dga' ba'i grogs mo'i bste gnas su phyin te bdag nyid ngo mtshar che nas rab tu zhugs so/ /'dir ji ltar sbrang rtsi byed pa'i rkang pa'i khyar gyis me tog rab tu rgyas pa'i rdul byi ⑤tshogs pas khyab pa'i rdo leb kyi steng nā ga ge sar gyi srang lam du byas pa la dga' ba'i grogs mo pad+ma ba tī duni sbrang gi bu mo dang lhan cig tu ⑦gnas shing cung zad cung zad smra zhing 'khod de/ drung du nye bar nye bar ④'ongs so/ /de nas sbrang gi bu mo dang pad+ma can rab tu zhugs te/ pad+ma can nas/ kye sbrang rtsi'i bu mo bdag gi snying myos pa snyam byed do zhes dga' ba'i grogs mo ⑨rin chen phreng ba ⑩ma la lta bar byed cing / ci'i phyir na de tsam du yang mi 'ong bar gyur/ rig 'dzin mas nye bar thos nas kye pad+ma can sems gtor bar (rmem byed ces zer/94—1453

'dir de dag gnyis na re a re dga'/ a re dga' zhes smra zhing gnyis po rtab rtab por langs song nas/ a i ci yin ci yin rig 'dzin ma nas kun gyi lta byed rnams kyis blta bar 'os pa bdag gis mthong ste mig gisatu'abras bu thob bo//gnyis po nas khyod kyis ci ⑤mthong spros shig /rig 'dzin la ①ni slar yang de nyid smra bar byed do/ /gnyis pos yang 'dri zhing rig 'dzin ma la pad+ma can rab tu 'khyud do/ /bdag ni rab tu dga' ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur te/ gal te bdag gis dbyangs can ma la bar rnyed na dhismra'o/ /gnyis po nas/ khyod kyi dga' bde shin tu phyi mo zhig zhugs pa 'dra'o/ /rig 'dzin ma nas 'di ni gzhan mthong nas kyang de la dga' ba chen po mthong ngo / /gnyis po nas bdag nyid gcig po 'gegs pas chog gam/ bdag cag la yang cha shas legs par gos khrumadzod/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ bdag gis mthong ba dul ba'i mdangs ldan pa/ /'od zer rab tu 'dren pa 'phro ba can/ /phyogs bzhi chos rnams ma lus sgyu rtsal tshogs/ /yongs su zhugs rnams mig ni dga' bar byed/ /gnyis po nas/ legs ldan ma zla ba'am ci zhig /rig 'dzin ma khros te/de bzhin du bdag gis ma smras pa rang mchog go/ /kye 'di ni ri dwags kyis rjomatshon te/ de la mtshungs pa ⑦byed dam/ gnyis po nas/ yang na myos byed dam—/ rig 'dzin ma nas gang de'i sbyor ba dang bral na hūṃ zhes byed cing byin za'i rtse mo ⑧phye ma leb dang 'dra ba ni ngu ⑨ba'i mdangs dang ldan zhing mdzes par rab tu rkyong ⑩ngam/ gnyis po nas/ gang ji ltar yin pa smros dang / rig 'dzin ma nas bdag gis ⑩smra bar bya yis ⑫de legs par nyon cig /'di nas rig 'dzin ma skye bo'i gtam phan tshun smra ba las gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu 'di 94—1454

'dra'o zhes thos pas ya mtshan che nas dga' ba dang lhan cig sā ke ta'i grong khyen du bdag gis ①phyin no/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs byen gyi lha mo 'od kyi blo gros ma la khye'u zhig yang dag par 'khrungs te/ gzhan gyis bskrun ②par mi nus shing gzugs dang phun sum tshogs pas rnam par spras pa mchog gi snying rje can gang 'dod pa kun sbyin pa gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu zhes pa bdag gis ①mthong ngo / /de yang mthong ba na kun gyis ④mngon par 'dod pa'i don phun sum tshogs pa grub pa'o/ /rgyal po gang zhig gi ⑤bu mo'i ched du bu mo dhide'i sku gzugs dang dbyibs kyi bkod pa thang ka la ri mor bris te khyer ba la bar du rig 'dzin ma rnams kyis brkus te 'khyer bar byed do/ /gnyis po mngon par 'dod pa 'phel te/ slar yang de gang na yod/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ nor 'dzin 'di nyid na'o/ /gnyis po nas/ khyod ni ⑦mkha' la 'gro ba 'bras bu dang bcas te 'thob bo/ /gang ji lta ba de bzhin du mngon par 'dod pa yid 'phrog pa rnams khyod kyis ⑧gang bar thob bo/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ kye ma rigs ⑨dang khyed cag gi yang mngon par 'dod par ⑩yongs su 'gyur byis sbrang rtsi'i bu mo nas/ gang las bdag cag la 'di'i skal ba sus ster bar byed/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ yang skyon gcig 'dug zer/ gnyis po nas/ skyon gang yin sgos shig /rig 'dzin ma nas/ gang gis na de khyim thab bya ba las phyir phyogs so/ /mā dha bī ⑪dang pad+ma ba tī dag nas ⑫'jig rten yid bzhin gyi nor bu ni shin tu dkon no/ /bibyā ⑫dh+wa rī nas/ bdag gis byango mtshar che ba gzhan yang dran te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i gtam gyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu ni ji lta ba bzhin du de la lhan cig skyes pa'i gtsug na nor bu'o/ /mādha bī nas 94—1455

a tsi ram̐ e bir+ya jo ri nas ci'i phyir 'di ngo mtshar che/ nam mkha'i spyod yul gyis skye bo de mthong ngam/ mā dha bī nas/ bdag cag gis mthong ba'i thabs 'ga' zhig yod dam/ bibyā ①dha rī nas ma yin te bdag gis khyer 'ongs so/ /gnyis po ngo tsha zhing rtab rtab por phyogs rnams su blta zhing / de gang na gang na zhes so/ /rig 'dzin mas bdag gi ②stod gos kyi gseb ①nas/ thang ka la ri mo bris pa de phyung nas bstan no/ /gnyis po ngo mtshar nas nges par bltas te/ gnas tshul ni rin chen phreng ba ma'i phyogs 'dra ba zhig go/ /mā dha bī dang / pad+ma ba tī ④dag nas/ khyod kyis ⑤don med pa'i dga' ba 'phel bar byas te/ khyod bzhin du legs pa'i nyams dang bcas so/ /grogs mo dga' ma dhibadag skyon ci mchis spros shig /pad+ma can yun ring du nges par bltas nas/ 'di la skyon cig mchis so/ /rig 'dzin ma khros te/skyon gang spros dang / pad+ma can sbrang gi bu mos mthong nas sbrang gi bu mo nas/smra bar mi nus pa'o zhes zer/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ kye pad+ma ba tī ⑦gdung bar ma byed cig /khyod kyi yang bdag gis thang ka cig ri mor bris te lha mo 'od kyi blo gros ma la byin pa dang / nye bar bltas nas/ de yang mngon par dga' nas 'di tsam zhig bag ma dang mna' ma'i gdong pa mthong nas ⑧zhes smra'o/ /'dis lhan cig tu ⑨mna' ma byas nas shin tu spro'o zhes smra'o/ /pad+ma can khros te| dga' ba'i grogs mo de bzhin du spyo bar rigs ⑩sam/ sbrang gi bu mo dga' nas de nas de nas zhes zer/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ de nas rgyal po tshangs byen ⑪gyis mngon du mthong ngo / /gnyi ⑫gar gyis bltas nas/ smra ba/'di ni gzhon nu ⑫rjes su 'ongs so/ /'on kyang byed pa ⑫po'i dbang las so/ /94—1456

de nas gnyis pos ri mo bris pa ①mngon du bltas nas/ gang na spyod pa'i mi gzhon nu la ston du bcug go/ /de nas des yun ring du bltas nas/ shugs nar byung khrungo / /mā dha ①bī nas/ de'i mtshan nyid ni ④gang yin rig 'dzin ma nas/ phyi ba'i skye bo ni rjes su chags so zhes pa'o/ /pad+ma ba tī rjoni gang mnyan par bya ba mnyan nas ngus so/ /rig 'dzin ma ni des skrag nas/ /ji ltar bdag gi bdud rtsi'i char byen pas/ /dug gis rjornam par khyab par ⑦gyur//de 'dis slar yang ji ltar bcos par bya/ /zhes so/ /yol ba'i nang du'o/ /de bzhin du/ de rnams gcig tu 'dir su 'ong ngam snyam mo/ /de nas drang srong dpon slob gnyis rab tu zhugs so/ /gnyis pa'o⑧/ /bu'i rang bzhin mnyes gshin pa/ /yid gdung gang gis mi shes pa/ /de nyid gcig pu ⑨skyes bu ste/ /'jig rten na ni bde mchog thob/ /spyod pa'i bu nas/ bu mo pad+ma can ma ba tī ⑩me tog thur song ba las ci ste yun ring du 'gor ro/ /ci'i phyir khyab 'jug gis ni mtshon byed ma zhes stobs kyis khyer ⑪ram/ tsha zer byed pas zla ba'i cha zhes mi bzod 'od kyis rang nyid rnam ⑫zhugs sam/ yang na rig 'dzin thabs dang phrad nas rig 'dzin yin zhes phyag byas khyer gyur tam/'di las bdag gis/ sems 'di ⑫rang dbang med par yang dag rab tu myos par gyur⑫/ slob mas smras pa/ kye mkhan po de ltar sems gdung mi 'tshal/mkhan po'i mthu stobs ni sa gsum na sus kyang 'da' bar mi nus so zhes zer nas gnyis po yongs su zhugs so/ /drang srong gis phyogs rnams su bltas te/mchi ma 'dzag cing / gal te bung ba'i rigs kyi lus ni rnam khebs zla rnams bral ⑫gyur nas/ /gdung bas ⑫zhugs shing tshang tshing gis sgrib ⑩khron pa rnams 94—1457

su lhung ba 'am/ /yang na zla dang 'thabs pas de'i mi bzod brtse zhing rgyug pas lhung / /yang na byis pa gcig pur ngu 'am bdag ni shin tu gdung bar byed/ /thams cad kyis 1mnyam du thos shing mthong nas rtab rtab por gyur nas/ rig pa ⑨'dzin ma nas yab yin nam ji ltar yin zhes zer ro/ /pad+ma can dang kyi sbrang gi bu mo dag ngo tsha dang bcas bzhin du bdag cag gis ji ltar smras pa yab kyis thos so zhes zer④/ pad+ma ba tī ⑤nas sbrang shing tshang tshing 'di'i nang du zhugs na yab kyis ma mjong ba phyir log pa srid dam snyam nas zhugs so/ /rig 'dzin ma ni rtab rtab por ⑪ nye bar btud de/ phyag byas so/ /drang srong nas/dge bar gyur cig zer/ bris sku de mthong nas/ bu mo rin chen phreng ba ma 'di ci yin zer/ rig 'dzin ma ni skrag nas bdag ni nges par 'jigs pas na smra mi nus so/ /yab nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyis de bzhin du mngon du mdzod cig ces zer⑦/ drang srong gis bsam gtan bsgoms so/ /rig 'dzin ma ni shin tu 'jigs par gyur te/ 'dir yab kyis ci smra'am snyam mo/ /drang srong nas bu mo 'jigs pa ⑤des chog go/ /kye 'di la ji lta ba de bzhin bdag dbang che'o zhes zer yang thams cad dga' ba dang bcas par gyur to/ /bdag cag rnams ⑨ 'dis dbugs phyung ⑪ snyam mo/ /drang srong nas/ sngon nas 'di lkuyon tan phun sum tshogs pa rnams ni nye bar thos te/ mngon par 'dod pa 'di ni mchog yin no/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ legs ldan gyis/bdag cag rnams rjes su bzung ngo / /sbrang gi ⑫ bu mo nas/ kye pad+ma ba tīkhya)/the tshom des chog don rnams grub/ /yid kyi shing rta las byung ba'i/ /nges par dka' thub skye bo yi/ /mngon par 'dod 'bras med mi 'gyur/ /drang 94—1458

srong nas/ bdag nyid chen po 'dir 'ongs pa/ re zhig ri mo las thob pa'ang mchod par 'os par bya'o zhes smra①/ rig 'dzin ma nas me tog blangs nas phul lo/ /drang srong gis de la phul te nges par bltas te/ e ma mkhas pa zhig gis bris so/ /'di lta ste/ yang dag gnas kyis rab dbye 'dug stangs lta tshul dang / /phra sbom zug dang mtho dma' rtsig ④pa'i cha rnams dang / /zhib tshags rnam ④dag mig ni rab tu g.yo ba 'dra/ /ya mtshan ri mo dag ni nges par smra ba bzhin/ /e ma bdag gi dubu mo ni yid kyi shing rta rab tu dga' bar chags so/ /'di lta ste/ bdag nyid chen po de nyid ni/ /yul rnams la ni kha phyir phyogs/ /gang gis de phyir gus pa yis/ /'di ni ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bu mo rin chen phreng ba ma yang khyod kyi grogs mo dga' ma dag gang na yod shes sam/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ legs ldan khyod nyid mthong nas tshang tshing gi ⑤khang pa 'dir zhugs so/ /drang srong nas/ pad+ma ba tī dukhyod kyis ji ltar ngo tsha yang bslabs sam/ bu pad+ma can 'dir shog /pad+ma can ni ngo tsha bas 'dar zhing / nye bar phyin to/ drang srong gis pad+ma can mthong ste/ 'tsher ngo des chog go/ /yid ches sems ni the tshom med par lta byed cing / /lus ni rnam par g.yo med brtan zhing bkur 'dod med/ /byis pa'i blo gros ji bzhin khyod kyis rab dgar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin gyis mdzes brtan ⑦ma ci'i phyir 'di ngo tsha/ /pad+ma ba tī ⑧ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong ni spyi bo la nye bar gtugs te mngon par 'dod pa ⑨slar thob par gyur cig ces zer| rig 'dzin ma gang gi skye bor ⑩gnas pas kye dga' ba'i grogs mo byed pa po yin no/ /gzhan du ⑪legs ldan gyis dbyangs ci'i phyir 'jug par 'gyur/94byed1459

bdag kyang don 'di la de bzhin du mngon par chags so/ /drang srong slob ma bram ze nas kye mkhan po myur du mdzod/ rig byed kyi dus tshod la song ngo /drang srong nas/ ji ltar nyi ma gung gi dus la nye bar 'ong ngam/ 'di lta ste/da ni rab shing gi grib ma ①rnams la rig 'dzin rnams ①bsnyel bso'i mtha'/ljon pa'i bsel grib 'og tu ri dwags rnams ni skyug ldad byed cing gnas pa dang /btsugs ④shing yur chu rnams nyal zhing gnas pa dang / btsugs yu 'gro med rtse mo rnams la lha yi sreg ④rdzas rnams kyi du ba yang dag 'khrigs/ /dpal ldan chags bral bsod nams mchog gi mngon brjod pa/ /ma lus sa stengs grags pas 'gro ba gcig nyid rgyal/ /gang zhig zlos gar rang dbang nor gyis rab dga'i gar/ /dpal ldan tsan+d+ra ⑤go mi'i snyan ngag len zhing gnas/ /'dir thams cad nges par zhugs so/ /yan lag dang po rdzogs so// //de nas snga 'jug ma rab tu zhugs te/ 'dir ni rgyal rigs lha'i 'jig rten 'dra bar mthong / /ri mo'i bag ma'ang bag ma'i ltad mo 'di bzhin no/ /gal te 'di ni bden pa yin na ji ltar 'gyur/ /de ci gzhan du 'di ni rjosngon med mthong bar 'gyur zhes zer nas yongs su blta zhing zhugs so/ /rgyal phran grong mtha'i shin tu mdzes ma rnams/ /'di rnams 'dir ni de bzhin rnam par spras—/ /rgyan gyi 'od zer 'di bzhin 'phro ba yis/ /grong bar rnam ⑦khengs gos dmar gar byed bzhin⑧/ /de nas ji ltar dga' ba'i grogs mo lo ma can gyis mthong nas nges par bltas shing 'dir lo ma can dang / de bzhin du gar byed cing 'ongs so/ /de nas lo ma can rab tu zhugs te/ kye kun da ⑨khyod 94—1460

nyon cig gsung ①/ 'di bzhin du bag ma'i ltad mo la btang stoms su byed pa ci yin/ kun ta li ka nas kye ha nya dze lo ma can lha mos ni bag ma ltad mor byas mod kyi②/ 'on kyang gzhon nu 'dir slar 'jug gam/ de nas bdag gis yid phyir mi ldog par byed do/ /lo ma can nas/ gang gi skye bo phyi ba'i bka'①| /nam zhig gzhon nus 'da' byed dam/ /rin chen 'byung gnas dus rlabs ④kyis/ /ci ste mtshams las 'da' 'gyur ram/ /kun ta nas/'dir lha mo nyid tshad ma'o/ /lo ma can nas/ gzhon nu gnyen ⑤gyi spyod yul du 'dug 0pa 'di rnams song ngam/ kun ta nas ⑦ma song ste 'di bzhin 'jug pa gzhon nu la smra ba ni lha mo 'od kyi blo gros ma nas/ bdag la 'phags pa'i ⑧go ta ma'i nye 'khor ltos la 'phags pa go ta ma la smros shig /de yang 'di bzhin du grogs pos byas pa la chags pa yin gyis zhes zer ro lo ma can nas/ ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i don phun sum tshogs te/ thams cad kyang rang gi gar rtse bar byed cing gnyis po yang gar byed do/ /lo ma can nges par bltas nas/ kye de bzhin yin na 'dir 'phags pa go ta mas legs ldan ma'i spyod pa'i rjes su 'gro zhing de bzhin ⑨'dir slar 'ong ngam zer nas/de nas lha mo 'di dag ⑩bdag cag gis smrar deng ⑪ngo zhes de dag song ste rab tu zhugs so/ /de nas rtsed ⑫grogs bzhad gad pa rab tu zhugs so/ /na mnyam dga' ba thub pa'i skye bo'i rjes su 'jug cing yang dag par spyod pa la lha mo 'od kyi ⑫blo gros ma'i skyes 'di'o/ /bdag cag gi (stesnying la zug rngur gnas te/de'i ri mor bris pa la yang bag ma'i ltad mo 'di smra zhing / bag ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /'dir bltas nas slar yang ji ltar 'jug par 'gyur ⑫ba de lta de 94byed1461

ltar 'dir yang de'i blo rnam par 'byed par bya ste/ gal te 'jig rten pha rol du / /bdag cag 'das par gyur ①na yang / /rigs rgyud rnam par chad gyur nas/ /mtshun la chu bzhin rnam par 'chad/ /yang ji ltar smras na⑤/nyams dga' ba'i bya ba 'grub par 'gyur snyam nas nges par bltas pa nas/der ①mnyam dga' ba'i sngar 'jug pa ④mdzi rab tu dga' ba'i skyed mos tshal nas 'thon ⑤byung ngo / /re zhig 'di la dri'i rjosnyam ste/ kye maspru dze+el na mnyam dga' ba gang na yod/ nam mkha' la khyod ci zhig smra/ de 'di na rab tu dga' ba'o/ /tshal na bzhugs so/ /der nye bar 'gro bar bya'o zhes rab tu zhugs nas bltas ⑧pa na gang zhig sbrang rtsi byed pa'i gshog ⑨pa'i rlung gis rab tu bskyod na ⑩me tog rnams ni kha bye ze 'bru'i rdul du 'khrigs shing gdong na bung ba rnams ni r+ghaṃ sgogs shing 'khor bas 'khrigs so/ /na mnyam dga' ba ma mthong nas/ mdzi las 'di na bzhugs zer te/ gal te gdug pa can gyi rig 'dzin mas 'di nas brkus te/ khyer ba ma yin nam zhes smras pa na/rig 'dzin ma rab tu zhugs te/ mya ngan dang bcas nas/ ji srid bdag cag ⑪gis dga' ba'i grogs mo la/ /gzhon nu'i tshul 'di nye bar smras gyur pa//de nas dga' grogs pad+ma ba tī ⑫la/ /mgo la zug rngu yang dag skyes par gyur/ /lus ni nyal ba tsam thob pa ma yin pa shin tu gdung ba 'phel bar gyur tsu)te/grogs mo'i skye bo yang shin tu gdung bar byed do/ / skabs der ④dga' ba'i grogs mo spangs te/ 'ongs kyang ma 'ongs pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /gzhon nu'i thugs kyang shin tu gdung bar byas so snyam nas/ lta zhing gzhon nu'i na mnyam mthun pa de bltas nas re zhig bar du 'di gang du 'gro blta bar bya'o snyam mo/ /94—1462

bzhad gad pas bltas te 'di na re zhig rtsed mo'i ri'i steng na chu'i 'khrul 'khor steng du 'bab cing rab tu g.yo ①ba dba' rlabs dzha ②ri'i sgra 'byen pa'i steng na na mnyam mthun pa blta bar bya'o zhes steng du phyin te/ gar byed cing tī tī sto zhes so/ /de nas mya ngan med pa'i tshal gyi rin chen rdo leb yangs pa'i steng na cung zad smra bar byed cing bzhugs nas mchis so/ /nye logs su phyin no/ /rig 'dzin ma ni 'dir ④re zhig gzhon nu dag yid ches pa'i gtam gang yin mnyam ④par bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas rab tu zhugs pa na 'dren pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ngo / /shugs ⑤nar phyung ste kye ma 'jig rten rnams ni yul la dumangon par zhen par 'gyur te/ gang des phyin cing 'gro ba gang zhig lan ⑦brgyar skyes gyur pa/ /bde ba gang de lan cig ma yin mngon du ma gyur med/ /dpal mo gang der ⑧mjes pa'i rnga ma g.yo zhing dgod ⑨pa ltar/ /gang zhig ma thob med cing slar yang de la ⑩de bzhin chags/ /bzhad ⑪gad nye bar mnyen ⑫te khyod kyi bde legs 'phel ⑫gyur cig /'dren pa ni de bzhin du sgo ka de nyid klog par byed de/ rig 'dzin ④ma ni rnga brdung zhing grogs dga' ma la mtshun gyi ⑫chu 'byen no zhes so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ bye bram ze shis par ⑫brjod pa'i lan gnang ⑩bar mdzod zer/ 'dren pa ⑫ji ltar go ta ma'am/ /na mnyam bde bar 'grur tam/ 'dir zhugs ⑪shig /bzhad ⑫gad pas rang nyid bsams te/ ji srid 0du yang na mnyam mthun pa ci zer nyan zhing brtags pa na shin tu byu zhing de yang dag par mi dga'o/ /de nas re zhig /'di ltar lha mo'i skyes smra ba'i skabs ma rnyed do/ /de ⑫bzhin re zhig smra'o snyam nas gsal bar/ kye na mnyam dga' ba gzigs gzigs/ /'di ltar thang 94—1463

shing ljon pa'i dra ba yi/ /bu ga las byung pad+ma'i 'dab mar ni/ /sbrang rtsis myos pa'i bung bas ①glu len cing / /pad+ma'i steng na chu rgyun rab tu 'bab/ /rig 'dzin ma ni legs so/ /go ta ma legs so/ /bdag cag la rjes su brtse bar mdzad do snyam mo/ /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam 'dir ci zhig lta④/ /kun kyang bye zhing rgyas ldan pa/ /ge snesar nges par lhung ba yis/ /'gro rnams gnas shing mi rtag pa/ /ji ltar 'di yis gsal bor dhismras/ /rig 'dzin ma ni ji ltar gsung ba thos nas bdag nyid shin tu gdung bar byed do/ /bzhad ⑤gad pas rang nyid bsams te gzhan gang yin smra'o snyam ste/ rab tu gsal bar kye gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ sbrang rtsi bsten zhing chu'i dhi'akhor rab g.yo las//chu 'dzin lho nas chu rgyun dbus su rnam 'bab pa/ /mthong nas rma bya mdongs rnams rab brkyong ⑦gar byed pa/ /na mnyam dga' ba chu rgyun do shal rnams la gzigs / /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam chu rgyun khang pa 'di nyid gcig pu'am//mngon 'dzin dngos po'i rgyu ⑧rnams ni/ /skad cig skad cig mngon par 'jig/gru byang ⑨rgyun gyi khang pa bzhin/ /'gro ba thams cad de bzhin 'jug /rig 'dzin ma ni snying brtan par byas la⑫/ gzhan yang mnyan par bya'o snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa bdag gi gnas la rnam par bsams te/ gdung ba ⑪sreg pa'i mya ngan grol nus rnams/ /blangs te gang dang gang ni 'dir smras kyang / /sbyin sreg mar rgyun 'bab bzhin de dang de/ /lhag par shin tu yongs su 'bar bar byed/ /de bas 'dir dgon pa stong par ngu bar bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas mngag gzhug ⑫ma rab tu zhugs nas/ lha mo 'od kyi blo gros mas/ bdag la bka' bsgos te bag ma'i bkra shis kyi dra ba 'di gzhon nu la khyen te 'ongs so/ /94—1464

gzhon nu ni de nas yongs su 'chag cing mchis so/ /drung du phyin te nye bar btud nas phyag byas te gzhon nu rgyal bar gyur cig rgyal bar gyur cig /lha mo'i bkas bkra shis kyi dra ba 'di blo dang ldan pa khyod kyis nges par byen cig ces so/ /rig 'dzin ma ni mi bzod par gyur①/ a e 'dir gang bag mar byas sam snyam mo/ /de bzhad gad pas bzung ste/ yongs su g.yogs so/ /mngag gzhug ②ma shin tu dga' ste/ e ma lha mo mngon par 'dod pa yid kyi shing rta shin tu yang nges so zer nas/ yongs su zhugs nas song ngo / /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam skabs med par ①'di bzhin bkra shis kyi dra ba bskur ba ci zhig /bzhad gad ma nas ④de sems so/ /'dren pas yang dris pa na/ bzhad gad pa nas/ bdag gi tshig gang zhig yal bar mi 'dor na smra'o—/ /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam smros dang / bzhad gad pa nas/ khyod yongs su len pa'o/ /rig ⑤'dzin ma ni sdug bsngal te/ e ma dga' ba'i grogs mo'i lus rdzogs pa ni/ ji ltar mthong snyam mo/ /'dren pas/ de dag gi dhisems la bltas nas/ ci ste bdag yongs su len pa yin nam/bzhad gad pas/ shin tu'o/ /'dren dze+epa nas/ 'di bzhin byed pa ji ltar bzhad gad pa nas/ 'di bkra shis dra ba la dris/ 'dren pa nas/ na mnyam yongs su len pa zhes bya ba ni sman ⑧med pa'i nad yin⑨/ 'di lta ste/gti mug skye mched 'dzin pa zhi ba 'thor zhing phyir log sgrub par byed/ /rnam g.yo'i yid 'ong myos pa'i gnas dang bsam gtan gyis ⑩ni gdug pa'i dgra/ /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas bde ba 'joms byed sdig pa'i rang bzhin gnas yin te//yongs 'dzin gdong ⑪bzhin blo ldan rnams kyang nyon mongs dang ni nyams par 94byed1465

byed—/ / rig 'dzin ma ①ngu zhing gzhan ci zhig lta snyam mo/ /'dren pa nas gzhan yang na mnyam/ /yongs su 'dzin pa byas gyur kyang / /bdag ni nags su 'gro bar byed/ /de nas ②skye bo gzhan rnams kyang / /yongs su sdug bsngal ci zhig bya/ /rig 'dzin ma ⑦ni dga' ba'i grogs mo gzhon nu'i rjes su 'di bzhin 'jug na/ legs so snyam mo/ /bzhad ④gad pa nas/ kye ji ltar 'di bzhin der ni 'jigs bcas 'bab/ /mi dbang gtsug ni 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba yis/ /zhabs la btud dang rgyal po'i phun tshogs yongs spangs nas//khyod ni nags na ⑤gnas pa ci'i phyir rab tu bsngags/ /'dren pa nas rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas las gzhan gang zhig kyang mchis sam gzigs mdzod/ ji ltar der ni dga' 'gyur rab dga'i sa gzhi rnams dang ni/ /mtho ris gang bā rnams kyi skyed dhipas byang sa gor ma'i steng / /gang zhig dga' zhing dga' ba'i ri dwags tshogs rnams bsnyen bkur zhing / /grogs nges nags kyi nang du gnas gyur pa ni skal ba bzang / /gzhan yang na mnyam/ spong ba'i brag ri skye bos dben zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas bzang na/ /phug yangs ⑦ri dwags rnams kyi spyod yul nags kyi ri mos yongs su bskor/ /so ga'i dus ni ⑧bung ba rnams ni rnga sgra snyan par rab sgrogs shing / /lam zhugs nyon mongs me yang bdag cag rnams la 'byung mi 'gyur zhes sgogs/ /rig 'dzin ma ni kye ma shin tu phyi mo zhig smras so snyam mo/ /bzhad ⑨gad pa nas/ kye snying rje med pa ji ltar gnyen 'dun ⑩gyi skye bo rnams la mnyes gshin pa'ang khyod la mi 'dug go//'dren pa nas/ 'jig rten gyi gnyen la de bzhin du mnyes gshin pa ni/'di lta ste/ 'jig rten thams cad mar me bzhin/ /skad cig skad cig gis 94—1466

skye zhing / /snum chags dbang gis ①'jig cing 'khor/ /skye ba med dag mya ngan 'da'/ /gzhan yang na mnyam mnyes gshin pa'i/ /rtsa bar mi shes pa las te/ /mi shes rdul gyis g.yogs gyur pa'i/ /sngon las sa bon ma zad las//sred pa'i chu yis dbang bsgyur skenas/ /skye ba'i myu gu skye bar 'gyur/ /rig 'dzin ma ni/ nye bar dul ba 'di 'dra ba ni/ thub pa'i skye bo la yang ga la snyam mo/ /bzhad khrugad pa nas/ gang yang 'dir re zhig 'jig rten pa'i chos kyi rjes su yang 'jug par ④mdzod cig /'dren pa nas/ 'jig rten gyi chos gang ⑤yin bzhad gad pa nas/ yul gyi rjes su mngon par dga'o/ /'dren pa nas/ yul gyis chog chog gzigs mdzod/ yul ni dug bzhin zos tsam nyid na 0mngar ldan cing / /rnam par smin pa rab tu tsha ba dug bzhin yul//yul ni dug bzhin bsrung bar mi ⑦nus rab g.yo'i shugs/ /shin tu rmongs byed mun pa stug po dug bzhin yul/ /yang na 'dod pa'i dug dang dug ni gzhal zhig ⑧brtags gyur na/ /rang bzhin mi mtshungs yul las dug ni mchog yin te/ /dug gis skye ba gcig nyid dug tu ⑨rab 'gro zhing / /skye ba dpag med du yang yul dug ⑩rab tu 'gro/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye re zhig bu'i gdong mthong bar mdzod dang / de nas nags su lhan cig tu 'gro bar bya'o/ /'dren pa nas/ 'di ni mi rnyed do/ /dper na bya ba 'di ni spang du di ring phyin nas ⑪shol byed pa/ /de 'dir skad cig yud ⑫tsam 'das gyur skye bo rtog byed de/ /mi bzad gshin rje khros pa dgod ⑫cing yongs su rtog pa'i/ /zur gyis blta bas be con mdangs kyang rab tu dmar bar byed/ /rig 'dzin ma ni ngu zhing kye ma grogs mo dga' ma/ bdag gis 'di bzhin du 'jig rten pha 94—1467

rol du yang khyod kyi sngon du 'gro zhing lam bstan par bya'o zhes rang nyid smra'o/ /bzhad gad pa ngu zhing / kye 'khor gyi skye bo thams cad spang ①ba ni snying rje ba yang sted dam/ 'dren pa nas/ bdag gis ②rang gi lus kyang yongs su gtong bar byed do/ /bzhad gad pa nas ci'i phyir gtong ④/ /'dren pa nas/gzhan gyi don du'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ de khyod bdag gi ④bya ba btang nas—/ ci ste gzhan gyi bya ba la bdag nyid la sdug bsngal byed/ /'dren pa nas—/ dman pa bdag nyid ma shes pa dud 'gro rnams kyang gnas dang zas skom rang byung ⑤spyod cing rnyed par sla/ /gang zhig 'dod rnyed shin tu skom tshe chu rnams kyang ni 'thung bar byed/ /gang zhig gzhan phan don du brtson 'grus rtsom rjobyed skyes bu de yi ni/ /rang gi gzi brjid kyis ni bde byed 'di ni skyes bu chen po'o/ /rig 'dzin ma ni snying gi dbugs phyung ngo / /snyam nas skabs rnyed de/ srog thag ran gyis ⑦bcings pa'i mtshan nyid ⑧grol lo snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye ci'i phyir bu ⑨khyod gzhan don sgrub par byed/ 'dren pa nas/ gzhan don gyi ri mo mngon par mi shes pa gzigs mdzod/ /gang zhig ngal med rta mgyogs kyis ⑩bgrod nyi mas snang bar byed/ /gang zhig khur grangs med par nor ldan rtag tu 'jig rten 'dzin/ /de ni nam yang rang don ma yin de yi rang bzhin nyid/ /chen po gang rnams 'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i ro gcig ro dang ldan/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye de bzhin du khyod ni bdag gi ma yin ⑩bram ze'i don nam ⑫gzhan gyi don lhag pa zhig yod do snyam mo//'dren pa nas snying rje yun ring du ma reg pa yin no/ /bdag mtshon skye bo nang du gdung bas bsreg ldan pa/ /gnyen bshes 'jig rten sdug bsngal gnas pa 94—1468

ci ①phyir bde/ /'jig rten kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag gi lus kyis dze+ekhyar/ /dam pa mnar med gnas pa yang ni spro bar byed/ /rig 'dzin ma ni mngon 'dod kyi skabs rnyed do snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye 'jig rten thams cad de bzhin du khyod kyi gnyen yin nam/ 'dren pa nas/ na mnyam de bzhin te/ gang gi mngal du dang po bcings shing gnas/ /gang gi pang du bag ma'i tsha zhing rtses①/ /gang zhig rnam bral mtshan rings mya ngan byas/ /'jig rten 'di rnams sngon nas gnyen bshes tshogs/ /rig 'dzin ma ni/kye ma 'di'i thugs ni ④shin tu rgya che'o snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ gnyen 'dun 'jig rten rnams kyi don mdzad pa la de las ci'i phyir ring du sdod par byed ces zer ro/ /rig 'dzin ma ni ⑤legs par smras so snyam mo/ /'dren pa ni shugs nar zhes phyung nas don 'dod pa'i skye bo shin tu rnyed par dka'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ don bya bar smra ba ni gang / 'dren pa nas/ lus la sogs pa cung zad slong ba'o/ /bzhad dhigad pa nas/ don bya ba'i skye bo rnams kyi nang nas lhag par che ba gang yin/ /rig 'dzin ma ni/ legs par dris so snyam mo/ /'dren pa nas/ gang zhig sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i skyabs gnas so/ /rig 'dzin ma ni shin tu dga' nas 'dir mngon par 'dod pa'i skabs rnyed do snyam nas/ 'tsher bzhin du nye bar btud de/phyag 'tshal nas/ ngu bzhin du bdag ni shin tu mnar bar byur pas skyabs gnas so/ /mthu chen po bdag ni skal ba dman te rjes su brtse bar mdzod cig/'dren pa ni shin tu mnyes te gzigs nas/ bzang mo ma 'jigs shig /bdag ni 'jig rten kun gyi gnyen du gnas/ /'gro rnams don grub mtshan du 94—1469

nye bar bcings/ /ma 'jigs ma 'jigs mi dkar mig can ma/ /di ring ci sgrub bdag la myur du spros/ /bzhad gad pa ni ya mtshan du gyur nas/ /e ma gzugs bzangs ①rab tu mdzes pa rkyang ②pa 'di ga las yin snyam mo/ /'dren pa nas/ don gang bya ba spros shig /rig 'dzin ma ni mgo bstod ①de chags pas bltas ④nas mthu chen po khyod kyi lus so/ /bzhad gad pa ⑤mi bzod cing dga' nas/ 'di ni ji ltar gdug pa can gyi rig 'dzin ma lta bu'o/ /de re zhig smrar chug snyam mo/ /gsal por smras pa/ kye na mnyam phar zur phar zur/'di ni gdug pa can gyi sring mo ste/ 'dis na mnyam dga' ba lus slong bar byed do snyam mo/ /rig 'dzin tshum 'jigs nas/ bdag nyid bsams pa/ ji ltar 'dis bdag gzhan du shes te/ bdag gi grogs mo dga' ma'i don shin tu 'grub pa lha mo ⑦'ga' zhig gis ⑧gzhan du bcos so snyam mo/ /'dren pa mnyes nas lus rab tu slong ba la ⑨sring mo de srid nas sgobs pa can gyi skye bo slong ⑩mo pa bdag gi ⑪mthong ngo snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa ni/ dbyug pa'i shing phyar te phar song phar song sring mo gdug pa can gyi skye bo slong ⑫mo pa bdag gis mthong ngo snyam mo/ /na mnyam dga' bas chen po'i dkyil 'khor thams cad las lhag pa'i rgyal srid kyi khur ⑫'khur bar nus pa'i lus slong bar ⑫byed dam zhes smra/ ⑫ji ltar slong ba'i skye bo sun 'byen par byed ces bzhad gad pa rgyab tu byas nas shin tu dga' nas bzang mo bdag gi lus slong bar byed pa de de bzhin du ⑩bden nam/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ mthu chen po gzhan du nus shing smra ba ma yin no/ /khyod ⑩kyi lus mthong ba tsam gyis kyang gang gi gdung ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad na de yis bdag la gnas par mdzod cig /94—1470

'dren pa ni mi dga' bar gyur te/ spobs can ①gang las gnod byed 'di①/ /re zhig bdag gi skal ba min/ /mngon 'dod bdag gis bsgrub bya ba/ /de ltar ①na yang ci zhig spros/ /rig 'dzin ma ngu zhing / bdag gi yid gcugs ④grogs mo ni/ /mgo bo zug rngu dang ldan te/ /de'i mthu chen po khyed kyis ⑤mthong ba las gtong ste/ nye bar zhi ba gzhan med do/ /bzhad gad pa shin tu 'jigs nas/ kye 'di ni sgyu ma sprul nas gzhan du smra bar byed de/ gzhan du de bzhin 'di yis 'chos shing ston par byed do/ /'dren pa ni/ de'i gtam yang mi nyan par khyed kyi yid gcugs rjogrogs mo gang na gnas/ rig 'dzin ma nas/ 'di ni de bzhin du ri bo gangs ldan gyi rtse ⑦la gnas so/ /'dren pa nas/ rol ba'i ri bo'i zhol nyid sgedu/ /bos nas bdag cag der ⑨re zhig 'gro'o/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ ci ste mthu chen po 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'gro zhing 'dren pa rnyed par dka' ba ci yang ma mchis so zhes gnyis po gar byed cing nam mkha' la song ngo / /bzhad gad pa nas/ khyed cag rab tu zhugs te/ bdag bram ze ni slar yang dri ma lhag ma bsnyil ba bzhin du yongs su spangs so zhes smra/ 'dren pa nas/ na mnyam khyod rang yang longs ⑩mdzod/ bzhad gad pa bdag nyid 'jigs par mthong nas rig 'dzin ma 'dzum zhing bzhad gad pa'i lag pa nas bzung nas yongs su zhugs so/ /'dren pa ni ya mtshan che nas grogs po ltos ltos/ nyi ma'i gzugs ni nges lhung rnam par 'jug pa bzhin/ /sa chen ri bo dang bcas 'og tu 'gro ba ltar/ /ta ma la yi nags tshal sngon po'i 'gram rnams ni/ /chu 'dzin rab tu bsal gyur ri mos mtha' rnams bskor⑪/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye khyod kyi ya mtshan che 94—1471

yang bdag ni bram ze ste/ 'di nyid du ri ①gang zhig la brten nas chu snod bzung nas bsod snyoms la brten nas/ khad kyis 'gro'o zhes zer/ 'dren pa nas ma 'jigs par re zhig ya mtshan che ba ltos shig dang / ri bo khang bzang ②'dra zhing chu 'dzin g.yo ba'i bla re la brten pa/ /chu klung ngur pa'i sgog gis 'gram bcings lam chen rdul rnams 'thul pa ltar/ /chu gter yongs su bskor ba'i 'obs chen bzhin du rab mtho'i 'gram ldan pa/ /sa chen dkyil 'khor gnas gcig bzhin du yang dag gsal bor kun nas mtshon/ /rig 'dzin ma nas a ho gzhon nus nye bar gzigs so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/gting zab mo 'jigs pa'i 'og gi sa chen po'i mthil mthong nas/ bdag nyid nges par 'jigs par snang nas gzugs gzhan la steng du bltas pa dang /shin tu 'jigs te/ kye gangs ri'i rtse mo tshogs pa bzhin du nam mkha'i mthil khengs nas 'jug pa 'di ci zhig yin/ rig 'dzin ma rnam par gnod ①cing /a ho bram ze 'di ni mtshan nyid yin no/ /'dren pas gzigs nas 'di ni nges par skar ma rnams so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ skar ma la 'di 'dra ba'i tshad gang ④la yin/ 'dren pa nas/ de ni 'di bzhin du ⑤rgya chen po'i tshad dang ldan no/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ sa'i mthil nas chu ngur dhimatshon pa ji ltar yinarka/ 'dren pa nas/ de yang ring po nas shin tu phra zhing / rnam par mjes so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ yang dze+emi rtsang bar 'jug pa ji ltar yin/'dren pa nas/ bdag cag shin tu mthon por gnas kyang mi rtsang ba bzhin no//bzhad ⑧gad pa nas/ yang 'di nyin par mi mthong ba ji ltar yin/ 'dren pa nas/ nye bar btud na nyin par kyang ⑨'di bzhin mthong ngo / /rig 94—1472

'dzin ma nas/ gzhon nus 'di rnams thams cad sngon gzigs pa snyam byed do| /bzhad ①gad pa nas/ kye na mnyam dga' ba chu gter gyi rlabs rnams las rlung drag pas rab tu bskyod pa bzhin du ka la'i sgra sgrogs pa'ang 'di ji ltar ④lags| 'dren pa nas/ brtags nas 'di ni nam mkha' chu klung gang gā'i sgra ste/ 'di lta ste/ lhag ma nyal ba bzhin du chu klung rnam spangs lha lam mthong ba'i phung po las/ /phyogs kyi glang chen rnams ni rtse zhing sna yis chu 'thor thigs pa zer ma rnams/ /yang dag tshim pa skye 'gyur chu thigs mu tig 'bras bu'i 'od zer mjos pa ltar/ /drang srong bdun po rnams ni gser gyi pad+ma 'dzin cing khrus la rab tu 'jug /drang srong bdun po 'di rnams ni phyag bya ba'i 'os so zhes thams cad kyis phyag byas so/ /yol ba'i nang du'o/ /'jig rten kun gyi phan mdzad phyir/ /gzhan yang gtsug gi rin chen ltar/ /bud med rin chen rin chen bu/ /mtshungs ③pa yang dag thob gyur cig /rig 'dzin ma shin tu dga' ste/ 'di rnams ma rmongs pa'i tshig gis ji lta ba bzhin du mchog sbyin no snyam mo/ /bzhad ④gad pa nas/ kye na mnyam 'di yis mkha' la 'gro ba'i stebs ⑤kyis bdag cag yongs su phyin te/ de nas 'dir nam mkha'i gang shā la yud tsam cig ngal bso cig dhizer ro/ /snyan ngag tshogs rnams gru yis snyan par rab sgrogs bskyed pa'i gnas/ /chags bral kun gyis sgrogs shing brjod pa de ni rgyal bar byed/ /gang gis rang nyid rnam phyung ⑦rnam gshegs gzings kyi yal ga yi/ /lugs las nye bar blangs nas tsan+d+ra go mis rab tu sbyar/ /zhes pas rab tu zhugs so/ /thams cad kyi yan lag gnyis pa rdzogs so// //94—1473

de nas sbrang gi bu mo rab tu zhugs te/ ngu zhing rin chen phreng ba ma/ /'di nas song nas nyi ma 'di tsam gyi bar du ji ltar bdag gis pad+ma ba tī ①dbugs phyung ngo / /di ring na ni sdelhag par yang mgo bo'i gzugs ①yang dag skyes so / /④rin chen phreng ba ma ni gang dang gang yun ring po de dang de nas bzod par dka' zhing rgyal ba'i bde bas mig mdongs shing ⑤mchi ma 'bab cing 'jug pa ni chu thogs so bzhin du grogs mo'i snying ni shin tu gdung bar byed do/ /bdag gi don grub pa de rnams dgos pa yang mi shes te/ rin chen phreng ba ma 'ongs na yang 'bras bu med do snyam mo/ /bdag gis rab tu gdung ba'i phyir spang ba'i thabs su gyur pa mthong rjonas/ de nas grogs mo dga' ma'i drung du 'gro'o snyam mo/ /yongs su zhugs nas bltas pa na de'i grogs mo dga' ma pad+ma ba tī ⑦ni yongs su sa brtol rkang 'thung gi 'og zla ba nor bu rdo ba'i steng na thig le blo gros ma'i lus kyi steng du nye bar brten nas gnas so/ /'di ni stong pa'i mthar gcig pu gnas so ⑧zhes nye bar zhugs te⑨/ de nas pad+ma ba tī ⑩dang /thig le'i blo gros ma'ang ji ltar lta zhing rab tu zhugs pa na rang nyid bsams te shugs nar ⑩zhes phyung ngo / /legs ldan me tog mtshon can gyis kyang rang lus sreg pa'i tshor ba ji ltar shes par ma gyur te/ /shes na gzhan rnams ji ltar sreg par byed/ /sbrang gi bu mo nye bar btud de/ grogs mo dga' ma di ring mnyelaḍūbar ma gyur tam/ pad+ma ba tī ⑫ni sbar yang de bzhin du smra bar byed do//thig le blo gros ma nas/ kye pad+ma ba tī ⑫ci'i phyir gus par mi byed/ 'di ni khyod kyi ⑫dga' ba'i grogs mo'o/ /pad+ma ba tī rtab rtab por gdan ⑫gang na 94—1474

bdag gi grogs mo dga' ma rin chen phreng ba ma/ thig le bro ①gros ma nas ma ②yin te/ 'di ni sbrang gi bu mo'o/ /pad+ma ba tī ③bdag ngo tsha nas bdag ni yang dag pa'i yul chos las shin tu 'das so snyam nas/ gsal bar smras pa/grogs mo sbrang gi bu mo bdag ni shin tu gdung bas gzir bas shin tu 'khrug ④par gyur to/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ grogs mo dga' ma dbugs phyung shig ⑤skyes bu dam pa'i gtam bsil ba bzhin du pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'di rnams khyod la brlan no/ /pad+ma ba tī rjonas 'di sol cig /nor bu chu shel gyi rdo ba'i steng na yang sreg bsnyam byed do/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma khyer la shog /gnyis po nas/'dir ji ltar tsan dan gyi khu bas gtor zhing / grogs mo ⑦dga' ma khyod kyi ⑧nu ma dag gi bar na byen nas bzhag kyang de yang lhag par shin tu gdung bas gzir nas yongs su skom ⑨par byed do/ /pad+ma ba tī ni ⑩sdug bsngal nas ha la 'di rnams sol la bdag nor bu chu shel gyi rdo ba'i steng du khyer cig ces smra/gnyis po rang la bsams te ngu zhing / kye ma 'di'i sems gzhan du gyur to snyam nas gsal por smras pa/ grogs mo 'di ni ji ltar nor bu chu shel gyi ⑪rdo ba'i steng na thigs pa'i rgyun mi 'chad par rnam par 'bab pa'i zer ma 'thor zhing chags so/ /pad+ma ba tī ⑫nas 'di ni chog go/ /bdag gi ni rin chen phreng ba mas ⑫'ongs pa'i bris sku lta'i ⑫zhes smra'o/ /gnyis po phan tshun ⑫bltas te shin tu mi dga' bar gyur te/ ji ltar 'di la zug rngu yang med dam zhes gsal bar smras pa⑫/ grogs mo 'di ni ji lta ba de ⑫ni 'di'o/ /pad+ma ba tī spre)nas/yang ri mo bris pa'i gzugs brnyan de gang na zhes smra/ gnyis po nas 'di na med pa ma yin te/ khyed kyi ⑪mdun na mchis so/ /pad+ma can gyis yun 94—1475

ring ji ltar 'di ltar zug rngu yang med dam zhes gsal bar smras pa/ grogs mo 'di ni ji lta ba de ni 'di'o/ /pad+ma ba tī gnam ①du bltas nas ngu zhing bdag nyid bsams pa/ gang zhig bris sku'i gzugs brnyan 'di 'dra ba de ni kye ma brtse ba med pa'i tshig tsam la 'ga' zhig gis yang skye bo 'di rjes su brtse ba can no zhes bsgrags ②so snyam nas nam mkhar sdebaltas te/ legs ldan mda' lnga khyed rjokyis 'dir/ /mda' ni ma skyes 'gyur ba 'am/ /'di ni yon tan rjes chags pas/ /yang na 'dis bsreg mthu med dam/ /stobs med rnams dang 'drar skyes na⑤/ /dpa' mthong mngon pa'i nga rgyal lo/ /phyogs rnams su blta bar byas nas/ gzhan ci zhig lta bar byed 'dir yang 'phags pa'i bu'i bris sku la 'khyud nas/ bdag nyid nyams par byed do zhes spra/ sbrang gi bu mo langs nas/ phyogs rnams la bltas pas ji ltar 'dis dri ma med pa'i nam mkha'i mthil du bya rnam par rgyu ba yang ma rjomatshon no/ /be+er yang bltas pas/ya mtshan che nas/ grogs dga' ma ltos ltos/ 'dir glog gi ⑦ri mo rab tu 'gyed pa bzhin du dri ma med pa'i nam mkha'i khams na rnam par 'phro ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /ha la khyed gnyis kyis ci zhig ltos shig⑧ /bdag ni gdung bas non to⑨/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ ri'i rtse mos mngon par g.yogasalgepa bzhin no//de nas thig le blo gros mas nges par bltas nas/ re zhig 'di ci zhig ces thig le blo gros ma grogs mo ⑩dga' ma la smras par ⑫bya'o snyam nas nges par zhugs so//yang gzhon nu dang bcas te rin chen phreng ba ma de bzhin du 'byung bar 'gyur ro//de nas rin chen phreng ba ma dang gzhon nu dang / bzhad gad pa rnams kyang rab tu zhugs so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ sgo na mnyam gzigs gzigs/ drang 94—1476

srong gi gnas kyi mtshan nyid 'dir yang dag par 'thul ba ngu ba'i rang bzhin sbyin sreg gi du ba'i phreng bas bar snang khebs shing phan tshun dgra yongs su 'jug pa'i dud 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyang gnyen gye 'jug pa khyad par can shin tu mnyes gshin pa phun sum tshogs pa drang srong gi gnas so/ /'dren pa nas/grogs po 'dir ①ngo mtshar che ba 'di lta ste/ stag mo yang ni khong nas dul zhing mig ni rab btsums ri dwags phru gu rnams ni ldag ②par byed/ /mnyes gshin rab dga' gtsug phud can ni mdongs rnams rab brkyang lteng ka rnams ni 'tshe ba bskyab ①phyir skyong / /seng ge yang ni glang mo gang zhig song ba'i phru gu rnams ni rang gi bu bzhin srung ④bar byed/ /gang rnams kyi ni byams pa'i gnas bcas nags dang ri bo'i phug na rnam par gnas pa de rnams rgyal/ /rig 'dzin ma nges par bltas nas/ bdag gi grogs mo dga' ma'i nye 'khor du phyin no/ /'dir ni grogs mo dga' ma tsan dan rnon po shin tu chags pa zla ba bzhin du zla ba'i 'od zer byi dkyil 'khor dang 'dra bar rnam par mjes so snyam mo| /bzhad gad pa ngo mtshar che nas/ sgo ⑤na mnyam gzigs gzigs bud med 'di ni rin po che ltar 'di'i 'jam mdangs 'od zer rab tu 'bab pa skye zhing bskyang bas mnyel nas gzigs pa lta bu'o/ /'dren pas nges par gzigs nas| na mnyam pa rnams kyi dukhyad par can rnams ring du gyur pas khyod kyis mngon par ma shes te khyod rin po che dang dze+esnyam mam/ 'di'i lus la reg pa tsam/ /rin chen ⑧gzhan rnams mngon par 'dod/ /de ni rin chen lta mi byed| /rang lus de bzhin rnam brgyan pas/ /bzhad gad pa nas yid kyi shing rta'i me tog ni mthong ngo zhes so/ /pad+ma can dang sbrang gi bu mo zur gyis lta ⑨94—1477

zhing rin chen phreng ba ma ①ni shin tu ring du thogs so zhes smra/ bzhad gad pa nas—/ kye na mnyam snyan par smra ba ni 'di lta bu'o/ /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam ②pa 'di ci zhig brjod ce na/ kye gang zhig zur gyis bltas pas rnam par 'phangs gyur pa/ /yid 'ong spyan las snyan par smra ba phyogs pa ni/ /g.yo med de 'dir sa chen steng gnas myos pa'i le lo yis/ /lus la me tog la gnas pa de ltar na 'di ③sbrang rtsi'i/ /rig 'dzin ma ni byed pa po rjes 'jug par mthong ngo / /bzhad gad pa ni/ /shin tu dga' nas rang nyid bsams te/'di ni mngon par 'dod pa'i 'bras bu ste/ 'di ni ji ltar thang kha la ri mo bris pa bdag gis mthong ba de'i snyam mo/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ mthu chen po re zhig ji srid de la smra ba'i bar du mnyel so bar mdzod cig /'dren pa nas/khyod ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bya'o/ /rig 'dzin ma shin tu dga' nas nye bar song ngo / /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ grogs mo dga' ma ltos ltos/ 'di ni rin chen phreng ba ma'o/ /pad+ma can nas/ de gang na gang na zhes zer te/ sprang rtsi'i bu mo dang pad+ma can dag gis gcig pu nyid du mthong nas brgyal nas gar byed do/ /rig 'dzin ma shin tu dngangs nas/ dga' ma khyod kyi yid kyi shing rta grub bo/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ grogs mo ④dga' ma dbugs phyung shig /rig 'dzin ma nges par bltas te/ kye ma bdag skal ba dman pa da shi zin/ha dhi ha dhi 'dir su 'jug par byed ces yongs su 'khyud nas bltas so/ /kye ma skal ba dman pa yid kyi shing rta lag tu 'ongs ⑤nas yang slar 'dor bar byed dam zhes smra zhing rig 'dzin ma nas/ gzhon nu yongs su skyob par mdzod cig/'dir ni bdag gi grogs mo dga' ma mthar byed kyis gsod cing 'phrog par 94—1478

byed do/ /'dren pa ni rtab rtab por kye ma rab tu myos so/ /bzhad ①gad pa nas| na mnyam dga' ba myur du mdzod cig /gnyis po yang nye ba drung du phyin to/ /rig 'dzin ma gzhon nu'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ mthu chen po grogs mo dga' ma rjes su brtse bar mdzad du gsol/ 'dren pa ni ngo tsha zhing 'jigs pa dang bcas nas bdag ②bsgrub par bya gang / khyod kyis nye bar bsgo bar mdzod/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ rig pa kun gyi ①pha rol tu phyin par gyur pa la/ bdag gis ci zhig nye bar ston/ /de ltar na'ang re zhig mthu chen po'i phyag las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bsil ba rab tu 'bab pa las grogs mo dga' ma yongs su reg par mdzod cig /'dren pa nas pad+ma can gyi mgo la legs par ④reg nas/ zla ba bzhin 'dra 'di yis ni/ /'dir ni rnam pa nyams pa bzhin/ /dga' ba thob las rnam nyams sam/ /khyod kyi rnam nyams sdug bsngal 'phel/ /pad+ma can ni mig cung zad phye nas/ 'dren pa nas/ma la ya skyes khu ⑤ba sor mos bzhin la byugs/ /ri dwags mig can 'di ni dkyus ring mig phye ba/ /chu 'dzin rab tu dkar bas cha rnams phyed g.yogs pa//mkha' la chu 'dzin dal gyis 'gro ba zla ba'i dbyibs/ /rig 'dzin ma ni grogs mo dga' ma 'tsho bar mthong ste/ shin tu dga'o/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ a ho gzhon nu mthu'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ grogs mo dga' ma yid kyi shing rta mthong ngo / /rig 'dzin ma nas/ mthu chen pos 'di re zhig mgo bo'i zug nye bar zhi'oX/ /'di'i lus kyang phyag gi mthil gyis reg par mdzod cig /'dren pas lus rnams kyang byugs ⑦nas/ shin tu mnyes te/ mi dga' ba da chog go/ /'di ni khur gyis dub pa 'jam pa'i lus ni rab g.yo bzhin/ /94—1479

yid 'ong dri yis 'gro zhing bung ba'i gshog pas rnam bskyed ①pa/ /mtshan mo ma la ti yi me tog phreng ba byed pa ①bzhin/ /'di yi lus rnams rim gyis gsal por yang dag g.yo bar byed/ grogs mo dag nas/ grogs mo dga' ma dbugs shig dbugs shig /mthu chen pos khyod 'dir rjes su bzung ngo / /de yis gzigs nas 'dir yid kyi shing rta rang gi lus bzhin du brjod/ pad+ma can ni 'jigs shing nges par bltas te/ ngo tsha bas 'dar zhing langs nas 'bros 'dod pas ma nus te rings nas gar byed do/ /rig 'dzin ma nas grogs mo dga' ma de tsam ma rings shig /re zhig gsar du 'ongs pa la stan gcig la gnas nas bsnyen bkur bar gyis shig /'dren pa nas/ dkar min mig can 'jigs bcas khyod ni sdug bsngal ba/ /chog chog lus ni gdung bas cung zad g.yo ba can/ /me tog phreng ba cung zhig kha 'bus 'dab ma rnams//bung ba rnams kyi rkang pa yang ni bzod ①mi nus/ /pad+ma can rang nyid bsams te / ci ste 'di ni 'dir ④nags nas 'ongs sam/ yang na 'di bzhin du snang ba'am/ yang na rmi lam du snang ba'am snyam mo/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/grogs mo dga' ma 'di ni de yin te/ khyod kyis gzhon nu'i sku gzugs thang sku ni ri mor zis pa la mchod pa'i phyir ba ku la'i me tog phreng ba gang zhig nyid kyis ⑤brgyus pa'o zhes bstod do/ /pad+ma can ni 'dren pa la zur gyis blta zhing ri mo'i sku rjogazugs la de phul lo/ /'dren pas ri mo bltas ⑦nas 'di ni kho bo bzhin du ri mor bris pa zhig go/ /ha a ⑧ho bdag la gus pa cher mchis so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ khyod kyi lha rnams gus pas bsnyen bkur bas da ltar de khyod la 'di bzhin du'o/ /'dren pa nas/ ji ltar 'di bzhin du'o/ /94—1480

bzhad gad pa nas/ lha rnams kyang gus pas bsnyen bkur nas mchog gsol bar byed do/ /khyod ni dka' thub ma'i mngon par 'dod pa'i ①gang yang sbyin ②mi byed do/ /grogs mo dga' nas ③legs par smras so/ /'dren pa ni 'dzum zhing khyod kyis de bzhin du ④mchog ster shes sam/ bzhad gad pa nas/ gal te khyod bdag gi rjes su 'jug na ⑤bram ze yin pas sbyin par bya'o/ /'dren pa nas—/ bdag gi 0rjes su 'jug par bya⑦/ bzhad gad pas dze+ekhyod de bzhin du 'di'i mchog tu bdag gis sbyin/ 'dren pa nas khyod ni tha shal rmongs pa rab tu mi ⑨shes pa'o/ /bzhad ⑩gad pa nas/ khyod ni shin tu mi bzod do/ /'dren pa nas/ na mnyam rab tu gsal ba'i dgongs pa la yang 'dis shin tu sbyin par byed de gzigs mdzod/ /bdag ni rab tu brkyang ⑪la tshul 'chos lus ni ngo tshas sdud byed cing ⑫/ /yid 'ong mig ni gsal por 'phangs shing skad cig nyid la slong bar byed/ /bdag ni mi bzod lta bas blta zhing slar yang mngon 'dod 'dren par byed/ /byis pa'i blo yi dgongs pa rab tu spro zhing g.yo yang 'dir mi byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /yol ba'i nang du'o/ /ca co chen po zhig grags so⑫/ /thams cad 'jigs nas nye bar langs so/ /bzhad ⑫gad pas nye bar bltas nas 'di ni gang nas glang chen myos pa yang dag rgyug byed cing / /'dir ni ji ltar shugs kyis ⑫mi bzad sna yi 'khyel byas nas/ /chu rnams 'phen pa char 'bab bzhin du stobs kyis ⑫rab tu 'jug /gdong la myos 'bab dri la sbrang rtsi byed rnams rjes su 'jug /yol ba la ca co ⑩smra'o/ /bzhad gad pa ni shin tu 'jigs te kye na mnyam yongs su skyob par mdzod ces smra'o—/ /pad+ma can ni shin tu 'jigs te/ gzhon nu la kun nas 'khyud do/ /⑫94—1481

grogs mo dag nas/ mthu chen po grogs mo dga' ma bsrung ①bar mdzod cig zer| 'dren pa nas ma 'jigs shig /'jigs ldan ma dul glang chen myos//so ldan gnam lcags mche ba can/ /bdag gi brang gis ②de mtshungs par/ /rtag tu rab gsal 'di bzung ngo / /rig 'dzin ma nas/ da ni 'jigs pa ⑦'di ga la byung / yol ba'i nang ④nas/ 'jigs pa rnams kyi mi 'jigs rab sbyin sa gsum rab tu tshim byed khyod ni gnyen/ /sdug bsngal chu gter ⑤klong 'khrugs rjo'agro rnams yang dag sgol ba'i gzings nyid do/ /khyod kyi phyag ni rab tu gsal ba'i rgyan gyis rol zhing kun 'khril so ldan po/ /gtum zhing ⑦g.yo bas 'jig rten ma lus 'dir ni skrag pa'i gnas skabs ga la 'gyur/ /gzhon nu nas/ kye dga' ma bdag thong zhig /glang po gtum ⑧po ni song /rig 'dzin ma dgod ⑨cing di ring yang khyod gang du yang mi gtong ngam/gzhon nu rang bzhin ⑩bsams te/ gal te bdag 'di lta bu'i ⑪gnas skabs su 'ga' zhig mthong bar mi 'gyur ram/ bdag ⑫ni tshul dang 'dra ba ma yin no snyam nas/ de nas drang srong gi slob ma rab tu zhugs so/ /rtab rtab por kyi ma ji ltar ri dwags kyi rigs rnams ⑫kyang 'di dang ⑫der shin tu skrag pas rab tu 'jug cing sems ni dngangs ⑫par gyur/ glang chen rab tu 'jigs pas thub pa'i gzhon nu rnams kyang gsal por ngu bar gyur/ pad+ma ba tī ⑫ni gang du song ngam snyam nas yongs su zhugs so/ /mthong nas shin tu mi bzod pas—/ a tshangs pa kye/ a tshangs pa kye ji ltar ⑫dka' thub kyi tshal na 'gal bar 'jug go zhes smra/ thams cad shin tu 'jigs te/ grogs mo dga' ⑫nas/ ji ltar 'phags pa'i spyod pa'i bu'o/ /pad+ma can ni gzhon nu 94—1482

btang ste/ ngo tsha nas kha 'og tu phyogs nas gnas so/ /yol ba'i nang du'o/ /'di lag ldan gyi 'jigs pas bdag gis pad+ma ba tī ①nas 'byung zhes drang srong ngus so/ /slob ma ni ngu zhing mkhan po yongs su skyob par mdzod cig /yongs su skyob par mdzod cig② /pad+ma ba tī ni 'di na ①yongs su sun 'byin par byed cing mchis so/ /grogs mo dag shin tu 'jigs shing shin tu mi phan par gyur to snyam mo/ /gzhon nu ni mi mthun pa'i mtshan nyid sdug bsngal bar bdag lhung ngo snyam mo/ /bzhad gad pa ni mi bzod par a re e ④re bram ze gdug pa can mi bden pa smra zhing ci'i phyir khyod ngu zhes dbyug pa'i shing gyen du phyar te nye bar btud do/ /bram ze ni a tshangs pa kye mkhan po yongs su skyob par mdzod ces smra/ de nas thub pa ni khros⑤/ rab tu zhugs nas ā rjo'adi su zhig ⑦nges par bltas nas/ lag pa ⑧dang rkang par bcas par ⑨rdobs shing / lha rnams thams cad stongs sam ci⑩/ /dmod pa rnams ni yal gyur tam / /gang zhig thub pa'i rigs rnams kyang / /kun nas gnod cing yongs su 'jig /ces smra/ kye bu pad+ma ba tī ⑩e ma gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu la pad+ma bdag gi ⑫yid kyi sbyin par byas te gdung bar byed do/ /gzhon nu nas| legs pa'i drang srong chen po gang / /bdag phyir de bzhin rjes gdung ba/ /kun spyod khrims las 'das gyur na/ /skyes bu pad+ma can ⑫bzhin gdung / /bdag las kun spyod rnams 'gal nas⑫/ /'di ni lha rnams kyis ⑫mkhyen 'gyur/ /bzhad gad pa shin tu 'jigs nas gnas skabs 'dir ci zhig smra| lha rnams kyi/ drang srong nas/ thub pa'i skye bo'i lha rnams ni gang dang gang / bzhad gad pa nas/ bram ze g.yo ⑫can phar song phar song /94—1483

mkhan po las mthu che ba'i lha gang zhig kyang ①yod dam/ drang srong nas/ lha rnams da lta nyid du sa stengs lhung sdebar bya 'am ci/ /chu gter rab tu rgyu ba skad cig nyid la skam mam ci/ /bskal pa'i me ni 'od zer 'bar bas rtswa rnams ma lus pa/ /sreg pa bzhin du 'jig rten rnams ni thal bar bya 'am ci/ /rig 'dzin ma rang nyid bsams te/ ji srid 'di ni mthong dug bzhin/ /'di yi ④dmod dug ma grol ba/ /de srid 'dir ni bdag gis ni/ /nyes rnams rab tu gsal bar bya/ /snyam mo/ /nye bar btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ /yab gcig gnang bar mdzod gnang bar mdzod/ 'dir pad+ma ba tī ④dgon pa'i glang po che myos pas gsod pa las/ mthu chen po 'dis bskyabs pa'o/ /drang srong nas/ 'di yang su zhig yin/ bzhad gad pa 'jigs bzhin du/lha tshangs pas byin gyi ⑤gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu'o/ /drang srong nas 'di ni gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu duyin pa de bden nam zhes nges par bltas nas ngus sorka/ /the tshom ni mchog ⑦go/ /'di ni mtshungs med dpal dang ldan/ /rtags kyang nor bus rnam par spras/ /ji ltar dpag bsam ljon pa ni/ /bdag gis dug gi sdong por shes/ /thams cad du/ bdag dman ⑧mi bzod mi shes pa/ /bdag dman shin tu mngon 'dod la/ /gang zhig mi shes dbang gis ni/ /bdag gis stisdig pa mngon par byas/ /thal mo sbyar nas kye mag pa skye bo las thos ⑩pas/ nyes par byas pa 'di rnams bzod par mdzod cig /mi shes pa'i dbang gis nye bar ⑩byas so/ /bzhad gad pa ni bram ze 'tsho'i snyam mo/ /gzhon nu ⑫nas gong ma rnams la nyes pa ma mchis so/ /bram ze dga' nas/ bzhad gad pa la 'khyud de/ phan tshun khyod kyang bzod par 94—1484

mdzod cig ces so/ /drang srong nas/ a ho gzhon nu ni bstan pa'o/ /bu mo pad+ma ba tī kye/ /de ①ring ngo tsha yang chog par mdzod/ /srog chags dbang phyug bdag por gyur/ /yang dag pas ni spro bar gyis/ /gzhon nu rang nyid bsams pa yin/ /'di'i skabs ni 'dir glo ②bur du byung ngo snyam nas/gsal por smras pa kye legs ldan rjes su bsgo bar mdzod cig /bdag phyi ①ba dag gis zhes pa'i ④dus 'das 'go ⑤bar byed do/ /drang srong nas/ lag pa'i chu 'dzin gang bar gyis la khyod dang btsun mo gnyis kar gshegs shig /gzhon nus rnam par bsams te legs ldan bdag ni rgyal rigs so/ /drang srong nas/ 'di yang yid kyi mtsho yi ni/ /chu skyes sbubs las yang dag byung / /bzhad gad pa nas/ de bzhin bdag cag gis kyang thos so/ /'dren pa nas/legs ldan bdag la phyi ba dag rjogis rjes su gnas pa med do/ /bzhad gad pa nas| 'di 'ba' zhig ma yin pa rjes su gnang ba ni ri mo 'ongs nas bag mar byas pa ni 'di'o/ /drang srong nas/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig med dam/'dren pa ni/ 'dren pa nas/ ngo tsha ba ⑦dang bcas so/ /drang srong nas 'di ci zhig /'dren pa nas de ltar ro/ /drang srong nas/ de ltar 'gyur ba ci yin/ 'dren pa nas/ kye 'di nyid do/ /bzhad gad pa ngu zhing / kye khyod la chags par gyur pa'i srog ma bsrungs sken da ni ji ltar drang srong gi rigs thams cad de bzhin du stongs par 'gyur ro/ /rig 'dzin ma ngu zhing / da ni thams cad 'dis phyir spong bar byed do/ /drang srong ni ngu zhing byed kyi ⑨lus dang 'dra ba ⑩'dis ji ltar tshangs par spyod kyang 'joms par byed dam/ gal te khyod kyis de bzhin du bdag cag rnams la dga' ba mthong ba las/ slar 94—1485

yang gzhan du byed par 'gyur zhing / bdag la 'dir chen pos yongs su sun 'byin cing de yis bdag 'dir chen por yongs su bslu zhing bsreg nas/bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i skye bo rnams dang ni me'i nang du rang nyid sbyin sreg du bya'o/ /kye 'di na su su/ me khyer la shog shig /bram ze nas/bdag gi ni lta ba mi bzod pas/ sngon du me'i nang du rab tu 'jug par byed do//bzhad gad pa rang nyid kyis ①bsams pa/ byed kyi de nyid legs so/ /'dren pa nas rang nyid bsams te/ thams cad kyis yang dag par brdzun ②par byed do snyam mo/ /gsal por smras pa/ legs ldan dag ②bdag ni gnas gang zhig /cung zad mi sbyin zhes bya med/ /ci'i phyir shin tu snying rje bas| /de'i phyir bdag ni yongs su sgong / /pad+ma can ni 'dis bdag de bzhin du byas nas ④mchog tu yang dga'o snyam nas/ drang srong nas byed dang bu mo pad+ma can lhan cig tu chos spyod cing dug ni mi spyod/ bzhad gad pa nas/khyod kyis ⑤slar yang bdag kyang mi grol ba ma yin nam/ 'dren pa nas/khyod ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs shig /bzhad dugad pa dang bram ze dag gar byed do/ /rig 'dzin ma ni bdag gis brtsams pa'i ⑦don grub snyam mo/ /pad+ma can ni byed pa pos bdag rjes su bzung ngo snyam mo/ /drang srong nas/chos mdon pa dang brtse ba yis/ /gtsug na nor bus bdag bzhin du/ /ri dbang mag par ⑧byas kyang ni/ /ri bo dran gyur de bzhin min/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi khang par zhugs te cho ga rnams ji lta ba bzhin du bsams te/ byin gyis brlabs nas thams cad yongs su zhugs so/ /drang srong ni phyogs rnams su nyi ma'i dus tshod du song ngam/ bltas nas 'di lta ste/ dus su song zhing bi tsu ⑨94—1486

la'i nags tshal tshogs rnams sngo zhing chu klung 'gram gyi ri mo las/ /glang ①chen rigs rnams gnyid kyis myos shing mig ni zum ②byed ri sul gnas rnams su ni 'gro bar byed/ /shal ma tī rnams kyi ni yal ga sgra bcas sdud cing bcag nas khur ba rnams ni skyes pa yis/ /thub pa rnams kyi sems ni tshim byed yid 'phrog gu gul phye ma'i dri bzangs phyogs bcur ⑦khyab par gyur/ /'di ni skye bo dam ④pa rnams kyi zla ba btsun pa zla ba yis/ /mchog tu gsal bar rab sbyar gar gyi sa gzhir gar mdzad gar tshogs kyis/ /gang gis ⑤legs par 'dren byed chags pa dang bral rgyal ba rnams kyi ni/ /yum gyur rtogs pa mchog gi rin chen bla med de ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni thams cad nges par zhugs so/ /yan lag gsum pa rdzogs be+e// //de nas sbrang gi bu mo 0rab tu zhugs te/ ngu zhing grogs mo dga' ma pad+ma can gyis ni de nishelo gcig lhag song ste/ bdag skal ba dman pas grogs mo dga' ma slar mthong bar 'gyur mi 'gyur ni mi shes so/ /dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'di na thub pa'i skye bos rab tu gang yang bdag ni stong pa snyam du sems so//de la ji ltar bdag gisnyegadung ba bsal bar bya/ yang nas phyogs stong par zhugs nas drag por ngu bar bya'am snyam ste/ 'di ni nges pa'i don du slar bya'o snyam nas yongs su zhugs so/ /skyed mos tshal 'di na sar+sā na'i ljon pa 'di ni grogs mo dga' ma byis pa'i dus su yang dag par bsgrun pa gang yin pa de ni 'di'o/ /mā ta bī 'khri shing kyang 'di'o/ /bdag ni skal ba dman te lhan cig tu byas nas grogs mo dga' ma pad+ma can gyis khyad par du nye bar bskyed pa'o 94—1487

zhes yang dag par 'khyud nas ngu zhing grogs mo dga' ma ni gang du song / byed rnams kyang 'dir ①me tog kha 'bus par rigs sam/ yang na de bzhin grogs mo dga' ma yang nges par 'khrungs par gyur tam zhes rtogs par byed do/ /ji ltar 'di bzhin du thos te shing rnams kyang mtshungs par mjos par smra'o snyam mo//yol ba'i nang du'o/ /a ho rmad du byung ba chen po 'khrungs snyam nas/ sbrang gi bu mos bltas pa na/ ji ltar bram ze muspru'i bu de nas rab tu zhugs nas a ho chen po 'khrungs so/ /sbrang gi bu mo nye bar btud nas/ 'phags pa muñdza'i bu la phyag byas so/ /muñdza shin tu dga' nas mthong ba'i bde legs 'phel bar gyur cig /khyod kyi grogs mo dga' ma pad+ma can la da zhig btsas so/ /sbrang gi bu mo shin tu dga' nas/ muñdza'i bu byed kyis bdud rtsi'i char phab bo /yang de'i ming cir brjod cing byen gyis brlabs/ muñdza nas/ pad+ma skyes zhes so—/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ dga'o dga'o/ /muñdza ②nas/ 'di 'ba' zhig las yang gzhan med dam/ sprang gi bu mo nas/ 'di yang yin mod/ yang gzhan dga' ba ci zhig /muñdza ①nas/ de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byen gyis ge 'i bzhin mthong nas mnyes te/ lha gtsug ④na nor bu rgyal srid la dbang bskur ro/ /sbrang gi bu mo nas/ ho dga'o dga'o/ /muñdza ⑤nas/ de nas 'od kyi blo gros ma dang / rgyal po tshangs pas byin gnyis dka' thub kyi tshal du gshegs shing bskyod do/ /de nas gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu'ang yab kyi rjes su 'jug cing gshegs so/ /sbrang gi bu mo ni ngu zhing muñdza'i rjobu bdag gi dga' ma'ang de bzhin nam zhes smra/ muñdza ⑦nas/ gtam lhag ma ma lus pa smra ba rna ba la zhog cig dang / de nas rgyal po tshangs pas ⑧byin gyis gzhon nu'i skyo 94byed1488

ba yongs su bsal ba'i phyir rang gi ①pho brang gi skyed mos tshal du dka' thub kyi nags kyi bya ba byed cing nags na gnas so/ /de nas yab kyi bkas rjes su gnang ①nas gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu ni srung ①ma med pa'i mchod sbyin bshams dhinas mchis so/ /bdag kyang der 'gro bar byed do/ /khyod kyi grogs ⑤mo dga' ma la bdag gis ci zhig smra bar bya/ sbrang gi bu mo nas/ sngar yang drang srong gi gnas kyi rgyan du gyis shig /muñdza tshunas dman de be+er yang bkra shis 'joms pa'o/ /sbrang gi bu mo shin tu 'jigs te/ bdag gis ci zhig smras snyam mo/ /de nas 'dir nang du rab tu zhugs shig /skyes gzhan bskul ⑦bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir rab tu zhugs nas song ngo / /de nas bran po rab tu zhugs nas phar song phar song / ci'i phyir lhag par 'tshang zhing 'phul bar byed/bram ze'i khang pa der rgyu yang ci byed/ nges par bltas nas ji ltar bsrungs ⑧kyang mi sdod par yongs su 'jug cing / 'di rnams ni 'dzin cing / 'di rnams ni 'jog cing / yang len cing / gzhan rnams ni sbyin sreg byed cing /bram ze 'grangs par dga' ⑨ba rnams thams cad za 'dod nas 'dir ji ltar bram ze 'khyams ⑩po rnams seng ge'i gdan gyi steng du sdod/ phar song phar song / re ⑪bram ze rnams phar zur phar zur/ dmod pa'i rma rnams na nas gar byed do/ /ngan pa rnams nga la ci ste sdigs ⑫par byed ces smra'o/ /des ⑫blon po sna chen po lag bzangs nges par 'ongs pa ⑫mthong nas 'di rnams de la smra'o snyam mo/ /de nas lag bzangs rab tu zhugs nas a re ⑫lus ngan po phar zur phar zur/ 'dir spro bas don gang ji ltar 'dod pas ster ba la ci'i phyir slong ⑫mo pa rnams yongs su sun 'byin ⑩par byed/ 'di rnams kyi don du de 94—1489
