bzhin du yang dag par brtsams ①pa ste/ gzhon nu gtsug na nor bus 'gog pa med pa'i mchod sbyin thams cad rang len gyi/ yon tan ②'di ni lha yis 'gro ba ma lus pa'i ①mngon 'dod yongs su 'gengs pa mtshan du bcings pa yin no| /cho ga 'di la slongalgemo pa rnams la de bzhin du cung zad ni los kyang ster/sngon yang 'dis de bzhin du mdzad nas ji ltar 'dod pa 'dzin par byed do/ /de rnams kyi 'di glo bur du byung ba ma yin no/ /'di la rab tu zhugs nas de ring gis lo lnga ⑤song ngo / /bran pho ni ji ltar 'di yang rnam par khros na de bzhin du 'dir gzhan yang mi rnyed do snyam nas/ de nas bros nas song ngo / /lag bzangs yongs su zhugs te/ lha gtsug na nor bus sbyin pa rnams rnam par lta ba la bdag bskos pa yin pas de rnams ji srid blta'o snyam nas nges par bltas pa na shin tu dga' ste/ a ho di ring lha'i phun sum tshogs pa chen po ni gang gis ji lta ba de bzhin du/ ji ltar 'dod pa len pas kyang zad par ma gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ gser gyi phung po rnams ni 'di na rjorab tu mtho zhing ri rab dang ni 'gran pa ltar/ /rin chen rnams kyi phung po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba nyi ma'i 'od kyang zil gyis gnon⑦/ /mu tig mchog rlum do shal tshogs rnams bkod pa 'od zer 'tsher ba skar ma'i phreng ba bzhin/ /skye bo rnams ni gang zhig rang dbang blangs nas rang khyim bzhin du dal bus 'gro bar byed/ /yongs su zhugs nas gzhan yang bltas pa na/ /glang chen dbang po rnams kyis stsos pa'i chang ni sa la bar med rab tu 'bab pa len byed pas/ /myur 'gro'i lus ni rnam par ring rnams rmig pa'i ra sdernams nges par 'gred ⑨pas ngo mtshar rab tu bcas/ /shing rta rnams ni rgya nag ba dan mdangs ldan rnams ni rgyug 94—1490

cing bskyod pa g.yer ka'i sgra bcas la/ /bram ze rnams kyis rab bskyod 'khor lo'i mu khyud sgra yis sa chen nor ldan rab tu g.yo ba ltar/ /brgya byen gyis mchod sbyin brgya rab tu byin pa de 'dir sa'i mthil du lha la bdag gis smra bar bya'o snyam nas/ gzhan yang bltas pa na①/ ji ltar mtshan nyid 'di lta bu ni ku ru'i rgyal po bzod par dka' ba gang zhig gis mi bzod par mi 'gyur ram/'on kyang des cung zad kyang mi 'gyur ro ②snyam mo/ /yongs su zhugs pa na der sbyin sreg gi khang par lha nyid rab tu zhugs so/ /rang 'od dpal dang byams pa yis| /tshangs pa'i zhi ba las kyang rgyal/ /bden pas sa chen las rgyal nas//chos ni mngon sum bzhin du gnas/ /ji srid bdag nyid nye bar btud do/ /de nas rgyal po dang / pad+ma can dang / bzhad gad pa dang / mkhan po rnams rab tu zhugs so/ /rgyal po dang / mkhan po dang / mchod sbyin rnams la sdelag bzangs nye bar btud nas phyag 'tshal te/ rgyal po chen po rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig /lha nyid kyi bkas ④rjes su bsgo nas sbyin pa'i sa gzhi rnams bdag gis bltas so/ /rgyal po nas/ de na yang ni slong ba rnams/ /rang gi khyim bzhin rab zhugs nas/ /ji ltar mngon 'dod yongs blangs shing / /yid kyi shing rta gang 'gro 'am/ /lag bzangs nas| lha mngon par 'dod pa phun sum tshogs te/ dpal ni gang zhig sa bdag rnams kyis sa stengs nas/ /rab 'bad rnyed rnams kun la bde bar nyer bsnyen gyur/ /skye bo rnams kyis rab tu zhugs pas khyim khyim rnams/ /da ni khyod pas kyang ni de ⑤rnams shin tu lhag /rgyal po nas/ 'di ni cung zad kyang ma yin te/ 'dir phyi rol gyi dngos po rnams ni thams cad kyi thun 94—1491

mong ste/ 'dir bdag gis ①ci zhig byen/ de bzhin du 'jig rten rnams ni mthu che ste/ rang dbang ba'i dngos po yang de bzhin du bdag gi ②sbyin pa'i gnas so zhes sgogs ③par byed do/ /gzigs mdzod/ 'jig rten kun gyi spyi yi ni/ /phyi rol dngos rnams de bdag ④gis/ /'jig rten sred pas rnam bslus ⑤nas/ /bdag ces 'dir ni 'dzin par byed/ /bdag gis ni snying po med cing mi dran pa'i lus 'di yang / 'gro ba'i don grub phyir ni rtag rjotu yongs su gtong / / gang gang ⑦'di ni ji lta ji ltar mngon 'dod pa/ /de dang de yi de lta de ltar rab tu sbyor/ /ces so/ /yol ba'i nang du kā la kā la'i sgra'o/ /thams cad shin tu 'jigs nas phyogs rnams su blta'o/ /rgyal po ni skabs ma yin par de bzhin du gnyid rnam par yur ro/ /'jig rten rnams ni yongs su g.yo'o/ /mkhan po ni gus shing 'bad pas sbyin sreg byed/a sho a sho ṣaṭa ces so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye na mnyam ya mtshan che/ya mtshan che/ rlung ni drang pos rnam par bskyod pa yis/ /chu gter skye bo dang bcas chu rnams ni/ /dba' rlabs phreng bas yongs su bskyod pa yis⑧/ /gru bzhin nor ldan shin tu g.yo bar gyur/ /rgyal po nas/ na mnyam khyod kyis legs par brtags te/ drag byung ⑨chu yi phung po rlung gis yongs su bskyod pa yirka/ /dba' rlabs rab tu 'khrugs ltar sa chen yang dag rnam par g.yo/ /gang las de ring 'di rnams mtho dang dma' gyur gru bzhin byed/ /'jig rten rnams ni chang gis myos bzhin lus ni rnam par g.yo/ /pad+ma can ni ha bu pad+ma skyes gong du song ngam zhes smra/ de nas g.yog mos pad+ma skyes lag pa nas bzung nas rab tu zhugs nas gzhon nu pad+ma skyes ni 'di'o zhes so/ /pad+ma skyes nas/94—1492

'phags pa 'di ci zhig /lha mo ni bu'i lag pa nas bzung nas/ rgyal po'i drung du nye bar btud nas/ rje'i sras ①'di bzhin du 'khrug ④pa 'di ci zhig /'dren pa ni pad+ma can gyi lag pa nas bzung nas/ dbugs 'byin te/ a yig 'jigs can re zhig ltos dang / sngon ma mthong ba'i rmad du byung ba dga' ba'i gnas skabs kyi mthar thug pa 'di lta ste/ sa gzhi'i dba' rlabs rim pa mtho dang dma' ba rnam pa rab tu mang po rnams/ /khang bzangs gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan cod pan rnams ni bskyod pa'i rim pa ltar/ /sgra chen rab tu 'jug pa sprin rnams kyis skeni 'brug sgra drag tu sgogs ④pa ltar/ /'di rnams chu gter 'dra zhing mi mtshungs khyad par slar yang 'jig rten mi lhung tsam/ /gzhan yang lha mo/ khang pa'i phreng ba rnams ni 'phred la 'gyel zhing ⑤slar yang langs| /chu bo rnams ni gyen du 'phar zhing gzhan du'ang 'gro mi byed/ /sa chen mtho dang dma' ba rnam pa sna tshogs byed pa ni/ /me long nang gi dugazugs brnyan rnam par g.yo ba rtog ⑦pa ltar/ /lag bzangs ⑧nas/ lha mthong lags so/ /shar gyi phyogs rnams ri yi 'gram bcas 'og tu 'gro byed nub phyogs nam mkha' la ni rab tu 'gro/ /rnam par g.yo bas lho phyogs dma' bar lhung zhing byang phyogs 'di rnams shin tu rab tu mthon por 'gro/ /chu gter g.yo bas dbus ni 'og tu rab tu 'gro zhing mtha' yi phyogs rnams steng du rab tu 'gro/ /'di rnams kyang ni steng dang 'og tu ⑨reg ste chu 'dzin mthar thug phyogs kyi mthar thug pa/ /rgyal po ni ngo mtshar nas phyi rol du nye bar byung ste 'jig rten pa rnams la dbugs 'byen pa mdzad do/ /lag bzangs ni lha'i bkas ⑩ji ltar bsgo nas nges par zhugs so/ /rgyal po ni legs ldan nor 94byed1493

'dzin ma la mchod yon phul nas/ skye dgu rnams la ltas ngan gang yin de 'bras bdag smin nas/ /bdag gi sbyin gnas rjes bzung skye bo rnams la 'byung ma gyur/ /'dir ni skye bo'i mngon par 'dod rnams rab tu rdzogs bya'i phyir| /gal te skye bo 'di rnams nyes na'ang bdag gi mngon 'dod cha/ /mkhan po ni gus pa dang bcas nas sbyin sreg byed/ in+d+ra ā gats+tsha ha re ā gats+tsha ①me me dha ti the me ṣe dṛ ṣa ྅ pa sh+ya ②me/ /zhes so/ /me'i thab khung la bltas nas 'jigs pas phyir 'phar ro/ /bzhad gad pa shin tu 'jigs nas kye na mnyam ltos ltos/ 'di ni 'jigs shing kha yi sgo nas mche ba rab tu gdags/ /mig ni nyin byed gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dra zhing rab tu dmar/ /shin tu 'jigs chen gad rgyangs nges par rab tu sgogs/ /'dir ni sbyin sreg thab khyang gyes skenas yang dag byung bar gyur/ /de nas srin po rab tu zhugs so/ /a ho hu ta ma ho da ta hūṃ zhes gar byed cing / /'byung bzhi ④'di rnams gom ⑤pa'i stobs kyis rab 'jig cing / /bar snang 'di rnams 'od zer mngon par 'bar bar rjobya/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo lag pa rab brkyang sdud ⑦byed cing / /'gro ba ma lus bdag gis rnam par g.yo bar bya/ /zhes so/ /rgyal po nas/dge ba byed pa la bgegs mang ngo zhes brjod pa 'di bden par 'dug go zhes gsungs so⑧/ /pad+ma can ni shin tu 'jigs ⑨nas byis pa'i gdong la gos kyis ⑩bkab ste rgyal po'i rgyab tu 'ongs so/ /rgyal po nas/ kye sems can chen po dgos pa ⑪ci'i ched du 'dir 'ongs/ srin po nas/ khyod kyis ⑫thams cad rab tu 'jug pa'i tshul khang pa ⑫chen po byas nas dgos pa ci'i ched du 'ongs kyang 'dri bar byed dam/ rgyal po ni shin tu mnyes nas gal te khyod kyis slong du 94—1494

'ongs sam/ ci slong ba sgos shig /srin po nas/ zas so/ /bzhad gad pa 'dren pa'i rgyab tu shin tu 'jigs nas 'ongs te tshul gyi khang par zas la song zhes smra/ srin po nas/ bdag gi zas ni gzhan yin nam/ rgyal po nas spros shig /srin po nas/ sha ni mdangs ldan slar yang ral gri'i lo mas sngon nyid du/ /rnam bcad rab tu ①mang po dron po ②mdog ni dmar po rnams/ /mi yi dbang po srin po rnams kyi bza' ba de rnams yin/ /mi yi bza' ba'i rigs khrurnams bdag la nges par ci zhig bya/ /rgyal po shin tu mnyes nas/tshur shog mkhas pa yid kyi shing rta rdzogs par bya/ /tshur shog bza' ba ji ltar 'dod bzhin lus 'di ni/ /pha rol don phyir bdag gis 'di ni nye bar bsrungs| /sha rnams bcad pas bdag ni yun ring 'bras bcas 'gyur/ /pad+ma can ngu zhing rje'i sras khyod kyi di ring tshul lugs 'di ci zhig /rgyal po nas/lha mo skyes pa de'i 'bras bu dang bcas so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye na mnyam ji ltar gcig gi don gyi phyir 'jig rten 'di rnams yongs su gtong ngam/rgyal po nas/ bdag ni de bzhin gang du yang / /'gro ba 'ga' yang 'dor mi byed/ /de yi phyir na skye bo 'di/ /zug rngu zhi phyir bdag nyid gtong / /mkhan po nas/ bdag ni de lta bu'i mchod sbyin gyi cho ga 'di mi byed do/ /'dir ni phyugs gsod len pa'i phyir/ /bgegs ni nges par rnam par zhugs/ /'di yi cho ga rig byed las/ /'di la phyugs ni sbyin par bshad/ /rgyal po nas| gang zhig dgos 'dod bgegs yin na/ /bdag ni bgegs kyang mchog tu mos/ /gang la yid kyi shing rta 'grub/ /cho ga de bzhin drag tu zhog /slar yang / kye yi bram ze mchod sbyin la/ /srin po phyugs rnams ci phyir rung //94—1495

yang na bdud rtsi spangs nas ni/ /snying po med pas ci zhig bya/ /srin po nas/sgo khyod 'dir ci'i phyir gtam skom ①pos dus 'phrog par byed/ rgyal po nas/sgo 'dir mchog gi tshes grangs la/ lus las ⑧ji ltar 'dod pa nye bar spyod cig pad+ma can ni ngu zhing skal ba dman pa bdag gi lus 'di yang re zhig dang por nye bar bza' bar gyis shig /rgyal po nas/ 'di ni bdag 'dod pa sneyin no/ /pad+ma can nas④/ lus 'di yang lha'i yin mod/ srin po nas/iḥ⑤mya ngan gyis 'jigs pa'i bag chags can 'dis ci zhig bya/ shums med do//ltos shig dang / mya ngan byas pa'i sha ni bska dang kha zhing tsha ba'i ro rnams yang dag bro bar byed/ /chags pa can ni sla zhing khu bar byas bzhin rab tu skrag bcas de ni bskams pa 'dra/ /khros pa'i skyur zhing rab tu tsha dang rtsub rtsub dubrod med zos nas brang ni tsha bar byed/ /mchog tu byams pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi lus ni mngar zhing dbang po thams cad mchog tu tshim/ /rgyal po shin tu mnyes nas / ring mo nas slong ba'i skye bo mngon shes can re zhig bdag gis mthong ngo zhes nas mtshon jogs te sha gcod par byas pa na/ pad+ma can ni lag pa nas bzung nas⑦/ rje'i sras ma bsams par ma byed cig ces smra zhing / kye sems can chen po 'phags pa'i bu yongs su thong la bdag longs shig ⑧zer/pad+ma skyes nas/ sgo la k+ṣa rā ⑨k+ṣas 'phags pa thong la bdag longs shig ⑩zer/bzhad gad pa nas/ sgo sems can chen po grogs po ⑩thong la bdag zo cig zer / rgyal po nas/ ma 'brel ba smra ba des chog chog /lha mo bdag gi chos kyi bgegs ma byed cig ces gsungs⑫/ pad+ma can ni rmongs nas gar byed/bzhad gad pa ni gzhon nu'i gdong gos kyis ⑫g.yogs par byed do/ /rgyal po 94byed1496

nas| sgo sems can chen po gnas skabs 'dir bdag gi sha la nye bar sbyor bar ①gyis shig /srin po ni bdag nyid bsams te/ 'di ltar khyod ni sems can chen po ste/ bdag ni ma yin no snyam nas/ nye bar za zhing gar byed do/ /rab tu gsal bar smras pa/ a ha ha 'dis shin tu ring por tshim par byas so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ legs ldan 'jig rten skyong ba rnams yongs su bskyab ⑦par mdzod/ yongs su bskyab ③par mdzod/ bdag ni ④na mnyam dga' ba'i srog 'dor bar byed do/ /mkhan po ni/ 'dir bsdad nas ci zhig bya zhes nas nges par song ngo / /srin po ni de nas re zhig tshim mo/ /rgyal po nas/kye dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di ni ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du nye bar spyod cig ces lus gtad nas brgyal te gar byed do/ /srin po nas/ rang nyid bsams pa/a ho mdzad spyod che'o/ /sems can chen po yun ring por nyon mongs par mi rigs so snyam nas nges par song ngo / /mi mngon tsam na zhugs nas/ brgya byin gyi ⑤gzugs su bstan nas/ kye rgyal po chen po nye bar bzhengs shig nye bar bzhengs shig /rgyal po nas/ bdag ni rjes su bzung zhing rab tu dga' bas lus la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin nye bar longs spyod cig /brgya byen nas bdag ni srin po ma lags te/ bdag ni brgya byin no/ /slar yang legs par 'ongs pa 'di gang zhig /bzhad gad pa nas/ dbugs phyung shig /dbugs phyung shig /kye na mnyam dga' ba 'di ni nges par lha'i rgyal po bdag nyid byon no/ /lha bzhengs par mjod cig /kye 'phags pa'i bu'i mdzad spyod 'di ni lha bas lhag par lha rnams la sgogs par byed do/ /pad+ma can ni rgyal po la bltas nas ngu zhing 'phags pa'i bu 'di lta bu mthong nas/ bdag gi 94—1497

lus ma nyams par gnas so snyam mo/ /rgyal po nas/ kye lha'i rgyal po rab tu dgos pa ci'i phyir 'dir byon/ brgya byen nas/ khyod kyi bsam pa'i mthu mi g.yo ba la nor 'dzin dang / ri rab dag kyang g.yos te/ gang gis ①'dir mi dbang khyod kyi bsam pa skye bo kun nas ②gsal bar bya ba'i phyir 'ongs te/rnam par spyod pa 'di ni bdag gi mig 'phrul ba ①yin no/ /bzhad gad pa nas/kye na mnyam gzigs gzigs/ gzhan yang ya mtshan che ba 'dir ni sprin gyi 'khor lo ④rlung drag pos bskyod pa ltar 'ur 'ur zhes rnam par bzlog ⑤par rtsom par byed do/ /rgyal po nas/ kye ma 'jig rten rnams sdug bsngal gyis gdung dhibar byed dam zhes gsungs/ pad+ma can nas⑦/ 'dir gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang 'byung ngam zer/ bzhad gad pa nas gzigs gzigs/ ston ka'i zla ba gang ba'i 'od ltar dkar zhing skar ma'i phreng ba'i do shal gyis nye bar brgyan cing gsal ba ltar/ rin po che'i 'od zer khyad par ⑧rab tu gsal ba nor rgyas kyi gdengs ka'i dkyil 'khor ltar dkar po yang dag par 'thon ⑨nas byung ngo / /rgyal po ni shin tu ya mtshan che nas/ rnam par bltas te/ 'dir gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro ⑩zhes so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye bud med rin po che lha mo pad+ma can gyi dbyibs lta bu zhig sa gzhi'i mthil nas yang dag ⑪par langs nas byung ngo / /kye na mnyam dga' ba gzigs mdzod/ /rgyal po ni ya mtshan che nas/ rnam par bltas te/ ro ldan mthil nas mngon sum du//'dir ni dpal mo bzhengs sam ci/ /yang na 'di ni rnam gsal ba/ /sa chen lhag pa'i ska rags sam/ /de nas sa'i lha mo rab tu zhugs nas mchod yon phul te skyes bu chen po tshur gshegs/ mchod yon bzhes shig zer/ rgyal po 94—1498

nas—/ kye khyod ni 'dir gsar du 'ongs pa ste/ legs ldan grong 'jig dang gnyis po bdag gis mchod par bgyi'o/ /brgya byin nas/ ji ltar dhibs sa rnam dag pas/ / de yis ②chen por gyur pa bzhin/ /de bzhin mchod pas tshim byas kyang / /mchog tu dga' ba thob ma yin/ /rgyal po nas/ khyed di ①ring de tsam slar duyang rnam par g.yo ba ci'i phyir lags/ /sa nas khyod kyi ⑤sems pa rgya chen mthong bas rab dga' nas/ /chu gter ri bo nags tshal mthar thug mngon par bskyod/ /khyod kyi ltad mo ya mtshan ngo mtshar lta ba yis/ /rab dga'i khur gyis lus non dbang gis yongs su 'dar/ /de nas nga ni bdud rtsi'i khu ba 'dis lus slar yang gsar par bya'o zhes/ 'dren pa'i lus la duyongs su byug pa byas so/ /bzhad gad pa shin tu dga' ste/ na mnyam dga' ba ji lta ba ⑦de bzhin du mthong bar gyur to/ /pad+ma can nas/ legs ldan gyi chos kyi mthu'o/ /brgya byin nas/ shin tu dka' ba spyad pa 'di'i ⑧las kyi tshul 'di ni cung zad las med do/ /sa nas lha'i dbang po 'di ni ⑨'di la dga' ba med de ⑩gzigs mdzod/ kau shi ka 'di yis sngon dus nas/ /'di bzhin lus ni stong phrag smin par byas/ /sngon yang dri ma bsnyil ⑪bzhin spangs pa ni/ /bdag gi sa phyogs 'ga' yang ⑫de yod min/ /slar yang rgyal po mthong bas 'dir rmad du byung ngo / /bdag ni 'gro bar byed do zhes nas song ngo / /brgya byin nas rgyal po rang gi bsod nams bsags pa des/ /mtho ris su yang dag par gshegs par mdzod cig /rgyal po nas/ de na slong ⑫mo ba yod dam ci byed brgya byen nas de med do/ /rgyal po nas gal te de bzhin yin na 'gro bar mi byed do/ /brgya byin nas der pha ma dag 'gro bar 94byed1499

mos sam/ byu ba dag ①ji ltar 'dod par ro/ /brgya byen nas de bzhin 'dir 'gro bar bya'o zhes nas yongs su song ngo / /de nas ji ltar bu ②med pa'i legs ldan 'od zer zhes pa'i drang srong rab tu zhugs ①nas/ a ho rgyal po chen po'i bsam pa rab tu rgya che'o zhes rab tu zhugs te/ kye rgyal po chen po bde legs su gyur cig /rgyal pos phyag byas nas/ legs ldan ci'i phyir byon/drang srong nas 'dir spyod kyi btsun mo dang bu'i ched du 'ongs so/ /pad+ma can ni 'di ci zhig snyam mo/ /rgyal po ni ④shin tu dga' nas legs ldan bdag gi lus la sogs pa 'di slong ba kun gyi rang dbang ngo / /de nas yol ba las ca co'i sgra'oske/ /kye re zhig mchod sbyin gyi cho ga'i btsun mo gtong ba med/ rgyal po nas / slong na sbyin par mi bya zhes/ /'di ni chos kyis ⑤cho gar med/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ phar zur bram ze gdug ༷pa phar zur phar zur/ rgyal po'i btsun mos khyod la ci zhig bya/ gzhan slong ⑦/ rgyal po nas de skad ma zer cigasde /drang srong chen po bdag snying yang / /ji ltar 'dod bzhin legs ldan long ⑨/ drang srong nas/ bu mo pad+ma ba tī ⑩dang / bu pad+ma ut+ta ra tshur shog shig⑪ /khyed gnyis rgyal pos byin no/ /pad+ma can ngu zhing rgyal po chen po bdag po ⑫ni yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang rgyal po'i gdung rgyud 'chad ⑫par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po nas/ bdag ni mi sbyin zhes pa cung zad kyang med do zhes bshad zin to/ /pad+ma can nas longs shig /de bzhin du ngu ④nas ci zhig bya/ bu pad+ma skyes tshur shog /'phags pa'i bus bdag cag yongs su btang zin gyis/ yab la legs su ltos shig /phyi nas ni mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma skyes nas ci ste phyi nas bdag gis ⑫yab mthong bar mi byed/ pad+ma can 94—1500

nas| pad+ma skyes gang gi phyir na/ 'dis bdag cag yongs su btang gis ①gzhan du 'gro'o/ /pad+ma skyes yum ②ci byed/ pad+ma can nas/ bdag cag byen nas 'gro'o/ /pad+ma skyes nas/ yab kyang de bzhin du 'gro bar byed dam/pad+ma can nas⑦/ pad+ma skyes kyis ④don ni mi shes par shes nas bu yab la phyag 'tshol cig zer/ pad+ma skyes ni thal mo sbyar nas/ yab bdag gi yum 'di tsam bshums pa ⑤ci ste/ bzhad gad pa nas/ kye ma khyod ni snying rje med/ /gang zhig 'di bzhin cho nge yis/ /bshums shing byes pa yongs su btang / /hā kye pad+ma ba tī dudang / hā bu pad+ma ut+ta ra/ khyed cag gnyis po dag yin no//bram ze'i bu bdag cag kyang khyed cag gi rjes su 'gro bar bya'o zhes rmongs nas gar byed do/ /drang srong nas shog shog /bu mo bdag cag rnams ⑦'gro bar bya ba ring por 'gro dgos so/ /rgyal po ni pad+ma skyes kyi spyi bo la bsnoms nas bshums ⑧shing / nags sam yang na grong khyer ram/ /ri bo dang ni rgya mtsho'ang rung / /khyed cag nyal zhing gnyid log kyang / /lha rnams kyis ni bsrung ⑨bar shog /lha mo khyed ni gar gnas der/ /gzhon nu 'di la rdeg ma byed| /lha mo ni bsteng tshig gis 'phags pa'i bu de bzhin du'ang mkhyen nam/rgyal po nas/ khyed kyi ⑩srog ni yongs 'dor kyang / /drang srong chen po'i bka' ma 'da'/ /me yi gzugs dang 'dra ba yi/ /mchog gi thub pa tshim ⑪byas pa'i/ /bsod nams yongs su bsgrubs ⑫byas pas/ /'jig rten kun byi mngon 'dod tshim/ /drang srong nas bu mo longs ⑫shig /bdag cag 'gro bar bya'o| /rgyal po nas/ lha mo gshegs par mdzod cig /pad+ma can ni phyag 'tshal te/ /rgyal rigs skye ba'i mthar thug par⑫/ /bdag kyang de bzhin 94—1501

rjes 'jug ①shog /ces so/ /pad+ma skyes nas/ yab kyi sdeng la sngon ni rta sbyin zer nas ma byen pas da khyod nga la nam ster/ rgyal po ni bshums shing pad+ma can la 'khyud nas bu de thub pa 'dis khyod la ster bar 'gyur byis/ pad+ma skyes nas—/ yab la①/ 'di na nga'i rta dang / glang po che dang / glang po'i khri dang / rta'i sga 'di rnams tshags gyis shig ces ④zer/ rgyal po rang nyid bsams ⑤pa na/ /skabs 'di rjobadag gi zug rngu ni/ /srog la bab kyang de bzhin min/ /ji ltar pha yi mnyes gshin ⑦pa'i/ /pad+ma mchog ni ring du 'gro//drang srong nas/ bu mo shog /bdag cag 'gro bar bya'o/ /pad+ma can ni rgyal po la blta zhing / bu'i lag pa nas bzung ⑧nas song ngo / /rgyal po nas/brtse ba'i zhags pas legs bsdams ⑨bzhin/ /gang gis ⑩bdag kyang shin tu gdung / /na mnyam dbugs phyung shig dbugs phyung shig /bzhad gad pa brtabs bzhin du longs ⑪nas kye mi ster ci zhig zer/ rgyal po rtab rtab po mdzad nas rnam par bsams pa/ da ni bdag gi pha ma dag blta bar bya'o snyam pa na pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams rab tu zhugs nas ngo mtshar che ngo mtshar che/lha'i yab yum dag nam mkha' la bya ba mdzad pa ⑫gzigs mdzod/ ngang pa'i gzhog ⑫pa'i cha yis bskyod bzhin rgyal mtshan phreng ba can/ /gzhal yas khang 'dras ri rab 1na ⑫po'i rtse mor rnam par gnas/ /lha yi drang srong rnams kyis ⑫mngon dga' brgya phrag rnams kyis bstod⑩/ /'di dag lha yi gnas su da ni rab tu zhugs par gyur/ /rgyal po shin tu mnyes te gzigs nas phyag 'tshal zhing de bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid klog go/ /slar yang gzigs nas bshums shing / yab ni rnam sad lam du ring du gshegs shing / yum kyang 94byed1502

rjes su gshegs so / /①pad+ma skyes dang lha mo grong khyer spangs shing gnyis skyes khyim du song / /da ni 'di ni stongs gyur ri bo shin tu dbe+en pa'i nags tshal gyi/ /gnas la bdag kyang rten byed blo ni 'gro bar shin tu rings par gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas yongs su zhugs ②pa na/ bzhad gad pa nas/kye na mnyam khyod kyang gshegs par mdzad na ①bdag bram ze yongs su 'dor ④bar byed dam/ 'dren pa nas/ byed ni ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin no/ /bzhad gad pa nas bdag bram ze yang gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig gi bran la mi ster na rjes su 'gro'o/ /rgyal po nas/ khyod bram ze yin mod/ de bzhin du bdag ster ba'i bdag po yang khyod nyid do/ /pho brang 'khor gyi mi rnams nas/ kye gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu byed kyang bdag cag rnams yongs su 'dor ram/ nor ldan ri phug khyod nyid ni/ /bsam gtan gyis ⑤srun 'byed mi byed/ /g.yo ba med pa rgya dhimatsho bzhin/ /nags kyi lha rnams kyis ni lta| / rgyas pa'i bu ⑦rnams bsdus nas gang gis ⑧zlos gar rab sbyar la/ /nye bar yongs su rtsom mdzad tsan+d+ra go mis rab sbyor dang / /gal te 'ga' zhig chags pa dang bral mtshungs 'gyur ⑨'gro rnams la/ /yang dag skyes sam sa chen yun ring gnas pas bden par smras/ /'dir ni thams cad nges par zhugs so / /⑩yan lag bzhi pa rdzogs so// //de nas rig pa ⑩'dzin pa rab tu zhugs so/ /rtsed mos rol cing mkha' la rgyu ba na a ho lha gtsug na nor bu'i grags pa rgyun mi 'chad pas phyogs ma lus pa khyab cing gang ba 'di lta ste/ gtsug na nor bu'i snyan pa'i grags pa chen 94—1503

pos phyogs rnams thams cad rab tu mdzes par brgyan/ /de yis rna ba'i rgyan bzhin gos dang bcas bzhin mnyam bzhin kun nas dgod ①bcas bzhin/ /tsan dan tshogs rnams bdud rtsis gang dang zla ba'i 'od zer 'tsher bas rnam par byug pa ltar/ /do shal rnam par 'phyang ba 'od zer 'phro ba'i tshogs kyis khyab cing rnam par g.yo ba ltar/ /ltos ltos de yi grags pa nges par 'phel ba ni//phyogs phyogs mi 'am ci yi bu mo rnams kyis ②glu len cing / /ri bo'i rtse la grub pa rig 'dzin rnams ni bstod cing sgogs/ /sa 'og mthil na gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer rab 'bar ba/ /klu rgyal rnams kyi gdengs ①ka'i dkyil 'khor zhi nas nyan par 'dod/ /rig 'dzin ma nas pad+ma ba tī ④ni yugs sa mo ma yin bzhin du bu ni chung ngu ⑤dang bcas 'khor thams cad yongs su spangs tedu/bdag po'i bkas drang srong chen po'i rjes su 'brang zhing da lta ji ltar gyur tam/rig pa 'dzin pa nas/ de bzhin legs ldan 'od zer can gyi gnas brten nas//ri bo gangs ldan mi ring ri sul dag na sbar yang gnas/ /drang srong chen po nga yang yab ni srid 'byung yid gcugs so/ /de ⑦phyir 'di ni gzhan gyi lag tu 'gro bar mi bya'i phyir/ /drang srong chen pos de nyid slong bar mdzad cing zhugs par nges so/ /rig 'dzin ma dga' nas/ pad+ma can ni sngon gyi rigs su rab tu zhugs te/ de ni sdug bsngal gyi khur bskur ⑧dka' ba ni med do/ /de nas da lta lha gtsug na nor bu ji ltar thos sam/ rig pa 'dzin pa nas de yang pad+ma can byis ⑨gang du khyer dang gnas pa mi shes shing / de dang nye ba na ⑩de bzhin ri'i phug tu rab tu zhugs nas so sor gnas par gyur/ de yi rnam par spangs pa'i grong khyen sā ke ta ni mchod sbyin phun sum tshogs pa rnams/ /shin tu mi 94—1504

bzad bzod par rab tu dka' ①ba'i rgyal pos mthong nas nye bar bskor bar ②byas| /rig 'dzin ma nas rje'i sras 'di'i dga' ba'i gtam 'di sdud ①par 'gyur ram/ mi 'gyur/ rig pa 'dzin pas 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab ④ste lha'i'o| /rig pa ⑤'dzin ma nas rje'i sras gang du babs par byed/ rig 'dzin ma dgod rjocing 'di khyod kyis ⑦smros shig /gang zhig ma la ya yi rtse mo rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs 'thor ba'i mdangs can nam/ /ri rab bang rim rnam yangs ⑧dga' zhing ya mtshan zhig gam yongs 'du ⑨sa brtol ri bo 'am/ /gang zhig sgeg cing gsal la grub pa rnams ni rab dga' ri bo gangs ldan rtse mo 'am/ /sa gzhi thams cad bris pa bzhin du nam mkha'i ⑩mthil nas lta zhing 'gro bar byed dam ci/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ shin tu phul du byung ba'i gnas bdag la yod de gtsug na nor bu mthong ba de ru de bzhin du babs par bya'o/ /rig pa 'dzin pa⑪nas/ legs ldan rnams ni mthong bas kyang / /dga' ⑫'gyur mngon par brjod pa legs/ /zhes nas yongs su zhugs so/ /ri phug 'di ni chu bo dal gyis ⑫'bab pa yi/ /chu 'thor zer ma bsil zhing rlung ni 'jam pos bskyod| /ljon shing gzhon nu'ang yal ga rnams ni kha 'bus pa/ /gang de skyes bu seng ge'i nye 'khor gnas yin no/ /rig 'dzin ma rnams ⑫rnam par bltas te/ 'di ni nges par phyag bya ba'i gnas so zhes gnyis pos ⑫phyag 'tshal nas rig pa 'dzin pas nges par brtags nas/ 'dir ni de ba dā ru ljon pa'i bsil grib ⑩'og /nor bu mu tig rdo ba dag gi steng na ni/ /pad+ma'i stan can mngon sum bzhin du skyil krung mdzad/ /gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu nye bar zhugs par gyur⑩/ /rig 'dzin ma nas/ a ho de ni shin tu brtan pa 94—1505

zab pa brling ba'i mdzad pa can no/ /'dis gangs ri thams cad dpal gyis gang bar byas so/ /rje'i sras 'dir me tog 'di rnams gang nas byung / rig pa 'dzin pas steng du bltas pa na ya mtshan che ste/ mkha' las lha rnams me tog char 'bebs shing / /sems can chen po mngon par mchod par byed/ /de ni de bzhin mchod pa'i don du ni/ /bdag cag kyang ni ①me tog tshol ⑧du 'deng //zhes nas so/ /de nas rab tu zhugs pa na 'dren pa ji lta ba mthong ste spyan cung zad phye nas a ho nad med pa'i bsam gtan bzhi ni 'di lta ste/ rnam par rtog bcas rnam par dpyod dang g.yo ba'i rlabs①/ /dang po yin te dga' bde g.yo bcas gnyis pa'o④/ /bde ba la chags 'jig pa'i nad can gsum pa'o/ / rab tu zhi ba ro gcig mthar thug 'di ni bzhi pa'o/ /⑤bzhad gad pa nas/kye na mnyam khyod rang gcig pu de bzhin du dang po dang / gnyis pa dang /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba thob nas bdag gcig pu 'gengs shing thum por bsdams nas tshong pa bzhin du rnyed pa thob nas gnas par byed dam/ bdag bram ze la yang bsam gtan cig kyang ma byin zhes zer/'dren pa ni bzhad cing na mnyam pa 'di ni sgom pa'i rjes su 'jug ste/ gzhan la sbyin par mi nus so/ /phreng ba'i yon tan bdag nyid bzhin/ /gal te bsam gtan 'jug 'gyur na/ /'jig rten kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /yid kyi shing rta cis mi bsgrubadhi/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ ji ltar na ⑦bsam gtan gyi bde ba thob par 'gyur ba lags/ 'dren pa nas/ gnyis min rten cing 'dod lha'i mtshon rnams bcom/ /bde ba 'di ni rang dbang yod byas nasaske/ /g.yo ba rnams gsal ⑨mtsho chu shin tu dngas/ /bsil bzhin rang gi sems 94—1506

las rab tu dang/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ 'di ni gzhan zhig la/ yul gyi bde ba yang gzhan zhig gam ci/ sde'adren pa nas/ khyod ni bdud rtsi dang dug sre sdebar byed dam ci/ /bsam gtan bde bas yid ni dhibasel bar byed/ /yul ⑤gyis slar yang dbang med sems byed cing / /'dod chags zhe sdang me yis rnam bcings shing rjo/ /dmyal ba'i me yis sreg par byed pa ltar/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ gal te de bzhin du yin na bdag kyang bsam gtan byed dorka/ /rgyal po nas/ de bzhin du mdzod cig /bzhad gad pa bsam gtan byed pa na rna bar cung zad thos so/ /kye ngu ba bzhin du thos par byed do/ /'dren pa nas/ bsam gtan ya mtshan che'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ khyod kyis ci yang ma thos sam/ rgyal pos kyang cung zad thos te/ 'di ni grag ⑦pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad nges par bud med ngu zhing 'dug go/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ji ltar shes/ rgyal po nas/ yan lag mchog rnams dbyangs snyan ⑧zhing / /rnam par 'dren ring mnyen ⑨dang 'jam/ /bskyed ⑩pa rno zhing rnam par gcod//skyes bu rnams ni rnam par rtsub/ /na mnyam mi ring bar mnyen pa bzhin du'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ 'di'i dbyangs sgrogs ⑩tshul ni sngon thos pa cig ⑫'dra ba snyam mo/ /rgyal po nas/ bdag kyang de bzhin du snyam mo/ /de ni dka' thub ma mnar ba zhig ngu ba yin nam/ der mngon par 'gro bar rigs so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye na mnyam de bltas ⑫nas ci zhig byed zer/ yol ba'i nang du'o/ /legs ldan 'jig rten skyong rnams yongs su skyobs shig yongs su skyobs shig ⑫zer/ rgyal po nas/ skye bo 'di bzhin du mnar ba ci zhig nye bar blta bar rigs so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye khyod ji ltar dus 94—1507

thams cad du gsar bu bzhin du pha rol gyi sdug bsngal gyis ①bdag nyid sdug bsngal bar byed dam/ rgyal po nas/ na mnyam/ 'khor bar ring du slar yang ni/ /bdag nyid de bzhin skye zhing skyes/ /sems can 'ga' zhig ②gnyen min pa/ /gang na'ang de ni gcig yod min/ /gnyis po rtab rtab por langs te yongs su zhugs pa na/ bzhad gad pa nas/ kye 'di ni lha mo pad+ma can la ci zhig rjes su byed pa ma yin nam/ rgyal po na re khyod ci zhig smra/ gang na lha mo pad+ma can gang la 'o skol gnyis snekyang phyogs tsam zhes zer/ de nas pad+ma can sha ba ri gnyis dang rjes su 'gro zhing rab tu zhugs so/ /sha ba ri dag ④nasarka/ song mi byed song zhes skad chen pos smra zhing dang mi 'gro'am zhes mad mā da ⑤ka zhes pa nas bud med rnyed pa 'dis nga'i bu chung de'i nu ma bsnun dupa'i ma ma byed do zhes zer/ gnyis pa nas/ ha kye na be+e ⑦ka la lo la kā 'di ni 'u cag gnyis kyis ⑧thob po/ /ji ltar 'gro ba de ltar 'gror chug zer/ pad+ma can ngu zhing kye ma ji ltar 'phags pa'i bu byed ni yongs su skyob pa'i ngang tshul de lta na skal dman bdag gi gnas skabs 'di lta bur 'jug pa las yongs su skyob par mi byed dam zhes smra/ bzhad gad pa nas/ kye ⑨ji ltar the tshom byed/lha mo pad+ma can no/ /rgyal pos de la bltas nas rtab rtab por lha mo ma 'jigs shig /pad+ma can ni brtags nas 'phags pa'i bu'am su zhig yin/ yang na bdag gis 'dir 'ga' ⑩zhig la 'phags pa'i bu mo'o ⑪zhes nye bar mthong ngam/rgyal po ni bshums shing lha mo 'di nye bar mthong ba 'di ni bdag yin te/ nye du'i skye bo sdug bsngal bar bya'o/ /bzhad ⑫gad pa nas/ kye ⑫lha mo ji ltar thams cad gzhan yin snyam du ma ⑫sems shig /'di ni na mnyam dga' ba'o⑫//94—1508

pad+ma can ni gnyis po la bltas te/ shin tu sdug bsngal nas ①sa la 'gyel lo/ /sha ba ri dag ②nas/ shog mi khyod shog /bzhad gad pa ni dbyug pa gyen du bgrengs ②te/ ha na ḍi ④bran mo yi bu gdug ⑤pa can gyi sha ba ri dgadhi /dbyug pa kyog po lag 'gro khros pa 'dra ba'i dbyug pa 'dis khyed cag gi mgo gzhom par bya'o zhes zer/ rgyal po na re na mnyam de bzhin du ma byed cig /ji ltar gnod pa byed pas bshes gyur pa/ /de ltar phan pa mdzad pas mi 'gyur snyam| /gang las de yis ⑦bzod par gyur pa yisge/ /'gro ba mtha' dag zlog pa'i rgyu nyid do/ /sha ba ri dag ⑨phan tshun bltas nas shin tu brten ⑩te g.yo bar ga la 'gyur/ de ltar na bdag cag 'gro bar bya'o/ /'di ni bdag cag dbang pos sprul pa byas zer/ 'jigs pas gar byed cing nges par zhugs te song ngo / /'dren pa nas/ a yi lha mo 'dir ci'i phyir ji ltar 'di 'dra ba'i skabs su zhugs/ pad+ma can ngu zhing 'phags pa'i bu bdag gi skal ba la dri bar mdzod/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye lha mo gzhon nu pad+ma skyes ji ltar/pad+ma can phyogs rnams su bltas nas skal ba dman pa bdag la da gzod ⑪gtam ci zhig /rgyal po rtab rtab por bu ci ci zhes smra⑫/ pad+ma can nas/ bu pad+ma skyes de ring gang na zhes smra/ bzhad gad pa na re/ ci ci kye lha mo sgos shig /pad+ma can nas/ bdag gi bu pad+ma skyes kyi dus gang / bzhad gad pa nas/kye lha mo gzhon nu ji lta ji ltar pad+ma can de yang gang gis ⑫yang phrogs so/ /rgyal po nas/ bdag gi bu gang gis phrogs pas gang gis yang shin tu mi bzad pa 'dir gnas nas byazhes bshums shing gnod pa shin tu mang ba dgon pa'i gnas 'dir bdag gis gzhan ci zhig sems par byed/ bzhad ⑫gad pa ngu 94—1509

zhing kye ma yongs su tshim pa med pa'i gshin rjes de ring med par byas so zhes rnam par bsams te/ kye lha mo ji ltar 'di bzhin du sdug bsngal spyod pa dang phrad—/ pad+ma can nas/ bdag me tog thu ba'i phyir gnas nas 'ongs pa ①dang phrad do/ /rgyal po nas/ lha mo nam zhig drang srong chen pos khyod ma mthong ba dang khro bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bzhengs la de bzhin du 'gro bar mdzod cig /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye ji ltar sā ri btson ra nas thar nas dze+elag tu 'ongs pa la slar yang khyod kyi ji lta ba bzhin du der 'jug gam/ rgyal po nas/ na mnyam 'di ni chos kyi lugs ma yin no/ /pad+ma can rgyal po la bltas nas ngu zhing 'phags pa'i bu khyod kyis bdag slar yang yongs su 'dor ram/rgyal po nas/ ji ltar khyod kyis ①bdag g.yang sa chen por skyur bar byed dam gzigs mdzod/ don gang bdag gis yongs rjobatang nas/ /slar yang len par 'dod pa ni⑤/ /dper na khyi bzhin gsal por ni/ /slar yang skyugs pa za byed dam/ /shin tu yun ring gnas gyur kyang / /bdag cag nam zhig 'bral bar nges/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs te/ bsags pa thams cad mthar 'dzad rjocing / /mthon po rnams ni dma' mor lhung / /'dus pa'i mtha' ni bral dze+eb ste/ /gson pa'i skematha' yang 'chi ba yin/ /gzhan yang lha mo/ kun gyi rang bzhin yun ring gnas kyang rnam par 'bral/ /'chi bdag zhags pas 'dzin cing rnam par kha gdangs stirgyu/ /gal te chos phyir 'di ni da ltar rnam bral kyang / /yang dag 'dus pa bas kyang shin tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /pad+ma can nas/ 'phags pa'i sras gang gsungs pa der bdag 'gro'orka/ /gal te bdag 'gro yang rkang pa'i sna mi 'gro'o/ /rgyal po nas/94—1510

lha mo ngang tshul 'dis ①bdag gi bka' ni sgrub par mdzod/ /na mnyam drang srong chen po'i gnas su lha mo skyel ①bar mdzod cig /bzhad ①gad pa nas/na mnyam ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o/ /pad+ma can 2 ngu zhing kye go ta ma skad cig gzhes dupar mdzod cig /bdag ni re zhig 'phags pa'i bu lta'o⑤/ /bdag ni skal ba dman te slar yang bdag gis mthong bar bya ba ga la yin zhes chags shing nges par bltas nas du'aphags pa'i bu bdag la'ang legs par gzigs mdzod/ be+er yang bdag gis khyod mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po nas/ lha mo nges par bltas ⑦pas ci zhig /'dus pa thams cad 'di bzhin 'gro bar 'gyur te gzigs mdzod/ dper na lam pa ⑧lam zhugs rnams / /'gro zhing lam du 'dus gyur ⑨nas/ /tshogs kyang phyogs gzhan 'gro bar byed/ /de bzhin gnyen 'dun tshogs rnams so/ /bzhad gad pa nas| kye na mnyam snying rje med par ma byed/ kye lha mo'i dbugs 'byin par mdzod cig /rgyal po ni bshums shing ji ltar bdag gis dbugs dbyung bar bya ste/ slar yang 'byung ⑩'gyur yang dag 'dus pa thob ce 'am ni slar yang khyod kyi ⑪sras po ni/ /pad+ma skyes kyis 'dir ni blon po dang ni dpung tshogs thams cad bcas par 'gyur zhe'am⑫/ /lha mo'i gyos sgyug bdag gi yab yum dag ni rab tu dang bas di ring thob ce 'am/ /mnga' ris shin tu rgyas par smra'am ⑫ji ltar bdag gis dga' bas rab tu dbugs dbyung bya/ /yol ba'i nang nas 'di bzhin/ no zhes so/ /thams cad rtab rtab por gyur te/ slar yang yol ba'i phag nas 'di bzhin no zhes ⑫ci zhig /'di bzhin gang la rig 'dzin rnams/ /dga' bas legs 'ongs nam mkha' las/ /me tog rnams 94—1511

kyi char phab ste/ /'dir ni gsal por gyur pa'o/ /rgyal po di ngo tsha dang bcas te/ lha mo 'dir yang 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas gal te bdag la 'dir ①lha mo dang bcas pa mthong na brdzun gyi dam bca' zhes 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma can ngu zhing phyag 'tshal te/ khyod la lha rnams kyis mthong bar 'gyur mod ces zer nas lta zhing yongs su song ngo / /bzhad gad pa rjes su zhugs te song ngo / /rgyal pos gzigs te/ bud med rin chen sbyin par btang / /yid ni 'gro zhing bya ba byas/ /bdag gi gtsug gi rin chen 'di/ /spun bzhin du ni don med gnas②/ /da ni dam pa slong ba su zhig 'byung snyam pa na/ de nas bram ze zhig ①zhugs nas kye bdag slong ba po zhes yongs su zhugs so/ /pad+ma can gyis bltas te/ go ta ma bram ze 'di ni ci zhig slong bar byed do snyam du bdag gi snying la ④sems so/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye lha mo 'di yang bram ze ste/ thams cad du bdag cag bram zes gtong bar mi byed de 'di na yang sleb ⑤bo/ /yang na nags tshang tshing gi phag dutu lha mo lta zhing sdod cig bdag gis nye bar 'gro bar bya'o/ /bram zes ⑦nges par bltas te/ 'di ni lha gtsug na nor bu gang yin pa 'di yin te/ gcig pu nyid kyi phun tshogs kyis/ /sa gsum rnams ni khyab par mdzad/ /bskal pa chags ⑧dus gnas pa yi/ /legs ldan pad+mo'i skye gnas bzhin/ /zhes zer nas/ kye rgyal po bde legs su gyur cig /rgyal po nas/ bde bar 'ongs sam 'dir bzhugs ⑨shig gsung / mig g.yas pa 'phrig par gyur nas bsams pa/ ji ltar mig ni ⑩g.yas 'gul zhing / /gang zhig lhag par mngon gsal byed/ /gang ba rgya chen bsngags 'os pa'i/ /gsal bar slong ba por gyur nges/ /bram ze chen po ci 94—1512

slong bar byed gsungs shig ces so/ /bram ze ni ngo tsha bzhin du bdag ni nges par 'dod pa che'o/ /rgyal po dga' ba dang bcas te ngo tsha ba chog go/ /bdag nyid kyi bzhin du 'di thams cad kyang khyod kyi'o/ /bram ze nas/gzhan don ro gcig shar ba yi①/ /'gro ba'i bshes gnyen zhi mdzad pa/ /bdag gi mngon 'dod khyod bzhin du/ /khyod kyi gtsug gi nor bu ste/ /bzhad gad pa rtab rtab por nye bar btud de/ kye bram ze khyed la ngo tsha ba'ang med do//na mnyam dga' ba'i lus kyi gnas skabs kyang 'di bzhin du sdug bsngal bar byed dam/ rgyal po nas/ na mnyam de bzhin du ma byed/ ji ltar bdag gi mchod pa'i gnas khyod kyis rgyang du 'phen nam/ 'di ni sbyin bdag 'dir bdag slong mo pa/ /grogs po phyin ci log tu ci phyir byed/ /'di ni 'gro ba myang 'das rgyur 'gro ba'i/ /bdag gi kun mkhyen bzhon ②pa'i mchog yin no/ /gzhan yang / yid bzhin nor dang slong ba'i skye bo dgadze+e /phun tshogs yon tan slong ba'i skye bo 'phags/ /yid bzhin nor ni nor tsam ster byed kyi/ /slong ba'i skye bo yon tan kun 'byung ngo / /kye bram ze gtsug gi nor bu 'di ni ji ltar 'dod par bton nas khyer cig /bram ze nas/ lha yi gtsug gi nor bu ri rab kyi/ /rtse mo lta bur su yis bskyod par nus/ /rgyal po nas/ rdo ba yis bsnun cing thon cig /gzigs mdzod/ chu shing snying po med pa ltar/ /rnam par nyams gyur bdag med pa'i/ /lus 'di gzhan don 'gro ba yi/ /dga' 'gyur gang gis skye ba med/ /bzhad ④gad pa nas/ yongs su skyobs shig yongs su skyobs shig⑤ /nags tshal gyi lha rnams gdug pa can gyi bram zes na mnyam dga' ba ni gsod dhipar byed do/ /lha mo rtab rtab por gyur 94—1513

nas 'di las gzhan pa ①yang mthong bar 'gyur ram zhes nye bar ④'ongs so /bram ze ngo mtshar te/ ci ste nags tshal gyi lha rnams 'ongs sam snyam mo/ /pad+ma can nas 'phags pa'i sras bya ba 'dis ci zhig byed/ rgyal po nas/yid kyi shing rta'i ①'bras bu dang bcas so/ /pad+ma can ngu zhing 'phags pa'i bu'i yid kyi shing rta'i 'bras bu dang bcas so/ /bram ze'i 'dod pa grub bo/ /rgyal po nas/ shin tu bdag tu rmongs pas chog go/ /gzigs mdzod/'khor ba'i chu gter sems can rnams/ /las kyi dba' rlabs shugs kyis bskyodarjo—/ /mthon po dag ni dma' mor 'phangs/ /de nas ⑤gang dang gang gis bsnyen/ /bram ze nas/ shin tu snying rje chen po la bltas dhinas bdag kyang yang dag par brtse ba ⑦skye na gtsug gi nor bu re zhig zhog cig /pad+ma can nas/ bram ze de bzhin du rjes su 'jug go/ /bzhad gad pa dga' nas legs par smras so/ /rgyal po shin tu mi ⑧mnyes nas/ kye bram ze khyod kyis gzhan du smras nas 'di bzhin du rigs sam/ bram ze nas/ rgyal po bdag cag gi yul du mā ri'i nad zhugs te/ de'i phyir blangs nas da ni 'dis ⑨spro bar byed do/ /rgyal po ni rtab rtab por ji lta ⑩ji ltar bram ze zhes gsungs⑪/bram ze nas/ kye rgyal po/ srong ⑫dang so so'i khyem rnams dur khrod mi bzad bzhin—/ /yan lag brkyang zhing lus 'dzag shing gi phung po bzhin/ /ri rab kyang ni khyi dang mkha' 'gros rgyu ⑫ma rnams/ /rab gtugs ④'di ni ku ru'i yul du byung ⑫bar gyur/ /rgyal po nas/ sdug bsngal lo/ /kye bram ze mā ri'i nad de ⑫rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i thabs gang yang med dam/ bram ze nas/'chi nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i ched du 'di bzhin lha'i gtsug gi nor ⑩bu slong 94—1514

ba 'jig rten pa rnams kyis ①bdag btang ngo / /rgyal po shin tu mnyes nas skye bo rnams la phan par ②bya ba'i phyir bdag gi gtsug gi nor bu slong bar byed do zhes kun nas phyung nas/ gtsug gi nor bu bkan nas rtsa ba ①rnam par bcings pa ④phyung nas ni/ /'di ni tshad chen ri bong 'dzin pa'i ⑤'od zer lta bur dkar/ /'gro ba'i don rnams yang dag sgrub rjomadzad gnyis skyes la byin nas| /mi drag 'gro ba kun gyi nad rnams 'di yis sel bar shog /ces byin te brgyal nas gar byed do/ /pad+ma can ngu zhing ha 'phags pa'i sras ha mthu chen po mgon med pa ⑦rnams kyi gnyen khyod kyis bdag gcig pu 'dir yongs su 'dor bar byed dam zhes zer/ bzhad gad pa nas/ ha na mnyam dga' ba 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen brtse ba chen po yongs su skyobs shig kye yongs su skyobs ⑧shig dpag bsam gyi shing yongs su 'dor zhing chu gter yongs su skam mo zhes zer—/ bram ze ni gzhan du 'dir bsdad nas ci ⑨byed/ 'di ni sems dpa' chen po de'i mngon par 'dod pa bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o snyam nas yongs su zhugs nas bltas pa na der thub pa cig 'ongs so/ /bdag ni ⑫sdig pa mi bzad pa dang ldan pas ji srid 'dis mi mthong ba de srid bdag 'bros so snyam nas zhugs so/ /de nas drang srong 'od zer can rin chen phreng ba ma dang bcas te rab tu zhugs so/ /ci ste sgra chen gnas skabs ma yin 'di ltar lhung zhing ci ste sa chen g.yo bar byed/ /ci ste rlung rnams kyang ni rtsub cing ci ste phyogs rnams kyang ni skya bor 'gro bar byed/ /ci ste nyi ma yang ni mtshams min gza' yi bdag pos 'dzin cing bcom nas gnas byed cing / /ci ste nyi ma'i gung la di ring 'dir ni yul rnams mun pas yang dag sgrib par byed/ /'di 94—1515

bzhin du mi'i bdag po la ji ltar sdug bsngal mi 'dod pa zhig go snyam nas bu mo rin chen phreng ba ma da ltar pad+ma ba tī gar song / rin chen phreng ba ma nas/chu klung dal gyis ①'bab pa'i 'gram du me tog thur song ngo / /drang srong nas 'di myur du bltar ②'gro bar bya'o zhes yongs su zhugs pa na rna bar cung zad thos nas a ye ji ltar ngu ba'i sgra 'dra ba zhig go/ /der re zhig bdag 'gro bar bya'o zhes nas yongs su zhugs nas bltas pa na/ rin chen phreng ba ma ngu zhing /legs ldan pad+ma can ni ji ltar ngu zhing mchis so/ /'di yang go ta ma'o/ /drang srong nas ①'di las gzhan 'ga' zhig kyang ngo / /rin chen phreng ba mas nges par bltas nas/ ha ④bdag gsod 'di ni lha gtsug na nor bu ste sa la 'gyel nas mchis so/ /drang srong nas/ ha ⑤bdag gsod bdag skal ba dman pa mi rtag pa ni stobs che'o/ /skye ba'i dpag bsam shing bzhin du/ /rtag tu 'tsho bar byed pa yi/ /de ni 'di na nyal zhing 'gyel/ /phun tshogs nges par skad cig tsam/ /bu mo pad+ma ba tī/ ci 0zhig /ji lta ba de bzhin du ngu bar byed do/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ legs ldan gzigs gzigs drang srong nas/ 'di ji ltar yin/ bzhad gad pa nas/ legs ldan gtsug na nor bu'i sbyin pa'o/ /drang srong nas/ ha ⑦dpag bsam gyi shing 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu zhes zer/ pad+ma can la rin chen phreng ba ma 'khyud sgenas grogs mo dga' ma 'dir shog /gnas skabs kyi mtha' 'di la ltos shig /hā bu pad+ma skyes yab kyis kyang yongs su 'dor bar byed do/ /de nas pad+ma skyes dang / lag bzangs dag kyang ⑨rab tu zhugs te 'di ni nga'o/ /pad+ma skyes ni 'dir blangs nas/ /bzod par dka' las rgyal bar byas/ / rje 94—1516

bo ①lta zhing 'gro bar byed/ /de las yod kyi the tshom ci/ /pad+ma skyes nas/adz+dza sna chen po yum dang bcas te yab dang 'jal ②bar byed do zhes zer/lag bzangs nas/ gzhon nu de ji lta ba de bzhin du bya'o zhes zer/ yongs su zhugs pa na pad+ma skyes rta ba ①bzhin du 'gyel bar gyur to/ /adz+dza nga'i rkang pa la ci nam cig gis rmugs so zhes ④zer/ lag bzangs ⑤'jigs nas myur du bltas te rang nyid bsams dupa dang / skrag pas kun nas 'gyel te/ ji ltar 'di ni sbrul yin te/ sa yi ser ga 'dir rjes su zhugs te song ngo / /bdag gi mngon 'dod grub pa 'di nyams so snyam mo/ /yang na myur du lha'i drung du nye bar 'gro zhing sleb ma thag tu gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer gyis dug med par 'gyur ro/ /snyam nas gsal bar smras pa/ gzhon nu myur du mdzod cig /yab yum dag dang mjal bar bya'o zhes smras pa na/ nga'i rkang pa ni sbrid sel sel mchis so/ /gnyid kyang bro/ lus po yang 'dir ⑦zhing mchis so zhes zer/lag bzangs kyi rna bar cung zad thos te/ ji ltar 'dir yang ngu ba'i sgra zhig go snyam nas brtags pa na⑧/ de ci ste 'di ni lha mo bshums pa yin nam/ 'di ni rin chen phreng ba ma'o/ /'di ni legs ldan 'od zer can no snyam nas/shin tu sngangs nas 'di thams cad ci'i phyir ngu zhes yang bltas pa na/ de rnams ni ngu zhing lha ni gzims nas bzhugs so/ /a ye lha yi dbu ni ci'i phyir 'di bzhin du song / /nges par bltas⑨/ hā rgyal po chen po ji ltar 'di 'dra ba'i gnas skabs su gyur zhes lha mo la lta zhing / khyod kyi spyan ni btsums shing mchis—/ /di ring 'jig rten snang ba med/ /snang byed dang bral nam mkha' bzhin| /dbu yi gtsug kyang stong bar snang / /zhes 'dren pa'i zhabs la 94—1517

phyag 'tshal nas/ 'dir ni lha 'ba' zhig gshegs par ma zad de gtsug gi nor bu'i 'od zer dang bral bas da ni gzhon nu yang gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /rin chen phreng ba ma pad+ma skyes la 'khyud de bu pad+ma skyes yab la gzigs mdzod cig /phyi nas nam yang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro/ /pad+ma skyes nas/ yab 'di bzhin du ci ste/ pad+ma can nas/ bdag ni skal ba'i rang bzhin no/ /pad+ma skyes nas / yab bzhengs 1mdzod bdag gi yum yang bshums shing mchis so zhes zhe brgyal zhing gar byed do/ /pad+ma can dang / rin chen phreng ba ma dag kyang hā bu hā —gzhon nu/ hā bu chung khyod kyis kyang bdag cag yongs su 'dor ram/lag bzangs nas/ hā bcom mo/ /skal ba dman pa 'dir phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal rigs stongs so/ /bzhad gad pa nas bu pad+ma skyes dbugs phyung shig /drang srong gis 4nges par bltas pas ngo mtshar bar gyur nas/ 'dir ni tsan dan chu yi 5thig le'i zer ma'i mkha' las yan lag mchog rnams 6char 'bebs shing / /bung ba dang bcas me tog rnams ni ring nas lding zhing rig 'dzin rnams kyis 'thor bar byed/ /klung 7rnams kyang ni dal gyis 'bab cing chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa gting zab rnams kyang ni/ / zil pa'i 8'od zer 'gyed cing lha yi rnga 9 rnams 'dir ni ri bo'i phug rnams rab myos byed/ /thams cad ya mtshan che nas bltas so/ /pad+ma can nas/ 'phags pa'i sras kyi sku ni lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i ched du lha'i 'jig rten du len par byed do zhes zer nas drang srong gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas/ legs ldan bdag bkas skrurjes su gnang bar mdzod cig zer nas/ lag bzangs la blta 13zhing /bdag gi sreg ༄ 5shing sta gon gyis shig bdag gi gtam gyi phyi ma yin no zhes zer/94—1518

bzhad gad pa nas/ kye ①lha mo thang cig gzhes shig /bdag kyang na mnyam dga' ba'i rjes su lhan cig tu ②'gro'o/ /drang srong nas da dung yang ngus nas ci zhig byed ma mthong ngam ci ste/ 'di yi thugs ka rab tu 'gul zhing spyan yang 'phrig par byed/ /'di yi zhal ni mtsho yi pad+ma bzhin du rnam par 'dzum/ /'di yi sku ni ba sru g.yo zhing phyag kyang skyob par rtsom/ /'di yi spyan ni 'jig rten rnams dang lhan cig 'gyod pa rtsom/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ kye lha mo kun nas ①'khrug par ma byed cig /na mnyam dga' bas kyang 'dzin par byed do//pad+ma can nges par bltas nas/ 'dir bdag gi skal bas dbugs 'byin par byed do zhes pad+ma skyes kyis ④lag pa nas bzung nas bu dbugs phyung shig /bu dbugs phyung shig /khyod kyi yab ni 'tsho bar snang ngo zhes zer/ rin chen phreng ba ma nas/ kye rgyal po chen po'i 'khor rnams dbugs phyung shig zer/ /rgyal po ni bkan nas rtsa ba gces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de ⑤nyid klog cing dal bus gsal bar byed do/ /pad+ma can nas/ 'phags pa'i sras 'di ni gzhon nu pad+ma skyes te/ 'di yang 'drid dupar mi byed dam/ rgyal po nas bu pad+ma skyes 'dir shog gsungasadze+e/ lag bzangs nas/ bdag gi skal bas ⑧'dir ji ltar bya/ lha 'di ni bdag gis ngal bso nas song ba na/ sbrul gyi mche bas bzung ste brgyal nas mchis so/ /rgyal po ni rtab rtab por 'di ci zhig /pad+ma can nas/ hā bu pad+ma skyes kyis yab ma mthong ma zer/ rin chen phreng ba ma nas/ hā grogs mo dga' ma khyod kyis ⑨yid kyi shing rta ma rdzogs so zhes zer/bzhad gad pa nas/ kye gshin rje tshim pa med pa zer/ lag bzangs nas/lha'i gtsug gi nor bu gang na/ bzhad gad pa nas/ bram ze la byin no/ /94—1519

lag bzangs nas/ g.yo sgyus bcom ste bzod par rab tu dka' ba'i g.yo thabs nges par yin no/ /lha ji ltar dgra rnams 'tsho ba'i phyir gtsug gi nor bu ster bar byed/ rgyal po nas/ bdag la phyis kyang gdung ba med do/ /drang srong nas cis shes zer/ rgyal po nas legs ldan/ gang zhig ①bden pa 'di dang snying rje'i bsam ②pa'i 'bras bu dang / /de byin bdag la nam yang rjes su gdung ba med 'gyur ①na/ /de yis da ltar de bas nus mthu shin tu lhag gyur pa'irka/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag la gtsug gi nor bu 'byung bar shog /ces gsungs pa ༷dang / glog 'khyug ⑤pa bzhin du mthong nas thams cad rtab rtab por gar byed do/ /pad+ma skyes kyang nye bar langs so/ /drang srong nas/a ho sems dpa' chen po'i bsam pa rnam par dag gyur te/ /nyi ma 'od zer stong phrag rnams ni 'phro zhing gsal ba ltar/ /slar yang mi yi bdag la gtsug gi nor bur 'khrungs gyur nas/ /gang gi mthu ni rab brkyang rjodug gi mun pa mngon par bcom/ /pad+ma skyes kyang da ni pad+ma bzhin du rab tu 'dzum zhes zer nas thams cad rtab rtab por gar byed do/ /pad+ma can ni rgyal po la lta zhing pad+ma skyes la 'khyud nas slar yang ⑦bdag gi mig phye bar gyur to zhes smra'o/ /bzhad gad pa nas/ na mnyam dga' ba'i ⑧rdzu 'phrul mngon du mdzad do/ /rin chen phreng ba ma nas/ 'di 'dra ba ltar yod pa bdag cag rnams dga' mo yin no zhes zer ro/ /lag bzangs ⑨nas/ gzhon nu yab yum dag la phyag 'tshol ⑩cig zer/ pad+ma skyes ni thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal bar byed/ rgyal po nas chos dang ldan par gyur cig ces gsungs/ pad+ma skyes ⑩nas yab ji lta bar gyur cig zer/ drang srong nas/ lha mo dang gzhon nu yang 'dir bdag 94—1520

gis 'bul bas rgyal po bzhes par mdzod cig zer/ rgyal po nas/ khyed ji ltar gsungs pa nyebazhin du bya'o/ /thams cad shin tu dga' nas gar byed do/ /drang srong nas 'di bzhin du byas pa khyed 2 kyis bzod par mdzod cig zer/'dren pa nas rjes su bzung ba la bzod pa'i yul gang la yin gsungs /yol ba'i nang nas/ khyod kyi yon tan rnams kyis skye dgu'i yid kyi shing rta rdzogs par shog /mya ngam 4thang la chu gter dang ni ri bo 'dzeg pa'i skas 5 su shog /chu gter sgrol ba'i gzings dang mi bzad mun pa rnams kyi snang bar shog /'jigs chen skyabs gnas dang ni dbul po rnams kyi dpag bsam shing du shog /ces zer ro/ /rgyal po nas 'di gang zhig /drang srong nas/'di ni lha yi tshogs rnams mnyam du khyab 'jug dbang phyug tshangs pa dbang po zla ba sogs/ /lha rnams kun gyis mkha' yi khang bzangs gnas shing thams cad 'di bzhin nam mkha' khyab par gyur/ /chen po de rnams gang rnams kyi ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phel zhing ser po dkar po yis/ /phyogs rnams rab tu mdzes shing khyab pa rtsig 7logs ri mor bris pa bzhin du mdzad gyur to/ /khyed kyi yab yum dag kyang nam mkha'i bzhon pa la gnas nas bu dang bcas shing chung mar bcas pa shis pa shis pa brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas phyag byas so/ /legs ldan 9 ci zhig bsgrub par bya ba gsungs shig /drang srong nas/ khyod ni med gyur mnga' ris sdug bsngal gnas/ /slar yang gshegs shing slar yang skyong ༷bar mdzod/ /di ring sa ke'i 1grong khyer gshegs pa'i phyir/ /mkha' bzhin 'di yang dbang pos khyod la bsrings/ /rgyal po nas/ gong ma rnams ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o/ /thams 94—1521

cad shin tu dga' zhing zhon nas gar byed do/ /yongs su zhugs pa na rgyal po nas| a ho mkha'i bzhon pa ni shin tu mgyogs te/ 'di lta ste/①ngang pa'i gshog pa rnam par bskyod pas rgyu ba'i tshogs ltar chu 'dzin rnams ni ring por gyur/ /ri bo'i dbang po rnams ni glang chen dbang po myos bzhin mngon du phyogs nas rgyug cing 'ong / /'di ni dbang pos dkrigs shing 'khor lo bzhin du nam mkha'i ②mthil ni rnam par gcod snepar byed/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor nye ba'i 'od zer tshogs pas bskor zhing byang gi phyogs su 'gro bar byed—/ /drang srong nas/ 'di ④ni bzod dka' grong khyer skye bo ⑤gnas bcas khyod las ni/ /bdud ris dkrugs shing 'jig rten kun 'tsho blta zhing phyag byed do/ /'di rnams kyang ni skye bo'i gnas bcas shin tu 'das byas nas//bdag nyid ji lta bzhin du grong khyer sā ke ta nas rjoso/ /slar yang khyod kyi dga' ba'i bya ba ci zhig yod pa smra bar gyis shig /rgyal po nas/ 'di las kyang dga' bar bya ba ci zhig yod/ lha mo pad+ma ba tī ⑦bu yi zhal dang dga' ba'i go ⑧ta ma/ /bzhon ⑨zhing mkha' yi bzhon pa la gnas yab yum lha tshogs 'khor bcas mthong / /dga' ba'i blon po sna chen dang ni skye bo'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa/ /rab tu zhi gyur gzhan ni ci zhig bsgrub par bya zhing bya ba ci/ /'on kyang dga' bar bya ba yod de/ 'gro rnams dam chos 'byung zhing rab tu sbyor ba'i ltad mo chen por shog /legs ⑩spyod yon tan rnams kyis 'chi bdag yid kyi shing rta 'bras med shog /thub pa'i skye bo'i gtam gyi 'brel tshogs ⑩zhi zhing bdud rtsi'i char rnams kyis/ /bsil zhing dge bas zla ba'i snang bas rab tu 'gro zhing don byed shog /gang zhig snyan ngag ⑫bden pa 94—1522

rnams kyis dus ring dga' byas shi phru sha yi sred 1rnams kyis/ /dus ring nas ni nor gyi khur thob ring nas skye bo'i sems ni rab tu dga' bar mdzad/ /slar yang bkur gnas mthong bar gyur nas dpal ldan chags pa dang bral zhes pas mdzad gyur pa/ /'jig rten kun du dga' ba sna tshogs zlos gar 'di ni gar gyi sa gzhir thob par shog /ces smras nas thams cad nges par zhugs so / /snyeyan lag lnga pa rdzogs so// //gzhon nu gtsug na nor bu'i skyes pa'i rabs zlos gar gyi bstan bcos 'jig rten kun du dga' ba zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis rab tu sbyar ba'o// //dam pa rnams kyi tshul 'a brten nas paṇ+ḍi ta chen po tīrti tsan+d+ra dang / yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bal yul yam bu'i grong khyer du legs par bsgyur ro// //94—1523

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ nā gā sdenan+da nā ma nā ṭa ka /bod skad du/klu kun du dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar/ thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo / /dga' ma dga' ba'i zol las skyes pa'i spu langs ①dag gis bsgribs pa'i lus 'dzin cing / /'dzum dang ldan pas rgyal ba'i byang chub dag la bkod pa me tog snyim pa ④ni/ /gshog rtsal ⑤rab bskyod sgra sgogs sbrang rtsi byed rnams rjosprang rtsi re bas bsten cing de'i/ /rkang pas bsnun pas kha zum tshogs phye ge sar gsar par gyur pa khyed la srungs⑦/ /bsam gtan zol dag nye bar bzung nas skad cig mig phye su la sems par byed/ /skyob pa yin yang lus med 'das ⑧gzir skye bo 'di dag srung ba min la ltos/ /snying rjer ldan par brdzus ⑨te khyod las gzhan pa'i brtse med skyes bu ga la yod/ /bdud mo rnams kyis byang chub la 'di phrag dog gis brjod rgyal bas khyed la srungs⑩/ /gzhan yang gzhu 94—1533

bkang 'dod pa dang ni rnga gsang brdung zhing sgra sgogs bdud kyi dpa' bo dang / /smin 'khyog rab 'dar glal 'dzum logs su lta ba mtho ris bu mo'i skye bo dang / /grub pa yan lag mchog btud ①rnams dang mtshar bas sru langs lus can nor lha yisaske/ /byang chub 'thob la bsam gtan g.yo med ces bltas thub pa'i dbang pos khyed la srungs/ /shin tu mang bar ②'gyur bas dga' bar byas te mdo 'dzin pa'o/ /di ring bdag po'i dga' ston la phyogs sna tshogs nas 'ongs pa dpal ldan dga' ba'i lha'i zhabs kyi pad+ma nye bar bsten pa'i rgyal po'i tshogs rnams kyis gus pa dang ldan par bos te/ bdag la smras pa/ ji ltar kho bo cag gi rje dpal ldan dga' ba'i lhas/ sngar med pa'i dngos po'i ①rgyan rnam par bkod pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i skyes rabs las brtsams ④pa/ klu kun du dga' ba zhes bya ba'i zlos gar mdzad pa ni kho bo cag rnams kyi nyan pa po'i ⑤brgyud pa las thos te/ sbyor ba dag ni ma rjomathong ngo / /de'i phyir rgyal po de nyid la gus pa dang / kho bo cag la rjes su gzung ⑦ba'i blos sbyor ba ji lta ba bzhin du khyod kyis ⑧zlos gar dag byos shig ces so/ /de'i phyir re zhig tshon gyi bkod pa dag byas nas ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa bzhin yongs su rdzogs par bya'o / /'dus ⑨pa'i skye bo 'di dag gi yid ni kun du tshim par gyur to zhes bya bar bdag gis nges ⑩te/ gang gi phyir/ dpal ldan dga' ba snyan dngags ⑪mkhan po mkhas la 'dus ⑫pa 'di dag yon tan 'dzin/ /'jig rten du ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yid 'phrog zlos gar bdag cag mkhas/ /'dir ni dngos po re re dag kyang 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'thob ⑫pa'i gnas yin na/ /bdag gi skal ba rgyas pas yon tan kun gyi tshogs 'dus 'di la smos ci dgos/ /94—1534

des na re zhig khyim pa mo bos te gru ①dag la gnas par bya'o/ /yongs su bgrod cing ②phyir mngon par phyogs te bltas nas 'phags ma re zhig 'dir/de nas gar mkhan ma ngu zhing zhugs so/ /mdo 'dzin pas mthong nas/'phags ma klu kun du dga' ba snezhes bya ba'i zlos gar bya ba yin na ci'i don du rgyu med pa nyid du ngu ④bar byed/ gar mkhan mas jo bo ji ltar mi ngu ste/gang gi phyir re zhig yab ni yum dang 'grogs nas rgan po'i dngos pos yid byung ste| da ni khyod kyis gnyen tshan ⑤rmi khur dag 'dzin par bzod do zhes thugs la bzhag 0nas dka' thub kyi nags su gshegs so/ /mdo 'dzin pas bdag kyang yongs su btang nas ji ltar yab yum nags su gshegs/ rnam par bsams ⑦nas de la ⑧da ni ci zhig rigs par 'gyur/ /yang na bdag bla ma'i zhabs kyi rim gro byed pa'i bde ba yongs su btang nas ji ltar khyim du 'dug par byed/ ji ltar sprin gyi bzhon pa bzhin/ /dbang phyug rim pas 'ongs btang ste| /pha ma'i sri zhu bsgrub ⑨pa'i phyir/ /bdag kyang nags su 'gro bar bya/ /song bar gyur te skabs dbye ba'o/ /de nas sprin gyi bzhon pa dang / bi dru ṣa ka dag zhugs te/ 'dren pas/ chags pa'i gnas zhes bya bar bdag gis ⑩rig /'jig ces bya bar bdag gis ma rtogs min/ /bya dang bya min rnam par dpyad rnams la/ /phyir phyogs gyur pa ras la sus ma rig /pha ma'i sri zhu byed pa bdag gi ni/ /lang tsho dbang po'i dbang du gyur pa 'di/ /gal te gus pas 'di ltar nyid gyur na/ /de ltar smad par 'os kyang dga' byed 'gyur⑩//bi dru ṣa kas khros pa ⑫dang bcas par/ kye gang gi ⑫tshe gson bzhin du shi ba'i rgan rgon 'di dag 'di ltar nags na 'dug pa la 'di snyed kyi dus su sdug bsngal 94—1535

nyams su myong yang byed ni yid byung bar ma gyur to/ /des na rab tu dang bas da dung yang re zhig bla ma'i zhabs kyi sri zhu la chags pa las phyir bzlog la rgyal srid kyi bde ba nyams su myong bar byos shig /'dren pas/ ji ltar yab kyi mdun du sar 'dug mdzes pa de lta seng ge'i khri la yod dam ci/ /yab kyi zhabs dag nyed pa las byung bde ba de ni rgyal srid dag la'ang ①yod dam ci/ /bla ma'i lhag ma spyad ④pa'i dga' ba gang 'dis sa gsum spyad pa dag la yod dam ci| /bla mas btang ba'i rgyal srid nges par gdung byed dag ste des na ①yon tan ci zhig yod/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ bdag nyid kyis rtogs par e ma 'di ni skye bo bla ma'i sri zhu la chags pa zhig go snyam du bsams nas/ des na 'dir yang re zhig brjod par bya'o/ /gsal bar kye grogs po nges par rgyal srid kyi bde ba 'ba' ④zhig gi ched du bdag gis 'di brjod pa ma yin ste/ gzhan yang khyod la bya ba dag yod pa nyid do/ /'dren pas/ 'dzum dang bcas pas bya ba bdag gis byas pa nyid ma yin nam ltos shig /rigs par 'os pa'i lam la blon po rnams sbyar dam pa rnams ni bde la bzhag /de bzhin gnyen gyi skye bo bdag mtshungs nyid byas rgyal srid dag kyang bsrung bar byas/ /yid la re ba ⑤las lhag 'bras ster dpag bsam shing yang slong ba rnams la byin/ /'di las gzhan pa'i bya ba ci zhig khyod kyi sems la gang zhig gnas pa spros/ bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po shin tu thub chod ldan zhing nyams par byed pa'i lha/ ma tang ga 'di mi rjomathun pa'i phyogs su nye bar gnas pa la gtso bo dang gnyen dag yang dag par gnas kyang khyod med na bdag ni rgyal srid legs par gnas par mi rtog go/ /'dren ⑦pas ma tang gas ⑧rgyal srid len par 'gyur ro zhes bya 94—1536

ba'i dogs pa yod dam ci/ gal te de ltar gyur na de las cir 'gyur/bdag gi lus la sogs pa thams cad gzhan gyi don nyid du yongs su bsrungs pa ma yin nam/ gang yang rang gis ma byin pa de ni yab kyi ngor yin no/ /des na don med pa'i bsam pa 'dis ci zhig bya/ yab kyis rjes su bstan pa nyid lhur bsgrub par bya'o/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye yab kyis ci zhig bstan/ 'dren pas| ji ltar nyi ma mang por yongs su dpyad ①pas dka' thub kyi nags 'di ②yam shing dang / ku sha dang / me tog dang / nye bar mkho ba'i rtsa ba dang /'bras bu dang / sdong bu dang / dri zhim pa dang /① rngad mang ba dag ring du byas par gyur gyis④/ de'i phyir/ ma la ya'i ri la song la bste gnas 'ga' zhig rtogs shig ces yab kyis bdag la rjes su bstan to/ /de'i phyir re zhig ma la ya nyid du 'gro'o zhes te song bar gyur to/ /bi dru ṣa kas mdun du bltas nas kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig /rlan ⑤dang bcas shing stug rjopo'i tsan dan gyi nags kyi khrod nas yongs su bskyod pa dri bzang ⑦rgya chen pos bsgos pa can ri'i ngos mi bzad ⑧pa las babs pas dum bur 'gyur ba'i chu rgyun las 'thor ⑨ba'i thigs pa bsil po 'dzin pa ma la ya'i rlung 'di ni nges par lam gyis ⑩yongs su dub pa dag sel zhing / dang por 'grogs ⑪par 'dod pa'i dga' ma la mgrin pa nas bzung ba bzhin du grogs po mdza' bo la sru long ⑫rgyas par byed pa 'dra'o/ /'dren pas kun du bltas nas a ye bdag cag gis ri ma la yar sleb par gyur to/ /brtags nas/ e ma 'di ni dga' bar bya ba zhig ste/ de ltar yang / dga' ldan phyogs kyi glang po 'gram pa'i ngos 'dar tsan dan dag ni chag cing zag /chu gter rlabs ⑫rnams rab 94—1537

tu bsnun pas phug dang lung pa dag ni cho nges sgogs/ /grub pa'i bud med bgrod pa rnams kyi rkang pa'i sgrug ①rtsis dmar ba mu tig rdo/ /bsten bya ri bo ma la ya 'dis bdag gi sems ni ci yang sred ldan byed/ /des ④na tshur shog /'di la 'dzegs te 'dug par 'os pa'i bste gnas dag btsal bar sdebya'o/ /'jogs te mtshan ma gsal ④bar byas nas/ bdag gi mig ni g.yas pa g.yo/ /'bras bu 'dod pa 'ga' yang med/ /thub pa'i gsung yang ⑤brdzun ma yin/ /'di ni ci zhig 'chad 'gyur ke/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po grogs po rjol dga' ba 'ga' zhig nye bar ston to/ /'dren pas/ nges par ji ltar khyod kyis smras pa de bzhin no/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig /khyad par dang bcas par stug dze+ecing snum pa'i rkang 'thung ⑧gis nye bar mdzes shing ba'i mar gyi ⑨dri'i snying po can gyi du ba drag tu 'phyur la/ ri dwags kyi tshogs 'jigs pa med cing lam du bag phab ste gnas pa 'di ni dka' thub kyi nags tshal bzhin du mtshon no/ /'dren pas/ grogs po yang dag par mtshon no/ /'di dag ni dka' thub kyi nags tshal nyid de/ gang gi phyir/gos kyi don du shing shun rnams bcad rtse ba nyid kyis shin tu che ba min/ /ril ba rnying pa chag ⑩pas mtshan pa'i ⑩chu rgyun dag ni mkha' ltar rab tu dang / /'ga' zhig dag na muñdza'i ⑫ske rags khye'u sa bcad cing dor bar gyur pa mthong //rtag tu thos pas ṣ+pe tsho dag kyang rig byed tshig 'di rab tu sgogs ⑫par byed/ / des na ④tshur sheg rab tu zhugs te/ nye bar mtshon par bya'o/ /rab tu zhugs te gar dag byed do/ /'dren pas/ e ma thub pa'i skye bo rab tu dga' ba rnams ni rig byed kyi tshig rgyas pa la the tshom rnam par gcod ⑫par byed 94—1538

la/ khye'u'i skye bo rnams ni ji ltar gsher ba gsher ①ba'i yam shing dag gcod ④cing / /dka' thub pa'i gzhon nu ma rnams ni ljon pa gsar pa'i kyo ra 'gengs ①par byed pa'i dka' thub kyi nags tshal ni rab tu zhi ba dang dga' bar byed pa nyid do④/ /'di nyid na/ bung ba'i sgra yis legs par 'ongs sam zhes ni brjod pa bzhin/ /'di dag mgo ni 'bras bu dud pas 'dud par ⑤byed pa bzhin| / me tog ⑦char pa 'thor zhing bdag la mchod yon ster ba bzhin/ /yal ga ldan pa yis kyang mgron gyi bsnyen bkur ji ltar bslabs/ /de'i phyir dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'dir ⑦ni 'dug par 'os pa zhig ⑧ste/ 'dir gnas na bdag cag gi sems bde bar 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /bi dru ṣa kas/kye grogs po 'on kyang nges par ri dwags 'di dag mgrin pa cung zad kyogs ⑨te g.yo ba med pa'i kha las cung zad zos pa'i rtswa kham nang na gnas pa zag cing rna ba gcig rab tu bslangs te gtad ⑩nas mig zum pa dang bcas ⑪pas nyan par byed pa lta bur mtshon no/ /'dren pas rna ba ⑫gtad nas/ gnas thob rab tu gsal ba'i 'gros ⑫can gdangs snyan dag gis rnam par gzhag spyopa 'dzin byed pa/ /bung ba'i sgra bzhin nges par yid 'phrog rgyud mangs ⑫dag gi rgyud mangs sgra dang ldan pa yis/ /gsal zhing rol sgeg tshig ldan gru ni kun du 'khyog pa'i lus can ri dwags 'di dag rnams/ /so yi bar na gnas pa rtswa yi kham ni gcod pa'i sgra dag bsdams nas nyan par byed/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'di na su zhig glu len par byed/ 'dren pas/ji ltar sor mo 'jam pa'i 'dab mas mngon par bsnun pa'i rgyud mangs shin tu gsal ba ma yin par sgogs shing glu yang snyan cing phra ba gtsor ⑫len pa de ltar 94—1539

bdag rtog pa ni gnas 'di na lha dag mnyes par byed cing lha'i bud med rgyud mangs dang ldan pa'i gru len par byed do/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po tshur shog /yu'u cag kyang lha'i gnas blta bar bya'o/ /'dren pas legs par brjod de/ nges par lha ni phyag bya bar 'os pa'o/ /nye bar song ste 'phral la ①'dug nas grogs po gal te na skye bo 'di lta bar mi 'os pa srid do/ / de nas ②re zhig ta ma la'i gel pa 'di'i nang du 'dug ste lha lta ba'i skabs btsal bar bya'o//de ltar byas te/ de nas ma la ya can ma dang / 'bangs mo zhugs te sa la 'dug nas rgyud mangs byung bar byed do/ /'dren mas glu len pa/ go rī ①rab rgyas pad+ma'i ge sar gyi/ /dngul ltar dkar ba'i 'od can bcom ldan ma/ /khyod kyi bka' drin dag gis bdag gi ni/ /mngon par 'dod pa rab tu grub par mdzod④/ /'dren pas rna ⑤gtad nas/ e ma ho gru/ e ma ho rol mo/'di la gsal byed kyi dbyangs rnam pa bcu po 'dis gsal ba thob cing / myur ba dang / bar ma dang / dal ba'i stabs rjornam pa gsum rab tu gsal bar yongs su bcad de/ ba lang gi rnga ma la sogs pa rnam pa gsum gyi rim pas ngal bso ⑦bar byas pa de kho na'i tshogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rol mo'i cho ga yang dag pa gsum bstan to/ /'bangs ⑧mos/ rje'i sras mo nges par yun ring du glu dag blangs nas khyod kyi lag rtse dag yongs su mi ngal lam/ 'dren mas/grung ⑨mo bcom ldan ma'i mdun du rgyud mangs sgogs par byed pa la bdag ga la ngal| 'bangs mos sgod pa dang bcas par kye brtse med ma 'di'i mdun du rgyud mangs bsgrags pas ci zhig bya zhes bdag smra'o/ /gang zhig 'di snyed kyi dus su skye bo gzhon nu ma'i dka' thub bsnyen nas ⑩nges pa la gnas pas bstan 94—1540

kyang da dung khyod la dang bar mi ston no/ /ji dru ṣa kas thos nas/ kye grogs po 'di ni nges par gzhon nu ma ste ci'i phyir mi lta/ 'dren pas skyon ci yod/gzhon nu ma lta ba ni skyon med pa nyid do/ /'on kyang gal te na bdag cag mthong nas 'jigs te/ ngo tsha ba gzhon nu ①ma la rnyed sla bas 'dir yun ring du mi sdod pa mi ②srid do/ /des na re zhig 'khri shing gi dra ba 'dis bsgribs te blta bar bya'o/ /gnyi gas bltas te/ bi dru ③ṣa kas/ ya mtshan dang bcas par kye grogs po ltos shig ltos shig /ngo mtshar ro ngo mtshar ro/ /rgyud mangs kyi sgras ④rna ba'i bde ba skyed par byed pa ⑤'ba' zhig tu ma zad de/rnam par shes pa'i rjes su mthun pa'i gzugs 'dis mig gi yang bde ba skyed par byed do/ /de'i phyir 'di ni rjosu zhig yin ci lha mo 'am/ klu'i bu mo'am/yang na rig pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo 'am/ yang na grub pa'i rigs las 'khrungs pa zhig go/ /'dren pas rnam par blta zhing chags pa dang bcas par grogs po 'di su zhig yin zhes bdag gis ma rtogs so/ /bdag gis ⑦'di tsam shes te/gal te mtho ris bu mo yin na 'phrog byed mig stong ldan des don byas 'gyur/ /gal te klu yi bu ⑧mo yin na'ang 'di'i ⑨gdong yod tshe sa 'og zla bas stong ma yin//gal ste rig 'dzin ma yin gzhan rigs las rgyal bdag cag rigs ni 'bras dang bcas/ /gal te grub rigs las skyes de phyir grub pa 'jig rten gsum du grags par 'gyur/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ 'dren pa la bltas nas dga' ba dang bcas shing rang gis rtogs par e ma'o/ /yun ring po zhig nas yid srub kyi spyod yul du lhung bar gyur to/ /bdag nyid la ston cing / yang na ma yin te/bram ze bdag gi'o/ /'bangs mos/ mdza' ba dang bcas par kye bram ze ⑩94—1541

bdag smra'o/ /brtse med ma 'di'i mdun du rgyud mangs bsgrags pas ci zhig bya zhes te rgyud mangs 'phangs so/ /'dren mas bu mo bcom ldan ma go rī ①la ma smad cig /ke ②ding bcom ldan mas ①bka' drin mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'bangs mos/ rje'i sras mo re zhig ci 'dra ba dag spros shig /'dren mas/bu mo nges par deng durmi lam du bdag 'di bzhin nyid du rgyud mangs bgreng ba la bcom ldan mas gsungs pa/ bu mo khyod kyis ⑤rgyud mangs bgreng ba mkhas pa khyad par du 'phags pa 'di dang / bdag la thun mong ma yin pa'i gus pa bu mo'i dngos po la rnyed dka' ba 'dis bdag shin tu tshim par gyur to/ /de'i phyir yun ring po ma yin pa na rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur bas lag pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /'bangs mos dga' ba dang bcas par rje'i sras mo/ gal te de ltar yin na mi lam du zhes ci'i phyir brjod/ lha mos snying la rjo'adod pa'i mchog ⑦byen pa nyid yin no/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ nges par bdag cag lha mo lta ba'i skabs su bab po/ /de'i phyir tshur sheg nye bar 'gro bar bya'o zhes te nye bar btud do/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ mi 'dod bzhin du khyen nas jo mo grung sgemo bdag bden par smra ste/ 'di ni mchog byen pa nyid do/ /'dren mas 'jigs ⑨pa dang bcas par 'dren pa ⑩la mtshon te/ bu mo 'di su zhig ces so/ /'bangs mos/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa 'dis ⑩na/ 'di nyid bcom ldan mas bka' drin mdzad pa yin ⑫snyam mo/ /'dren mas chags pa dang bcas shing ngo tsha ba dang bcas par bltas so/ /'dren pas/ g.yo zhing yangs pa'i mig ldan dbugs 'byin cing / /'dar zhing mkhregs stug ⑫nu ldan 'khrul byed ma/ /lus 'di dka' thub nyid kyis ⑫94—1542

shin tu ni/ /ngal gyur slar yang ci slad gdung bar byed/ /'dren mas/ bu mo shin tu 'jigs pas 'di la mngon ①du phyogs te 'dug par mi nus so zhes te/logs la ②bltas nas 'khod do/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ jo mo khyod kyi dka' thub kyi nags tshal 'di na gang zhig 'gron snepo 'ongs pa la tshig tsam gyis kyang phebs par smra ba ma yin pa 'di 'dra ba'i kun du spyod pa yod dam byu/ 'bangs mos rje'i sras mo/ 'gron ④po la bsnyen bkur bya ba rigs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir ji ltar mthu chen po dang ldan pa 'di dag la gus par bya ba la rmongs par gnas/yang na khyod bzhugs shig /kho mo nyid kyis ji ltar rigs pa dag bya'i/'dren pa ⑤la mtshon te jo bo legs par 'ongs sam/ jo bo rjostan yongs su bzung ⑦bas phyogs 'di brgyan par mdzod cig /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye grogs po 'di ni legs par smra'o/ /yud tsam zhig 'dug ste ngal gso ⑧bar bya'o/ /'dren pas/ khyod ni rigs par smra'o/ /gnyi ga 'khod do/ /'dren mas kwa yi ⑨bzhad gad kyi ngang tshul can ma de ltar ma byed/ gal te dka' thub pa 'ga' zhig gis mthong na 'di las bdag dul ba ma yin pa dang ldan par dogs ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dka' thub pa zhugs te/ rigs kyi bdag po kau shi kas bdag la bka' bsgos pa/ mnyes gshin shā ṇa ḍa ⑪l+ya/ yab kyi bkas/rgyal tshab bshes gnyen gyi dbyig gzhon nu sprin kyi bzhon ⑫pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ⑫bar 'byur bdag ri ma ④ya 'di nyid kyi phyogs ⑫'ga' zhig na gnas pa sring mo ma la ya can gyi khyem thab kyi slad du blta ba'i phyir di ring 'ongs te⑩| gal te de blta zhing ma la ya can gyi nyi ma gung gi mchod sbyin gyi dus yol bar 'gyur srid do/ /des na de bos la shog shig ces so/ /des na 94—1543

bdag re zhig go rī'i ①khang pa nyid du 'gro'o/ /'gro zhing sa la rnam par bltas nas/ a sneye rdul dang ldan pa'i phyogs na rab tu gsal ba'i 'khor los mtshan pa'i rjes kyi phreng ba dag snang ba 'di su zhig gi yin/ mdun du bltas te sprin gyi bzhon pa la nges par brtags nas 'di ni skyes bu chen po 'di khruyin nam snyam mo/ /gzhan yang / mgo la gtsug tor 'di gsal smin ma'i bar na mdzod spu 'di ni rnam par mdzes/ /mig ni pad+ma'i rjes su mthun zhing brang gdengs 'phrog byed dag la 'gran par byed/ /lag pa 'khor los mtshan pa ji ltar de ltar ④skyes bu dag ni su zhig 'di/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i gnas dag ma thob 'dug pa yin nam snyam/ /yang na the tshom gyis ci zhig bya ste/ shin tu gsal bar 'di ni sprin gyi bzhon pa yin par nges so ma la ya can ma la bltas nas a ye 'di yang rgyal po'i bu mo'o/ /gnyi ga la bltas nas| gal te phan tshun rjes su 'tsham pa 'di dag 'brel par byed na byed pa po ni yun ring po zhig na rig pa byed par gyur to/ /nye bar btud nas khyod ni ⑤dge bar gyur cig /'dren pas/ bcom ldan sprin gyi bzhon pa phyag bgyid do zhes te ldang bar 'dod do/ /dka' thub pas mngon du ldang mi dgos so/ /kye mngon 'ongs kun gyi bla ma nyid ces pas/ khyod nyid bdag cag gi bla ma yin no| /des na ji ltar bde bar bzhugs shig /ma la ya can mas/ jo bo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dka' thub pas de mthong nas/ rjes su 'tsham pa'i bdag po'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig /rgyal po'i bu mo/ khyod la rigs kyi bdag po kau shi kas bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyi mchod sbyin gyi dus yol bar 'gyur gyis myur du shog shig ces so/ /'dren mas/ mi dga' ba dang bcas 94—1544

par| gang bla mas bka' stsal pa nyid do/ /rang gi rtogs par/ gcig ni bla ①ma'i gsung dang gzhan/ /mdza' bo blta ②ba'i rtse dga' bzang / /'gro 'am mi 'gro 'gal ba la/ /bdag snying 'phyang ①mo yug par 'gyur/ /shugs phyung zhing ④langs te ngo tsha ba ⑤dang bcas shing chags pa dang bcas par 'dren pa la blta zhing dka' thub pa dang lhan cig song bar gyur to/ /'dren pas| sred pa dang bcas par shugs phyung nas 'dren ma la blta zhing /tshang ra'i khyon gyi khur ldan zhing / /dman pa dag tu 'gro ma 'di/ /gzhan du 'gro yang bdag gi ni/ /snying la gom pa bkod par gyur/ /'bangs mos/tshur sheg chur sheg /rje'i sras mo zhes te/ ma la ya can ma 'khor dang bcas pa song bar gyur to/ /bi dru ṣa kas/ kye gang zhig blta bar bya ba dag mthong ngo / /da ni nyi ma gung gi nyi ma'i gdung ba nyis 'gyur du byas pa bzhin du bdag gi rjolto ba'i me dag lhab lhab byed do/ /de'i phyir 'di nas song ste/gang gis bram ze dag gi mgron du 'gyur bar byas nas thub pa'i skye bo las dngos su rnyed pa'i rtsa ba dang chu ba la sogs pas srog gzung ⑦bar bya'o/ /'dren pas/steng du bltas nas/ a ye/ bcom ldan 'od zer stong phrag ldan ni nam mkha'i dkyil na 'dzegs te bzhugs so/ /de ltar yang / gdung bas de dus tsan dan la bdar ⑧thang chus dkar ba'i 'gram pa 'dzin byed cing / /rang gi rna ba bskyod pa'i rlung ni yang dag chags pas bzhin la g.yob byed cing ⑨/ /lag pas gtor ba'i chu thigs snying khar khyad par du 'dren ⑩glang po'i bdag po 'di| /da ni bzod dka' zug rngu drag pos zug pa lta bu'i gnas skabs 'dzin par byed/ /ces te gnyi ga ⑩song ngo / /mtshan ma dang po'o// //94—1545

de nas 'bangs mo zhugs te/ rje'i sras mo ma la ya can mas/bdag la gsungs ①pa/ bu mo me tog gsar ba can bdag gi ming po jo bo bshes gnyen gyi dbyig di ②ring yun ring du thogs so/ /de'i phyir song la 'ong ngam mi 'ong rtogs shig ces so/ /yongs su bgrod snede phyi rol du mngon par phyogs shing bltas nas/ 'di nyid nas 'ongs pa 'di su zhig yin/nges par brtags nas ci grung ④mo'am/ 'bangs mo gnyis pa yang zhugs so//dang po mas nye bar btud nas/ grogs mo grung mo ⑤khyod kyang ci'i phyir mgyogs par 'gro bar byed/ gnyis pas rje'i sras mo ma la ya can mas bdag la gsungs pa/ bu mo grung rjomo bdag gi lus kyis me tog thu ba'i ⑦yongs su ngal ba mi bzod do/ /ston ka'i gdung bas byas pa bzhin du bdag yongs su gdung bas shin tu lhag par gzir bar gyur to/ /des na khyod song la chu shing gzhon nu'i 'dab mas bsgribs pa tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang par/zla ba chu shel gyi rdo la mal stan chas gyis shig ces so/ /ji ltar gsungs pa ⑧bzhin du bdag gis kyang byas te/ de'i phyir song nas rje'i sras mo nyid la sbran par bya'o/ /dang po mas/ gal te de ltar ⑨yin na myur du chas dag gyis tu)shig /der song na de'i gdung ba nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pas bgad nas rang gis ⑪rtogs par gang zhig 'di 'dra ba'i gdung ba dag ni de lta bus nye bar zhi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rnam par bkra zhing dga' bar bya ba tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang pa mthong nas ⑫de ni shin tu yang lhag par 'gyur ro zhes bdag rtog go/ /gsal bar grogs mo khyod song shig /94—1546

bdag gis kyang rdo ba'i gzhi bstar ba bdag rje'i sras mo la sbran par bya'o zhes nas song ste 'jug par byed pa'o/ /de nas sred pa dang ldan pa'i ma la ya can ma dang / 'bangs mo yang zhugs so/ /'dren mas shugs nar phyung nas bdag nyid kyis rtogs par/ skye bo de la sems khyod kyis bdag ngo tshas/de ltar phyir phyogs par byas te/ da ni khyod nyid der 'gro ba'i phyir na/e ma khyod ni bdag nyid rgyas par byed pa zhig go/ /gsal bar/ bu mo bcom ldan ma'i gnas su 'gro ba'i lam dag bdag la ston cig /'bangs mos rje'i sras mo tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang par gshegs pa ma lags sam/'dren mas/ ngo tsha dang bcas pas ①bu mo khyod kyis legs par dran par byas so| /de'i phyir tshur sheg de nyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /'bangs mos byon cig byon cig rje'i sras mo song bar gyur to/ /'dren ma gzhan du song ba na/'bangs mos phyir bltas nas mya ngan dang bcas shing bdag nyid kyis rtogs par kye sdem 'di ni snying gis stong ba zhig ste ji ltar yang snelha mo'i gnas de nyid du 'jug par byed do/ /gsal bar de na tsan dan 'khri shing khang pa yod pa ma yin nam/ des na 'dir byon cig /'dren mas skyengs pa'i 'dzum dang bcas par de ltar byed do/ /'bangs mos tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang pa de ni 'di lags so/ /des na nang du zhugs te zla ba chu shel gyi nor bu'i rdo la rje'i sras mo bzhugs ④par mdzod cig /'dren mas/ de ltar byas te shugs nar phyung nas bdag nyid kyis rtogs par/ bcom ldan me tog gi mtshon dang ldan pa gang gi gzugs kyis pham par byas pa de la ci yang mi bgyid par gnod pa ma byas shing bud med du gyur pa dag la bsnun par bgyid/ ngo tsha ba ⑤ma mchis 94—1547

sam zhes te myos pa'i gnas skabs kyi gar dag byed do/ /gsal bar nges par byas nas bu mo ci'i phyir yal 'dab stug pos nyi ma'i 'od zer sgrib ①pa dang ldan pa'i tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang pa 'di dag ding bdag gdung ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed/ 'bangs mos 'dzum dang bcas par gdung ba'i rgyu ni bdag gis ②shes te/ 'on kyang rje'i sras mo/ bdag la thugs mi ches pas ①khas len par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dren mas/ bdag nyid kyis rtogs par 'dis bdag mtshon yang re zhig dri bar bya'o/ /gsal bar/ bu mo re zhig de dag gis ④ci/ de'i rgyu ci yin bdag smros shig /'bangs mos/ rje'i sras mo 'di ni byed kyi snying la 'dod pa'i mchog /'dren mas brtabs ⑤pa dang bcas shing dga' ba dang bcas par langs te/ mdun du gom pa gnyis gsum song nas de gang na gang na/ 'bangs mos langs te/ 'dzum pa dang bcas par durje'i sras mo ci ⑦lags/ 'dren mas/ ngo tsha dang bcas par ⑧'dug ste kha 'og tu bltas nas 'khod do/ /'bangs mos rje'i sras mo bdag ni 'di skad brjod par 'dod de/ 'di ni byed kyi snying la 'dod pa'i mchog gdung ba'i rgyu yin pa gang gis na tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang pa rang bzhin gyis bsel yang khyod kyi gdung ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mi nus so/ /'dren mas dga' ba ⑨dang bcas par 'bangs mo la 'khyud nas/ bu mo grung ⑩mo khyod ni nges par grung ⑪mo ste/ gzhan pa ci zhig dri bar bya/ des na sgros shig /'bangs mo ⑫rje'i sras mo da lta nyid khyod la smras pa yin no/ /des na mchog lta bas byas pa'i gdung ba 'dis re zhig gdung bar ma byed cig /gal te bdag grung ⑫mo yin pa de lta na de yang rje'i sras mo mthong ba med par yud tsam yang gzhan du mngon 94—1548

par dga' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di yang bdag gis shes pa nyid do/ /'dren mas mchi ma dang bcas par bu mo de lta bu'i skal ba bdag la ga la yod/'bangs mos rje'i sras mo de skad ci la gsungs①/ khyab 'jug ⑧brang gi gzhi la dpal mo 'dzin pa yang bde bar ji ltar 'gyur/ 'dren mas skye bo legs pa ngag snyan pa bor nas/ gzhan smra bar byed dam ci/ bu mo bdag gi gdung ba 'di bas kyang 'di shin tu lhag par gzir ba ste/ gang gzi byen chen po de la tshig tsam gyis kyang dga' bar ma byas pa bdag tshul dang mthun pa ma yin par mdon to zhes te ④ngus so/ /'bangs mos mchi ma dang bcas par rje'i sras mo ma bshums shig /langs nas yal 'dab blangs nas bapar te khu ba snying gar byugs so/ /rje'i sras mo/ bdag smra'o/ /ma bshums shig /nu ma'i ngos la byugs pa ④tsan dan yal 'dab kyi ⑤thang chu 'di ni nges par rgyun chad med par 'bab dupa mchi ma'i thigs pa 'di dag gis dro bar byas pas khyod kyi snying ga'i gdung ba mi sel lo zhes te chu shing gi 'dab ma dag gis g.yob par ⑦byed do//'dren mas/ lag pas bzlog ⑧cing / bu mo ma g.yob ma g.yob chu shing gi 'dab ma'i rlung 'di ni shin tu pa'o/ /'bangs mos rje'i sras mo 'di'i skyon du ma byed cig /'di ltar snyam ⑨zhing stug pa'i tsan dan 'khri shing yal 'dab dang 'grogs pa chu shing gi 'dab ma'i rlung 'di ni ⑩shin tu bsel yang byed nyid kyi dbugs kyis tsha bar byas so/ /'dren mas mchi ma dang bcas par bu mo ⑪sdug bsngal 'di nye bar zhi ba'i thabs 'ga' zhig yod dam/ 'bangs mos rje'i sras mo gal te de nyid 'dir 'ongs na ⑫yod pa nyid do/ /de nas 'dren pa ⑫dang / bi dru ṣa ka dag zhugs so/ /'dren pas/ phyir log ⑫dkar dang 94—1549

dkar min mig gi 'od kyis bste gnas shing de rnams/ /yal ga la chags ri dwags pags pa'i tshogs kyis sgeg pa bzhin byed cing / /thub pa'i sngon du bdag la bltas pa gang de nyid kyis bdag ni bcom gyur na/ /me tog mda' can byed kyis ①don med mda' 'di dag ni ci slad 'phen par byed/ /bi dru ṣa kas| kye grogs po nges par khyod kyi brtan pa gang du song / 'dren pas/grogs po bdag la brtan pa yod pa nyid ma yin nam/ gang gi phyir/ zla bas dag pa'i mtshan las ④min nam ci zhig ut+pal sngon po ma bsnams sam/ /rab rgyas dzā ti'i me tog dri ldang srod la'i rlung dag bzod pa min nam ci/ /pad tshal sbrang rtsi byed pa'i dar dir sgra dag ①ci zhig bdag gis ma rjomanyan nam/ /gdung ba dag gis gnod med bdag la mi brtenasnyepa zhes gang gis byed rjod byed//yang ni rjogrogs po a ti'i ⑦rigs bdag gis yang dag par ma brjod do/ /lus med kyis 'phangs pa me tog gi mda' ni bud med kyi ⑧snying gis kyang bzod pa ma yin nam/ gang gis na de ring khyod kyi ⑨mdun du bdag gis bstan ⑩pa yin no zhes brjod par bya/ bi dru ṣa kas/ bdag nyid kyis rtogs par 'di ltar brtan ⑪pa med pa nyid du yang ⑫khas len cing / 'dis snying la gdung ba chen po gnas pa dag gsal bar byed do/ /des na re zhig ji ltar yang 'di g.yeng bar bya'o/ /gsal bar kye grogs po ding khyod bla ma'i bsnyen bkur myur ba nyid du byas nas ci'i slad du 'dir 'ongs/ 'dren pas/ grogs po gnas ⑫dag dris te gzhan su zhig la 'di smra bar bya/ ding bdag gi ⑫mi lam du shes pa ni dga' ma'i mchog de nyid mdzub ⑫mos ston cing tsan dan 'khri shing gi khang pa ⑫zla ba chu shel gyi stan 'di la 'dug nas mdza' bas khros te/94—1550
